turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Thank you for calling StarHub support. My name is Amanda. May I have your account number please?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [angry gasp] Don't ask me for account number again! I called three times already today! Your internet is down AGAIN, completely useless lah!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I deeply apologize for the repeated downtime, sir. I see there's an outage in your area and we are currently working to—

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: CANCEL IT! Just cancel the whole line! I am switching to Singtel tomorrow. Absolute rubbish service!

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [heavy sigh] So you're telling me, my card is blocked while I'm stuck overseas, and I have to visit a branch... in Kuala Lumpur?

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Unfortunately, for security protocol regarding suspected fraud, physical verification is the only way we can unlock the card, ma'am.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [scoff] Wow. Fantastic. Really a world-class digital bank. So helpful.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I understand this is frustrating. I can offer you an emergency cash advance via wire transfer if—

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Whatever. Just leave it blocked. I'll figure it out myself.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Hello, my laptop is asking for a BitLocker recovery key. I am not sure where to find this.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Not a problem at all. If you log into your Microsoft account on your phone, you will find it under the Devices section.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Ah, okay, let me check now. [pause] Yes, I see a long string of numbers here.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Perfect. Just type those numbers exactly as they appear into your laptop, and it will unlock.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: It is booting up now. Thank you for the quick help.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Hi! I just realized I entered the completely wrong shipping address for my daughter's wedding gift. Is it too late to change it?

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Let me check the dispatch status for you. Oh, it was just about to leave the warehouse. I've intercepted it and updated the address.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [warm laugh] Oh my goodness, are you serious? You are an absolute lifesaver! I was so stressed out about this!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: You're very welcome! It will arrive at the new address by Thursday.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Thank you, thank you so much! Brilliant service, truly. Have a wonderful day!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Hello, this is HSBC Premier. How can I assist you with your mortgage application today?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [angry gasp] Are you joking with me? You rejected it AGAIN without any explanation! I sent the documents three times already!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I see the application here, sir. It appears the income verification was flagged by our automated—

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: I DON'T CARE ABOUT YOUR SYSTEM! Let me speak to your manager right now! This is completely unacceptable!

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: My email is locked again! You people promised it was fixed yesterday. I am losing business because of this nonsense!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I am so sorry to hear that. Let me quickly pull up your domain settings to see what—

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: No, no, NO! No more checking! If it is not unlocked in five minutes, I am taking my entire company to a different provider!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Thank you for contacting Shopee Logistics. Your parcel is currently held at the transit hub due to a delayed flight.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [scoff] Delayed flight? It has been sitting there for two weeks! That was supposed to be a birthday gift!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I completely understand the frustration. As a courtesy, I can process a full refund right now, or—

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: I don't want a stupid refund! I WANT MY PARCEL! Get someone on the phone who can actually deliver it!

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: So let me get this straight. You charged me fifty dollars for roaming, even though I specifically bought the data passport package.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Looking at the logs, ma'am, it seems the data passport was activated on the 15th, but the roaming charges were incurred on the 14th.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [mocking chuckle] Oh, how convenient. Really amazing system you have there. Just brilliant.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I can offer a one-time waiver for half of the charges, but I cannot waive the full fifty dollars.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [sigh] Fine. Just do it. I'm too tired to argue with you people.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [heavy sigh] Every single time I log into the app, it asks me for a security token. I already disabled that feature.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: There was a recent security update that re-enabled 2FA for all accounts holding over ten thousand dollars, sir.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: So you change my settings without telling me? That is incredibly annoying.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: It was detailed in the terms of service update email sent last week, but I can guide you on how to opt out.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Don't bother. I will just deal with it. Goodbye.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I've checked the warranty, and unfortunately, physical screen damage is not covered under the standard policy.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: So... there is nothing you can do. Even though it arrived cracked.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Since it was reported after the 48-hour delivery window, our system automatically denies the claim. I am truly sorry.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [sigh] Yes. Okay. It is my fault for not checking immediately. Forget it.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Hi, I need help resetting my password. The reset link isn't arriving in my inbox.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Sure thing. Sometimes they get caught in the spam folder. Could you check there for an email from support@company.com?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Ah, yes, it is in the spam folder. I see it now.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Great! Just click that link, and you should be good to go.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Done. The password is reset. Thank you.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Your new billing cycle will start on the first of next month, which is why there is a prorated charge on this invoice.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Oh, I understand now. So next month will just be the standard flat rate?

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Exactly. Next month it will be exactly forty-five dollars, with no extra fees.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Okay, that makes perfect sense. I will go ahead and pay this bill online.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Thank you very much. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: I want to transfer some funds to my fixed deposit account, but I forgot the routing code.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: No problem, sir. The routing code for the internal fixed deposit is 014.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: 014. Let me type that in. Okay, the transfer was successful.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Perfect. You should see the updated balance in your account dashboard immediately.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Yes, I see it. Thanks for your help.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: I received my dress, but it is one size too small. Is it too late to exchange it before my event on Friday?

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Not at all! I will expedite a replacement for you right now via overnight shipping, completely free of charge.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Are you serious? That is amazing! Thank you so much, I was really starting to panic!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: It is my pleasure! The tracking number will be in your email shortly. Have a wonderful time at your event!

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: You are the best! Five stars for your service, truly!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Okay, the modem has been remotely reset. You should see all the green lights come back on now.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [warm laugh] Yes, it is working perfectly! I have been trying to fix this for three hours. You solved it in three minutes!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I am so glad I could help out. It was just a small configuration error on our side.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Well, you are a wizard, my friend. Thank you so much for the excellent support. Have a great day!

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: I am so confused by this new app interface. I just want to pay my utility bill, but I can't find the button.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Don't worry, I can guide you. Look at the bottom right corner; there should be a blue icon that says 'Payments'.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Oh, I see it now! And there is the utility option. That was so easy.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Excellent! You can also save it as a favorite so it appears on the home screen next time.

turns.text: Yes, yes. Account number is TLC dash eight eight four two zero one. And registered number is nine eight four five, three three two, one one zero.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Thank you, Mr. Menon. I can see your account — FiberMax three hundred Mbps plan, registered to the Koramangala address. Is that correct?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Yes, yes, that is correct only. Koramangala, fourth block. Now please tell me what is the problem. I am working from home today and I cannot even load a simple video call, isn't it?

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I completely understand, Mr. Menon, and I sincerely apologize for the inconvenience. Let me run a quick line diagnostic on our end. Could you tell me approximately what speed you are getting right now?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: I just ran the speed test only, Priya ji — I am getting four Mbps download. FOUR! On a three-hundred Mbps plan, na? [scoff] This is completely unacceptable.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Four Mbps — yes, that is significantly below your plan speed. I can see alerts on your node as well, Mr. Menon. While I run the full diagnostic, may I ask — is your router connected via ethernet or Wi-Fi?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Wi-Fi only. But I am sitting right next to the router, na. Two feet away. Signal is full bars showing.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Understood. Let's first try a router restart. Could you please switch off the router, wait for thirty seconds, then power it back on? I'll hold on the line.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [sigh] Okay, okay. I am switching it off now. [pause] Thirty seconds... [pause] All right, switching back on. Lights are blinking.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Perfect. Please give it about a minute to fully reconnect. I'm watching the line signal on my end right now.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Okay, it has reconnected. Running speed test again... [pause] ...Still only five Mbps, Priya ji. There is no improvement at all, na. This restart is not helping.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I see that, Mr. Menon, and I apologize — the restart did not clear the issue. My diagnostic is showing packet loss at the distribution node serving your area. This is a network-level problem, not your equipment.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Network level? Then why is nobody fixing it? Since MORNING I am suffering. Do you know how many important meetings I have missed today? Kindly tell me when this will be resolved.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Mr. Menon, I completely hear your frustration and I truly apologize. I need to escalate this to our network operations team for a priority fix. May I place you on a brief hold of about two minutes while I loop them in?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [angry gasp] Two more minutes? Priya ji, I have been suffering since nine AM and you are saying two more minutes hold? [sigh] Fine, fine. Go ahead, but please hurry up only.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Thank you so much for your patience, Mr. Menon. I'm connecting you now. Please hold.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: [hold music plays for approximately eight seconds] Mr. Menon, thank you for holding. I've now connected with our Level Two network operations engineer, Suresh, who can see your node directly.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Hello? Yes, yes I am here. Okay, so what is the status now?

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: So Suresh has identified a fiber splice fault at the Koramangala junction box — it was causing signal degradation across roughly forty households in your sector. He is pushing a remote rerouting command to your node right now.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Forty households? So it was not just me? [scoff] And nobody sent any alert or notification? I was thinking my equipment is faulty only. This is very poor communication, na.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: You are absolutely right, Mr. Menon, and that is a valid point. Our proactive alert system should have notified you and it failed to do so in this case. I will be raising a feedback ticket for that as well. I sincerely apologize.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [sigh] Okay. So is it fixed now or still rerouting? I am checking my speed test... [pause] ...Oh! Oh wait. Eighty-seven Mbps now! That is much better!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Wonderful! The rerouting is still completing — it should climb closer to your full three hundred in the next few minutes as the signal stabilizes. Can you run one more test in about sixty seconds?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Yes, yes, I am waiting... [pause] Running again now... [pause] Two hundred and sixty-four Mbps! Arrey! That is almost full speed, na! [warm laugh] It is working!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: That is excellent news, Mr. Menon! I'm so relieved. The remaining gap to three hundred will fully close as the node finishes optimizing — should be complete within the hour.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Priya ji, I am honestly SO HAPPY right now. You don't know — I was about to go to my neighbor's house to borrow their hotspot only! [warm laugh] What a relief this is!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: [warm laugh] I am so glad we could sort it out before that! And Mr. Menon, because of the prolonged outage and the missed alert, I would like to apply a one-day service credit to your account. Would that be all right?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Oh my goodness! A credit also? Priya ji, you are too kind, honestly. Yes, yes, of course that is all right! [warm laugh] You have made my whole day, I am telling you.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: It's the least we can do, Mr. Menon. The credit will reflect on your next billing cycle. I'm also enabling enhanced monitoring on your line for the next seventy-two hours so we catch any recurrence immediately.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Wonderful, wonderful! You know, I was so frustrated in the beginning, I was ready to complain to TRAI only. But now I must say — this is very professional service. You have handled everything so well, Priya ji.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: That genuinely means a lot, Mr. Menon. Your patience through the troubleshooting steps was really appreciated on our end as well. Is there anything else at all I can help you with today?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: No, no, everything is perfect now. My Teams call is already connected — full HD video, no lag at all! [warm laugh] My colleagues must be wondering what happened to me!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: [warm laugh] Go join your call, Mr. Menon! You've earned it. A summary SMS and the credit confirmation will be sent to your registered number shortly.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Thank you SO much, Priya ji. And please also thank that Suresh engineer also for fixing it so fast, na. Both of you deserve a gold medal today! [warm laugh] God bless!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: [warm laugh] I will absolutely pass that on to Suresh, he will be very happy to hear it! Thank you for being such a wonderful customer, Mr. Menon. You have a fantastic rest of your day. Take care!

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: You too, you too! Bye-bye, Priya ji! [warm laugh] Bye!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Thank you for calling Apex Retail support. My name is Sneha. May I have your name and order ID?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Yes, hello. Vikram Sen here. Order number AX-88219. I am waiting since morning itself at home for this delivery.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Thank you, Mr. Sen. I see an order for a laptop power adapter with same-day express shipping.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Correct. Guaranteed delivery promised before five PM. It is six-thirty now, and your app suddenly shows 'Customer unavailable, door locked'.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I see the delivery attempt scan logged at five-forty-two PM by our courier partner.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [scoff] That is completely bogus. I took leave and I'm sitting at home only. Nobody rang the bell.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Understood. Let me confirm the address on file. Flat 402, Green Glen Layout, Bellandur?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Yes, that address only. Gate security is there twenty-four hours. If any delivery boy entered, they would call intercom, no?

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Right. And the driver didn't dial your registered mobile ending in four-nine-one-eight?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Not a single ring on my phone. He simply sat somewhere and marked customer unavailable to meet his evening quota.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I apologize, Mr. Sen. Sometimes drivers mark status prematurely when running behind schedule or—

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [angry scoff] --Don't make excuses! Why charge three hundred rupees extra for express delivery then?

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: You are right, sir. Please allow me two minutes to contact the regional hub dispatch directly. May I place you on hold?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [heavy sigh] Fine, do that. Please check properly what this fellow is actually doing.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Thank you for waiting, Mr. Sen. I spoke with the supervisor at the Marathahalli logistics hub.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: So? Is he sending the driver back?

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Unfortunately, the van already returned to the depot, and all field personnel have checked out.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [tired laugh] Wonderful. Checked out. So he lied on the portal, went home, and you can do nothing.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I have logged a strict escalation ticket against the courier partner for this false scan.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [sigh] What will I do with a ticket? My laptop is dead, and tomorrow morning I have a client presentation.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I understand. I checked for morning re-dispatch, but tomorrow is a public holiday; hub operations are suspended.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Public holiday? [dry chuckle] So you took my money, promised today, and now simply failed.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: The route was scheduled for today, sir. It is entirely our failure that the carrier did not deliver.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [long slow sigh] I knew it. Every single time, same story only.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: The earliest guaranteed delivery slot is Monday between ten AM and one PM.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Monday. [cold scoff] Monday my client presentation will be over. Tell me, should I show my client blank slides on Monday?

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I have already processed a full refund of your three hundred rupee express delivery fee.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Three hundred rupees refund. [tired scoff] Wow. That really solves my entire crisis. Fantastic.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Would you like to cancel the shipment for a full item refund, or keep it active for Monday?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [monotone sigh] Do whatever you want. Keep it, cancel it. I don't care anymore.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I am deeply sorry for this breakdown, Mr. Sen. I will cancel the order and issue a full refund.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [flat exhale] Yeah. Whatever. [hangs up]

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Welcome to ShopSphere e-commerce support. I'm David. May I have your order number?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Hello David. My order number is eight-eight-three-two-one, lah. I got an email saying it's cancelled?

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Thank you. [typing] For verification, could you confirm the email address associated with the purchase?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: It's kelvin.tan at gmail dot com. I didn't cancel it, leh. Why like that?

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Thanks, Kelvin. I see the order for the office chair. It seems our system flagged the payment for manual review, and then auto-cancelled it.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [sigh] Flagged for what? I used my usual card, you know? Never had this issue.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I understand. Our automated security filters can be overly sensitive. May I place you on a brief hold while I consult our billing department?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Okay, can. But please be quick, later the chair out of stock then how?

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I will be fast. Please hold for just a minute.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [mutters] Always so troublesome...

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: [typing] Thank you for waiting. I spoke with billing. The transaction is voided and can't be reversed from my end.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Aiyah! So I have to buy it all over again meh? The flash sale already over!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I know, so I escalated this to my supervisor. We can issue a direct invoice honoring that flash sale price, so you don't lose out.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Oh, that's good. Can you send it now?

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Yes, my manager authorized it. I'm generating a secure payment link for the chair right now.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Let me check my email. [pause] Ah, I see the ShopSphere invoice.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Perfect. Please click it and checkout. I'll stay on the line to confirm the new order won't be flagged.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [typing] Okay, putting in the OTP now... Done already. You see it?

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: [typing] Yes, it went through. Your new order number is eight-eight-three-four-five, marked for immediate processing.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Alright, noted down. Thanks for sorting this out.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: You're welcome, Kelvin. Glad we kept your discount. Anything else you need today?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: No, that's all. Have a good day.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Welcome to Tech Support. This is David. How can I help you today?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Hello David! My phone email is not syncing since morning. Can you help me check?

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Absolutely! I see your account here. Let me push a quick manual sync from our server.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Oh, that is so fast! Let me refresh my phone app now.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Take your time. You should see the new emails populating shortly.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Ah, [warm laugh] IT WORKS! All my important emails are flooding in right now. I am so happy!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I'm delighted to hear that! Is there anything else you need help with?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: No, no, you are a lifesaver, David! Thank you very much. Have a wonderful day!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: You too! Thanks for calling support.

fine_grained_emotion: ecstatic delight, effusive gratitude, warm laughter

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [anxious exhale] Aiyo, my whole internet just go down lah — nothing work at all since this morning!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I can see the signal drop on our end. Let me push a remote reset to your line right now.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [hopeful pause] Okay, okay — I wait lah.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Reset is done. Can you check your router lights now?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [gasp of joy] WAH — the blue light is back! Internet is working lah!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Wonderful! Signal is now fully stable on your line.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [warm laugh] So fast one! You are really AMAZING lah, seriously — best support I ever get!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: So glad we sorted it out for you. Don't hesitate to call back anytime.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [joyful exhale] Thank you SO MUCH — really make my day lah! Bye-bye!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Apex Bank support, how can I help?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [scoff] YOUR APP CANNOT LOGIN AGAIN LAH!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Sorry, could you try clearing the cache—

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [angry gasp] CACHE WHAT LEH? I NEED MY MONEY!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Sir, let me verify your account—

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [scoff] STILL FAILED MEH? USELESS BANK!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: The server is currently experiencing—

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [shouting] GET YOUR MANAGER NOW OR I CLOSE ACCOUNT LAH!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Good afternoon, thank you for calling GlobalCart Support. My name is Sarah. How can I help today?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Hello, Sarah. [sigh] Calling about a return pickup. The courier no-show yesterday.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I am very sorry the courier missed the scheduled pickup. Let me pull up your account and get this fixed for you. Could you please provide your return reference number?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Yes, it is R-T-N, eight eight two, four one nine.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Thank you. To ensure I'm speaking with the account holder, please confirm your email and phone number.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Email is wei dot chen at hotmail dot com. Phone is zero four, one two, three three, four five.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Perfect, thank you Mr. Chen. The pickup was scheduled for yesterday between two and six PM.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Correct. I wait at home all afternoon, but nobody come. No phone call also. Quite inconvenient.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I completely understand your frustration. Checking the driver's log... [typing] It says the address was marked as inaccessible.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Inaccessible? Very strange. I live in normal apartment building. The front gate is always open during the day.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: That is odd. Sometimes drivers struggle with newer developments. May I place you on brief hold while I call dispatch?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Yes, you can put me on hold. I will wait to see what happened. [clear throat]

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Thank you for your patience, Mr. Chen. [hold music] I just spoke directly with our dispatch team. The driver reported that his navigation system routed him to a service alley behind the complex instead of the main entrance.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Ah, I see. Yes, the GPS always wrong here. They must turn in from the main road, not small lane.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: That explains it. I am adding a note for the driver right now. Is there a clear landmark near the entrance?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Yes, there is a big Sunshine Supermarket right on the corner. Tell them park near the supermarket entrance, and then just walk straight along the path to building B.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Very helpful. I have updated the instructions. Now, we need to reschedule. Would tomorrow afternoon work?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Tomorrow afternoon I have a meeting. Is it possible for them to come today? I want to return fast.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Let me quickly check the current availability for today's routes in your specific area. [typing] Please give me just one moment to see if we can still squeeze you in.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Okay, please check.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Thanks for holding. Unfortunately, all routes for your district are fully dispatched today. The earliest is tomorrow.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: I see. Then tomorrow morning please. Between nine and twelve is okay, because I work from home.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I can certainly arrange that for you. I have successfully locked in the nine AM to twelve noon pickup window for tomorrow morning.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Good. But this time they must call me. Last time no one call, very waste of time.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Absolutely. I marked it mandatory for the driver to call you thirty minutes before they arrive.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Okay, thank you. I will keep my phone with me, so I can answer.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Perfect. Just to confirm, the phone number ending in four five is the best one to reach you?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Yes, correct number. Do I need a new reference number for tomorrow?

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: No, your reference number remains exactly the same. However, I will send you a new confirmation email shortly with the updated pickup time and the new driver instructions.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Okay, I will check my email later.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Is there anything else regarding this return I can help you with today?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: No, that is all. [warm laugh] Thank you for fixing the issue.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: It was my pleasure. Thank you for your patience.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Thank you. Have a good day.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: You have a wonderful day as well. Goodbye.

fine_grained_emotion: ecstatic delight, effusive gratitude, warm laughter

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [anxious] Hello, my software licence — it expired yesterday only, na, and I am not able to open even a single file!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I understand, let me pull up your account right away. One moment please.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Yes-yes, please, it is very urgent only. My whole project is stuck!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Got it. I've pushed a 30-day renewal to your registered email. Try logging out and back in.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [gasp] Arre, it is working! [warm laugh] Oh my goodness, so fast only!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Wonderful! You should be fully up and running now.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [warm laugh] You are simply BRILLIANT, yaar! I was so worried and you sorted it in two minutes itself — THANK YOU so much, God bless you!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Apex Retail support, Jason speaking. May I have your order ID and name, please?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [sigh] Marcus Tan here, order ORD-77402-SG. Check quickly lah, I've waited very long already.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Thank you, Mr. Tan. I see your sixteen-piece porcelain dining set. How can I help today?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Help? Alamak, box arrived an hour ago, and WALAU EH, everything inside totally smashed to powder lah! Zero plates survived!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I'm terribly sorry, Mr. Tan. Did the outer carton arrive with obvious crushing or tears?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [scoff] Totally caved in lah! Courier just dumped it and fled. No fragile label at all. How can like that?

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I see. To process this claim, please upload five photos of the damage to your portal.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Hello, I uploaded six clear photos half an hour ago leh! Open your system and see lah, don't ask silly things.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Understood, I see them now. Please hold briefly while I check with logistics about an immediate replacement.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [heavy sigh] Hurry up lor. I need this dining set for my housewarming this Saturday.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Thanks for waiting, Mr. Tan. Our claims team states this third-party seller didn't buy fragile insurance, so we cannot issue a replacement.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [angry gasp] What talk is this?! I bought from your platform! Why should I care about seller insurance, hah?!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Per policy, sir, you must pack all broken shards, pay return postage to Shenzhen, and wait twenty days for inspection—

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [scoff] ARE YOU CRAZY?! YOU WANT ME TO PACK SHARP GLASS AND PAY POSTAGE FOR YOUR FAULT?!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Sir, please calm down. That is standard procedure before any refund can be released.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: CALM DOWN?! YOU SEND BROKEN JUNK AND WANT ME TO SHUT UP LAH?! REFUND MY CREDIT CARD RIGHT NOW!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I cannot bypass the return protocol, sir. If you don't return the item, the claim closes automatically.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: AUTOMATICALLY CLOSES?! YOU DARE THREATEN ME MEH?! TRANSFER ME TO YOUR MANAGER RIGHT NOW! DON'T WASTE TIME LAH!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Supervisors are busy, Mr. Tan. I can only schedule a callback within forty-eight hours.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: FORTY-EIGHT HOURS?! MY EVENT IS SATURDAY! I AM REPORTING THIS FRAUD TO CASE AND POLICE TODAY!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Your notes are logged, sir. Without returning the parcel, nothing more can be done today. Is there anything else—

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [snort] ANYTHING ELSE?! SHUT UP LAH! I'M DISPUTING THIS CHARGE WITH DBS BANK NOW! YOU CHEATS! [slam]

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Welcome to DBS Bank, my name is Sarah. How can I assist you with your credit limit today?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Wah, Sarah, I just check my app! The limit increase approved so fast, I really didn't expect it leh! [warm laugh]

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: [warm laugh] I'm so glad to hear that, Mr. Tan. Yes, we processed your request immediately for your upcoming holiday.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: You all are the BEST lah! Seriously, usually these things take so long, but boom, it's there! Thank you so much!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: You're very welcome! We always strive to provide the best service. Is there anything else you need help with?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: No need already! You made my day, okay? I go book my flights now, WOOHOO! Have a wonderful day, Sarah!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Enjoy your vacation, Mr. Tan! Goodbye and thank you for banking with us.

fine_grained_emotion: ecstatic delight, effusive praise, warm laughter, genuine gratitude

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Hello, good afternoon! I wanted to check about a late fee that appeared on my account lah — I think there may have been a mix-up with my payment date.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Good afternoon! Happy to look into that for you. Could I get your account number and verify your identity first?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Yes of course! Account ending 7-7-4-2. The fee was charged on the fourteenth, but I already made the payment on the thirteenth leh — one day before the due date!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I can see your account now. You're right — the payment timestamp shows it cleared at 11:58 PM on the thirteenth. That's within the window. The fee was applied in error.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Oh really meh? So you can see it there already? Wah, that is such a relief lah!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Absolutely. I'm reversing the thirty-dollar late fee right now — it will reflect in your account within one business day. I'm also noting this on your record so it doesn't recur.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [warm laugh] Aiyo, you settle so fast one! I was a bit nervous to call, you know, but you made everything so simple lah. Really appreciate it!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: It's truly my pleasure — you did everything right on your end. Is there anything else I can help you with today?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [warm laugh] No no, that's all I needed! Honestly, this is the best customer service I've had in a long time lah. You are very good, thank you so much!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Thank you so much — that really means a lot! You have a wonderful afternoon. Goodbye!

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Hello madam, I noticed an unrecognised charge of four thousand rupees on my card just now only. Kindly check, please?

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Checking that right away, sir. Ah, good news! Our fraud shield caught that suspicious merchant and blocked the payment automatically.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [delighted gasp] Arre, REALLY? [warm laugh] WHAT A RELIEF! You stopped it already? That is simply BRILLIANT service, madam!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Yes sir! The transaction is fully cancelled, your funds are safe, and I have updated your security preferences.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [warm laugh] SUPERB! You resolved it in two minutes itself! I am SO GRATEFUL, honestly! THANK YOU SO MUCH!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: You are most welcome, sir! Have a truly wonderful day ahead!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Tech support, how can I help?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [scoff] WHY MY WIFI DEAD AGAIN LAH?!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I'm sorry, please let me—

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: LET YOU WHAT MEH?! FIVE HOURS ALREADY!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Sir, there is a local node outage—

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: I PAY SO MUCH FOR THIS LEH?!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Our team is trying to fix—

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [angry gasp] CANCEL MY PLAN! GET YOUR MANAGER NOW!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Thank you for calling ShopSwift customer support, my name is Daniel, how can I assist you today?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Yes, hi. I want to check on my refund. I already wait very long already, so I hope this can be settle quickly.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Of course, I completely understand. I'd be happy to look into that for you. May I have your full name and the email address linked to your account?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: My name is Wei Liang Chen. Email is weiliang dot chen at gmail dot com.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Thank you, Mr. Chen. And for verification purposes, could you confirm the last four digits of the payment method used on that order?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: It's 8847. The order number is SS-209944-B. I already have everything ready, I been calling about this same thing for two weeks already lah.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I appreciate your patience, Mr. Chen, and I sincerely apologize for the inconvenience. Let me pull up your account now... okay, I can see order SS-209944-B here. It shows a return was initiated on September the eighth. Is that the refund you're referring to?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Yes, that one. September eighth. Today already September twenty-fifth leh. Seventeen days. The website say five to seven business days. So what happen?

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: You're absolutely right, and that is well beyond our standard processing window. I can see the refund was approved on our end on September tenth, but it appears there may have been a delay at the payment processing stage. Let me check the transaction notes more carefully—

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [sigh] Every time I call, the agent say the same thing — 'let me check the notes.' Then what? Nothing happen.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I hear you, Mr. Chen, and I'm sorry you've had to repeat yourself. I can see two previous case notes here from September fifteenth and September nineteenth. It looks like both times the refund was flagged for a secondary review by our finance team. I want to escalate this directly for you right now.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Secondary review for what? I already send back the item. The tracking show delivered to your warehouse September fifth. Three days before I even submit the return request. So what is there to review, meh?

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: That is a very valid point, and I completely agree — the item was received before the return was even logged. That should not have triggered a secondary hold. I'm going to place you on a brief hold, perhaps two to three minutes, while I contact our finance escalation team directly. Is that okay?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [flat tone] Sure. Go ahead. I've been waiting seventeen days, few more minutes no difference already.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: [hold music implied — system note: 4-minute hold] Mr. Chen, thank you so very much for your patience. I was able to reach our finance team, and they've confirmed that your refund was stuck in a batch processing error that affected a small number of accounts. They've manually released it just now.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Okay. So when will the money actually reach my bank? Because last time the agent also say it's released, and then I check three days later — nothing.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Totally understandable concern. The finance team is saying the standard timeframe from a manual release is three to five business days for it to reflect in your account.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [scoff] Three to five business days. So now I have to wait again. [flat] You know, your website say five to seven days the first time. Then it became seventeen days. Now you want me to add another five days on top. That's very nice lah.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I completely understand your frustration, Mr. Chen, and I'm truly sorry. I know this has been an extremely poor experience. I want to assure you that the release has been confirmed and—

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Can you give me something in writing? Like email confirmation that the refund is now released? Because every agent 'assure' me, but no proof.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: That's a completely reasonable request. Let me try to send you a case update email right now from my end... [pause] Hmm, I'm seeing that the email notification system is actually managed by a different department, and I'm not able to trigger a custom release confirmation directly from my interface. What I can do is add a high-priority note to your case and request that team to—

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [long sigh] So you cannot send the email yourself.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Not directly, no, but I can escalate it as—

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: And if I check my account in five days and the refund still not there, I call again, and some other agent will say 'let me check the notes' again, right? That's how it work lah.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I assure you that won't happen, Mr. Chen. I've flagged this case as a priority escalation. If you don't see the refund by October second, you're welcome to call back and reference case number ESC-77412, and—

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [monotone] ESC-77412. Okay. I write it down. [pause] You know, I bought from ShopSwift because my friend recommend. Spend nearly three hundred dollars. Now I just want my money back and it's like I'm asking for something very difficult. Very good service lah.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I hear you, and I am genuinely sorry, Mr. Chen. Your feedback is important to us and I'll be sure to log this experience. Is there anything else I can help you with today?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [flat, barely engaged] No. Nothing else you can help. I just... wait again lor. Thank you.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Thank you for your patience and for calling ShopSwift, Mr. Chen. We truly value your—

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [call disconnects mid-sentence — customer hangs up]

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Swift Fiber support, David speaking. How may I help you today?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [weary sigh] Your technician was supposed to come for installation between ten and one today itself. It's four PM already.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I do apologize for the delay, sir. Let me check the technician's route to see—

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [flat scoff] Don't bother. I took leave from office and sat idle waiting only.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I completely understand. I can reschedule you for tomorrow morning's first slot?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [heavy sigh] Tomorrow also no one will come, na? Just leave it. I don't even care anymore.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Hello?! WHY MY PROMO CODE 'RAYA50' CANNOT USE? [angry scoff] I key in, it say invalid! You all scammer is it?!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I apologize, sir. Let me quickly check the promo terms—

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: CHECK WHAT CHECK LAH! [shouting] I ALREADY SPEND TWO THOUSAND RINGGIT! It's supposed to give fifty percent off, wei!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Sir, that code is capped at ten Ringgit and expired yesterday.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: EXPIRED? [loud sigh] I JUST SAW THE AD THIS MORNING! This is cheating! Give me your manager NOW!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: The manager cannot override expired vouchers, sir.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: CANCEL MY WHOLE ORDER LAH! I am deleting your stupid app and reporting you! [angry gasp]

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [sigh] Yeah, my router keeps dropping the 5GHz band every few hours lah. Already reset three times already.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I understand, sir. Let's start by logging into the admin panel. Can you type 192.168.1.1 into your browser and—

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [flat interruption] Done liao. Already inside.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Great! Now navigate to Wireless Settings, then Advanced, and change the channel width from Auto to 80MHz only.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [monotone] There's no Advanced tab leh. Just Basic and Security. Very standard one, meh.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Ah, different firmware versions may have different layouts. Could you check which firmware version your router is running?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [quiet scoff] So you're saying you don't know where the setting is lor. Okay, I'll go find myself.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: No no, sir, I'm still here to help. Let me escalate this to our Level Two—

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [long sigh] Forget it lah. Every time same thing. I'll just buy a new router.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Terima kasih for calling Celco Mobile Malaysia. My name is Jason. How may I assist you with your account today?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Hello Jason, [anxious sigh] aiyo, I got a terrible shock when I opened my bill this morning lah! It's so high!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I understand your concern, sir. Let me look into this right away. May I have your full name and account number?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Yes, Farid bin Kamaruddin. My mobile number is zero-one-two, four-eight-eight, nine-nine-one-two. Account is eight-eight-three-one-zero-four.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Thank you Mr. Farid. Authentication is successful. Can you walk me through the specific discrepancy you noticed on this month's statement?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Normally my commitment plan is only ninety-eight ringgit. But suddenly the total amount due is FOUR HUNDRED AND EIGHTY RINGGIT lah!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: That is indeed a substantial difference, Mr. Farid. Pulling up your itemized ledger now. I see an extra charge of three hundred eighty ringgit.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Yes! It says 'Asean Roaming Five-Day Unlimited Thailand'. But hello, I never go Thailand leh! I was only holidaying in Desaru, Johor!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Understood. Let me examine the international network handover records between June twelfth and fourteenth to see where the signal originated.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Alamak, how can the tower simply charge me like that? I never turn on data roaming also. Very unfair kan?

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Looking at the network logs, our regional automated billing gateway mistakenly flagged an offshore maritime signal bounce as an international roaming subscription.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Aiyo, system fault lah tu! Please Jason, you must help me reverse this. My family grocery budget is affected leh.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I certainly will. May I place you on a brief two-minute hold while I access the manual billing override ledger?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Okay can, I will hold. Please settle it properly ah Jason, don't drop my line ya.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: [clears throat] Thank you for waiting, Mr. Farid. We encountered a complication: the monthly billing cycle closed at midnight, locking regular dispute waivers.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [gasp] ALAMAK! Locked?! You mean I must pay four hundred eighty ringgit first meh? Jason, cannot like that lah! I cannot afford!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Please do not worry, Mr. Farid. I will not let you pay that. I am initiating an emergency direct administrative tier-two escalation.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [trembling sigh] Okay okay... please try your best Jason. I really trust you on this one ya.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Hold on for just thirty seconds while I get the direct override key from our duty finance manager on the internal terminal.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Ya ya, take your time. I am praying here bro.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Fantastic news, Mr. Farid! Finance validated the maritime signal glitch and approved the total three-hundred-eighty-ringgit cancellation immediately!

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [gasp] Betul ke Jason?! [relieved chuckle] Really cleared off the bill completely?

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Completely zeroed out. Even better, to apologize for the stress, we applied a fifty-ringgit goodwill rebate and three months free unlimited 5G!

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [ecstatic laugh] WAH! ARE YOU SERIOUS JASON?! [warm laughter] Ya Allah, you are an absolute angel lah! Fifty ringgit rebate some more?!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: [warm chuckle] Yes sir, so your net bill due this month is only forty-eight ringgit instead of ninety-eight! Fully updated in our database.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: BRO! YOU ARE THE BEST LAH! [joyful laughter] I was sweating so bad just now! You resolved everything so fast and steady!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I am truly delighted to help, Mr. Farid. I have just dispatched the revised invoice summary to your registered WhatsApp and email.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [warm laugh] Got it already! Ding sound just came! TERIMA KASIH BANYAK-BANYAK Jason! You deserve five-star rating and promotion, confirm one hundred percent!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: You are most welcome, Mr. Farid! Thank you for your wonderful patience and kindness. Have a fabulous weekend ahead in Desaru!

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [delighted chuckle] You too Jason! Take care and God bless you brother! Jumpa lagi, bye-bye!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Thank you for calling Horizon Telecom. My name is David. How can I assist you today?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Hello, David. [pause] I am calling to check on some roaming charges on my recent bill, lah.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I can certainly help you look into that. Could I please have your mobile number and your full name?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Yes, my number is 0-1-2, 5-5-5, 4-3-2-1. [pause] And my name is Ahmad bin Yusof.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Thank you, Mr. Ahmad. Just for security, can you verify your date of birth, please?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: It is the 12th of August, 1985.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: [typing] Excellent, thank you. I have your account pulled up. You mentioned some roaming charges?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Yes, correct. I went to Indonesia last month for a short business trip.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Okay, let me pull up the billing statement for last month. [typing] Please give me a moment.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Sure, take your time.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I see the charges here. There is a 150 ringgit charge for international roaming data.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Ah, I see. But I thought I purchased the ASEAN roaming pass before I flew, kan?

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Let me check your purchase history. Do you happen to remember the exact date you activated the pass?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [pause] I think it was on the 14th of October, right before my flight.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Let me put you on a brief hold while I check the activation logs for that date.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Okay, no problem. I will wait.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Thank you for holding, Mr. Ahmad. I checked the logs, and the activation attempt failed due to a system timeout.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Oh, is that so? [pause] I didn't receive any SMS saying it failed, leh.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I apologize for the lack of notification. Since it was our system's error, I will escalate this to billing to reverse the 150 ringgit charge.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: That would be good. Will it be credited back to this current bill?

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Let me confirm with the billing supervisor. Please hold for just another minute.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Alright, standing by.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Thank you for your patience. The supervisor has approved the reversal. It will reflect on your account within 24 hours.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Okay, understood. So I just pay the normal amount without the roaming charge, right?

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: That is correct. Your new balance due will be 85 ringgit.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Very well. Thank you for sorting this out, David.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: You are very welcome, Mr. Ahmad. Is there anything else regarding your account I can assist with?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: No, that is all for today. Thank you again.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Have a wonderful day ahead, and thank you for choosing Horizon Telecom. Goodbye.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Goodbye.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Thank you for calling NetLine support, how can I assist you today?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [angry gasp] How can you assist? MY INTERNET IS CRAWLING LAH! Three megabits only — I pay for five hundred! This is daylight robbery, meh?

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I understand your frustration, sir. Let me just run a line diagnostic and—

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [shouts over engineer] NO MORE DIAGNOSTIC! EVERY TIME DIAGNOSTIC, NOTHING CHANGE LAH! I WANT MANAGER NOW. You people waste my whole morning already!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Sir, a manager may take a few minutes to connect. While you wait, if I could just—

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [scoff] A FEW MINUTES? I CANCEL THIS CONTRACT TODAY, you hear me or not? Completely useless service leh!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Apex Bank, Sarah speaking. How can I help you today?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [heavy sigh] My FAST transfer has been stuck on pending since nine this morning, leh.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I see the transaction. Our clearing gateway needs up to three working days to—

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [scoff] Three days? What three days, FAST transfer is supposed to be instant what.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: The batch system had a timeout, so manual reconciliation is required, sir.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [flat chuckle] Wonderful lah. So my rent money is just floating nowhere, right?

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I apologize for the delay. We can log an expedited trace for you.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [tired sigh] Never mind lah. Trace also no use one. Whatever lor, bye.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Welcome to Telecom support. My name is Alex, how can I assist you?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Hello Alex. I am trying to port my number, but it is showing as failed since yesterday.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: [typing] Let's look into that. Could you provide the mobile number?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Yes, it is 555-0198. I submitted the request last evening itself.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Thank you. Checking... The system indicates the porting PIN was incorrect.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [clears throat] I see. I have the correct PIN now. Can we update it today itself?

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Certainly. Please share the correct PIN and I'll re-submit your request.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: It is 4-8-2-6. Kindly do the needful.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: [typing] I've updated it. Your porting will successfully complete within two hours.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: That is perfectly fine. Thank you for your help.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [sigh] My laptop cannot start lah. Press the power button, nothing happen one.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I understand, sir! Let's troubleshoot together. Can you check if the charging light is—

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [scoff] No light leh. No sound. Nothing. I already check meh.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Okay, try holding the power button for thirty seconds, then—

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [heavy sigh] Same thing lah. You think I never try already ah.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I'm sorry to hear that, sir. We may need to escalate this to our senior—

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [flat monotone] Nevermind lah. Waste time one. I just go buy new laptop.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Telecom Support. Did your fiber router reconnect, sir?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [joyful gasp] Arre, YES! The PON light became green now only!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Wonderful. I just cleared the line attenuation remotely.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [warm laugh] SUPERB, yaar! My office portal opened instantly!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Are your download speeds normal now?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Rocket speed itself! You saved my client meeting today!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Glad to resolve it. Anything else, sir?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [excited chuckle] Nothing at all! THANK YOU so much, truly!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Welcome to GlobalTech Mart Customer Service. My name is Sarah. How can I help you today?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Yes, hello. I am calling about a refund. It has been over one month, and I still do not receive my money. This is very ridiculous.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I'm sorry to hear about the delay with your refund. I can certainly look into that for you. May I have your order number, please?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: The order number is eight eight three, nine one two, four four. I returned a laptop. It was very expensive, you know.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Thank you. Let me just pull up your account. [keyboard typing] Okay, I see the return for the Asus Zenbook. For security, can you verify the email address?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [sigh] It is j-dot-chen-eighty-eight at mail-dot-com. I already verify this three times last week with other agents.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I understand your frustration. Thank you for confirming. I see the return was delivered to our warehouse on August second.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Exactly. August second. And today is late September. Your policy say refund takes five to seven business days. So, where is my money?

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Let me check the payment gateway status. [keyboard typing] It looks like the refund was initiated on our end, but there seems to be a hold from the banking side.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [scoff] Banking side? I call my bank yesterday. They say they have no record of any incoming refund. They say the problem is from your company.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: That's unusual. Sometimes cross-border transactions take longer, but not this long. Let me place you on a brief hold while I contact our finance department.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Fine. But please do not just disconnect me. Every time I wait, the line suddenly go dead.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I promise I'll be right back. It will just take about two to three minutes. Please stay on the line.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [heavy sigh] Okay, I am waiting.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: [hold music fades] Thank you for your patience. I spoke with the finance team, and they mentioned the transaction was flagged due to a currency conversion error on the payment processor's end.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Currency conversion error? What does that even mean? I pay in local currency. Just reverse the transaction. Why is this so difficult?

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Because the payment processor handles the routing, they have to manually clear the block. The finance team is submitting a manual release request right now.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [flatly] Submitting a request. And how many more weeks will this request take? Another month?

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: They advised it could take an additional ten to fourteen business days for the manual request to be fully processed...

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Another fourteen days? [cold laugh] ARE YOU KIDDING ME? This is almost two thousand dollars. You are basically holding my money hostage.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I completely understand this is a major inconvenience. I can escalate this to a supervisor to see if we can expedite it, but I can't guarantee a faster timeline.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [heavy sigh] Escalate to supervisor. Yes, I hear this before. The supervisor will just read from the exact same script you are reading from.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: The supervisor might have a direct line to the processor. Would you like me to transfer you, or have them call you back?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [hopeless monotone] You know what? Whatever. Just leave it. Send the ticket, make the request, whatever. I am so tired of this. Keep the money if it is so hard to return it.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I have submitted the high-priority ticket, Mr. Chen. You'll receive an email confirmation shortly. I am very sorry for this experience.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Yeah, sure. Do whatever you want. Just... goodbye.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Thank you for calling ShopNest customer support. My name is Priya. How may I assist you today?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Hello, yes, good afternoon. My name is Rajesh Venkataraman. I am calling because I received a wrong item in my delivery.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I am sorry to hear that, Mr. Venkataraman. Let me pull up your account right away. Could you please provide me your registered email address or your order number?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Yes, my email is rajesh dot venkataraman at gmail dot com. And the order number is SN-dash-4-4-7-8-8-2.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Thank you. I can see your account here. Just to verify, is the registered mobile number ending in 9-3-4-1 correct?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Yes, that is correct.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Perfect. Thank you for confirming, Mr. Venkataraman. I can see order SN-447882 was delivered yesterday. Can you describe the issue with your delivery?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Yes, so I had ordered a blue Lenovo wireless keyboard, the K-200 model. But what I received inside the box is a mouse. A wired mouse. Not even the same brand. So something has clearly gone wrong at the warehouse level.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I understand completely, and I apologize for the inconvenience. That is certainly not the experience we want for our customers. Let me check the order details and the fulfillment records for that shipment.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Please, yes. I need this resolved because I actually needed that keyboard for my work setup. I have been managing without it since yesterday.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I completely understand, Mr. Venkataraman. [brief pause] I can see the item was dispatched from our Bengaluru fulfillment center. Could you confirm — is the outer packaging sealed, or was it opened when it arrived?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: The outer packaging was sealed with the ShopNest tape. I opened it myself. Inside, there was the product box, but when I opened the product box, the item inside was the wrong one. So the mix-up happened before packing, I think.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: That is very helpful information, thank you. This does suggest a fulfillment error. I am going to initiate a return and replacement request for you right away. Mr. Venkataraman, could you please hold for two to three minutes while I raise the ticket?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Yes, sure. Go ahead.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: [hold music implied] Thank you for your patience, Mr. Venkataraman. I am back. So I have raised a return request, ticket number RT-dash-9-9-2-1-4. However, I am seeing a flag on the system here. Because the item delivered is categorically different — a mouse versus a keyboard — our standard wrong-item replacement flow is routing this to our fulfillment disputes team for manual review.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [mild sigh] Manual review. How long would that take, approximately?

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Typically it takes twenty-four to forty-eight business hours for the disputes team to verify and approve. After that, the replacement would be dispatched.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: That is quite a long time. I placed this order six days ago. I waited for the delivery, and now I am being told to wait another two days just for approval? This is not very convenient, honestly.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I fully understand your frustration, Mr. Venkataraman, and that concern is valid. Let me see if I can escalate the priority of this ticket or find a faster resolution path for you. Could you please hold for another moment?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [sigh] Alright, I will hold.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: [hold music implied] Thank you so much for your patience. I spoke with my supervisor and we have been able to mark this as a high-priority fulfillment error. The review window has been reduced to four to six business hours. Additionally, I can initiate the replacement dispatch preemptively, subject to the review outcome.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Okay, that sounds better. So the replacement will be sent out within today or tomorrow?

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Yes, if the review is completed within the six-hour window — which it should be given the priority flag — your replacement Lenovo K-200 keyboard in blue will be dispatched by end of business today, and you should receive it within two to three working days.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Alright. And what about the wrong item — the mouse — that I have here? What do I do with it?

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Our courier will collect it when they deliver the replacement. You do not need to arrange anything separately. Just keep it in the original packaging if possible. The collection is free of charge for you.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Okay, good. And I will get a confirmation email with all of this — the ticket number, the replacement details?

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Absolutely. I am sending you a confirmation email right now to your registered address. It will include the return ticket RT-99214, the replacement order reference, and the expected delivery window. You should receive it within the next five minutes.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Fine. One more thing — is there any way to get some sort of compensation for this inconvenience? I had to call in, wait on hold, and I still need to wait a few more days.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: That is a fair ask. As a goodwill gesture, I am adding a voucher of two hundred and fifty rupees to your ShopNest wallet. It will be credited within twenty-four hours and has no expiry for six months. I hope that helps, Mr. Venkataraman.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Alright, that is appreciated. Thank you for that.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Of course. Is there anything else I can assist you with regarding this order or any other matter?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: No, I think that covers everything. Just please make sure the replacement goes out on time. That is all I need.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: You have my word on it, Mr. Venkataraman. I have personally flagged this with our fulfillment team. Your reference number for today's call is CS-dash-7-7-3-5-0-1. You can use this if you need to follow up.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: CS-773501. Okay, I have noted it down.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Perfect. Thank you so much for your patience throughout this call, and I am sorry again for the trouble caused by the wrong delivery. We will make sure the correct item reaches you promptly.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Okay, thank you. I hope so. Goodbye.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Thank you for calling ShopNest, Mr. Venkataraman. Have a good evening. Goodbye.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Happy to help. If it happens again more frequently, it may be worth checking the battery health. Have a good day.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: No, that is all. Have a good day.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Ya, hurry up please. I paid extra fifty ringgit for guaranteed same-day delivery.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I see the order here for the portable projector. Scheduled window was two to five PM.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Exactly! Now already past six o'clock, kan? Nobody came, nobody called, completely ghosted!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I sincerely apologize for the delay. Did you receive any SMS notification from the courier?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Nothing at all lah! [scoff] I took half-day unpaid leave just to sit here waiting!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I completely understand your frustration. Let me check the real-time tracking notes on our system.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Check, check, see where this lazy driver went. How can treat customer like this?

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Looking at the manifest, it shows assigned to SwiftLogistics van four, driver name Nizam.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Okay, so call this Nizam now lah. Why he simply skip my house?

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I will contact the dispatch hub directly. May I place you on a brief hold?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [groan] Fine, but don't take ten years, okay? My event starts tonight!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Thank you for your patience, Mr. Farhan. I will be right back with an update.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Fast a bit lah, please.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Thank you for holding, Mr. Farhan. I have the dispatch team on the other line.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: So what happened? Is the van reaching my taman now or what?

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Mr. Farhan, I'm afraid the driver reported that your front gate was locked and unanswered.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [angry gasp] WHAT?! Are you crazy?! I have been sitting at the porch since two PM!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I understand this is upsetting, sir, but that is the note entered into the system.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [scoff] That driver is lying through his teeth lah! Alamak, nobody even came near my gate!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I apologize, sir. In these cases, the standard procedure is to reassign for tomorrow's cycle.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: TOMORROW?! NO WAY! I bought this projector for my mother's birthday dinner tonight, you understand?!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I genuinely apologize, but our evening dispatch window has already concluded for today.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: NOT MY PROBLEM! Send a Grab or dispatch a relief rider immediately! Solve it!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Our contract with third-party logistics does not permit external courier reimbursements—

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: DON'T GIVE ME RUBBISH EXCUSES! [shouting] YOU PROMISED SAME-DAY, I PAID FOR IT!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Sir, please calm down. I can issue a voucher for your shipping fee right now.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: A VOUCHER?! ARE YOU INSULTING ME?! KEEP YOUR PATHETIC VOUCHER, YOU HEAR ME?!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Mr. Farhan, I must ask you to refrain from shouting so we can proceed constructively.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: CONSTRUCTIVELY MY FOOT! YOU RUINED MY CELEBRATION, THEN YOU CALL ME A LIAR?!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Nobody is calling you a liar, sir. I am simply explaining our operational limitations tonight.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: OPERATIONAL LIMITATIONS?! TRANSFER ME TO YOUR MANAGER RIGHT NOW! THIS INSTANT!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: My supervisor is currently engaged on another escalation, but I can log a ticket—

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [slams desk] NO MORE TICKETS! I AM REPORTING YOUR FRAUD COMPANY TO TRIBUNAL CONSUMER AND POLICE! CANCEL MY ENTIRE MEMBERSHIP! USELESS INCOMPETENT FOOLS!

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [throat clear] Hello. My phone bill this month is very high. Can you check for me?

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I can help with that. What is your account number?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: It is eight-four-two-one. I think there is extra charge for international call, but I didn't make.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: [typing] Let me check. Ah, it was a system error. I have removed the extra charges.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Okay, that is good. The total is correct now?

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Yes, your new balance is forty-five dollars, effective immediately.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Thank you. I will pay it today. Bye.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Thank you for calling NovaTel customer support, my name is Priya, how may I assist you today?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [heavy sigh] Yes, hello. My name is Rajesh Nair and I am calling because my new SIM card is still not activated. It has been THREE days now. Three days, madam.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I'm really sorry to hear that, Mr. Nair. I completely understand how frustrating that must be. Could I please have your account number or the mobile number associated with the SIM card so I can pull up your account?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Yes, yes. The number is 9-8-8-3-0-5-7-1-2. And account ID is ACT-9847261. I already gave all this information last time also when I called. Why do I have to keep repeating myself, tell me?

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I sincerely apologize for the inconvenience, Mr. Nair. I'm pulling up your account right now. Could you also please verify the date of birth on the account for security purposes?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [scoff] Fine. It is 14th March, 1981. Please, just fix the SIM. I need it for work. My business calls are going on my personal number only and that is very problematic for me.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Thank you for verifying, Mr. Nair. I can see your account here. I can see that a SIM activation request was indeed raised three days ago. Let me check the current status on our backend system. Please bear with me for just a moment.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [sighs] Okay. I am bearing with you.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Mr. Nair, I can see that your SIM activation is showing a status of pending provisioning. It seems like the request got stuck in our system. What I'd like to do is manually trigger a re-provisioning request from my end. Would that be okay?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Okay, yes, please do that. Last agent also said the same thing and nothing happened. But okay, let us try again.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I completely understand your skepticism, Mr. Nair, and I assure you I am escalating this properly this time. I'm going to place you on a brief hold of about two minutes while I coordinate with our provisioning team directly. Is that alright?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Two minutes only, yes? Last time they put me on hold for fifteen minutes and then the call dropped. If that happens again I will be very angry, I am telling you.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I promise you, Mr. Nair, I will be back in two minutes. Please hold.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: [hold music ends] Mr. Nair, thank you so much for your patience. I spoke with our provisioning team and unfortunately they are saying that your SIM has a flag on it due to a KYC document mismatch. They need you to re-submit your identity proof through our app or nearest store before they can activate it.

turns.speaker: customer
