turns.text: [angry gasp] WHAT? KYC mismatch? I submitted my Aadhaar card at the store when I bought the SIM! They verified it right there in front of me! How is there a mis—

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Mr. Nair, I understand, I do—our system is showing that the store possibly uploaded an unclear scan of the document and it was rejected by the verification—

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: NO, NO, NO! You STOP right there! I went to your store, I stood in queue for FORTY-FIVE MINUTES, they took my document, they said everything is fine, ACTIVATED IN FOUR HOURS they told me. FOUR HOURS! And now three DAYS later you are telling me there is some scan problem? THIS IS YOUR STORE'S FAULT, NOT MINE!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Mr. Nair, please, I hear you, and you are absolutely right to be upset. I am going to flag this as a store error and request an urgent override. But sir, the system still requires a document re-upload as a mandatory step before—

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [bitter laugh] Override? OVERRIDE? Your system is a JOKE! Let me talk to your manager RIGHT NOW. I want your supervisor on this call immediately. I will not waste one more second talking to someone who cannot fix anything!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Sir, I completely understand. I am going to transfer you to my supervisor right away. Please give me just thirty seconds to—

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: THIRTY SECONDS! Fine! THIRTY SECONDS ONLY! And if the supervisor also cannot solve this today, I am CANCELLING my entire plan, ALL THREE connections I have with NovaTel, and I am going straight to the regulator! I WILL FILE A COMPLAINT!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Mr. Nair, I'm transferring you now. I have also added a priority note on your account so the supervisor can see the full history. I'm truly sorry for—

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [furious scoff] Sorry is not activating my SIM, is it! Go! Transfer! Quickly!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: [transfer hold tone plays] Please hold while I connect you to the supervisor.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [long angry exhale] Three days. THREE DAYS for a SIM card. I don't believe this. UNBELIEVABLE. [muttering] Every single time with these people... every single time.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Thank you for calling Apex Bank wire support. My name is David. How may I assist you?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [sigh] Yes, hello David. I have big problem. My fund transfer is completely stuck since Tuesday.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I am sorry to hear that, sir. I can look into this stuck transfer. May I have your name?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: My name is Wei Zhang. Z-H-A-N-G. Account number ending in five eight two one.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Thank you, Mr. Zhang. For security verification, could you confirm your registered billing zip code and date of birth?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Zip code nine four one zero seven. Date of birth is November fourteen, nineteen eighty.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Verification confirmed. Thank you. Could you provide the transaction reference number and the amount?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Reference is WT-nine zero four two. Amount is twenty-eight thousand five hundred dollars. Huge money for me!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Got it. Twenty-eight thousand five hundred. When exactly was this initiated, and was it domestic or international?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Tuesday morning at nine AM! Domestic wire to my equipment supplier. Your app says same day delivery!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I see. Let me pull up transaction WT-nine zero four two in our clearing database. One moment, please.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [scoff] Aiyah, you pull up fast, please. The supplier already threaten to cancel my factory machinery contract today!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I understand the urgency, Mr. Zhang. The status is currently marked as 'compliance review hold'.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [angry gasp] Compliance hold?! Why compliance hold?! Money already deduct from my checking account seventy-two hours ago!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Our automated risk filter flags high-value transfers exceeding ten thousand dollars for standard intermediary verification.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: I send wire to this supplier three times before! No problem before! Why suddenly hold my money without telling me?!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I apologize for the lack of notice. Let me place you on hold while I contact payment operations.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [groan] Fine! But don't take ten minutes. I am waiting right here.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: [clears throat] Thank you for holding, Mr. Zhang. I spoke with our senior payment operations specialist.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: So? You release the money already? Did the wire go through?!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Unfortunately, our backend batch queue experienced a data sync exception yesterday. The wire cannot be released automatically today.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: What?! What you mean cannot release?! You take my money, but you do not send it?!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: The funds are currently reserved in our settlement account. The tier-two clearing team must conduct a manual re-audit on Monday.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: MONDAY?! Today is Friday! You hold my twenty-eight thousand dollars for whole weekend?! Are you joking with me?!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I truly understand your frustration, sir, but our manual clearing protocols strictly dictate that we cannot bypass—

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: —DO NOT TELL ME ABOUT YOUR PROTOCOL! [slams desk] YOUR SYSTEM BREAK DOWN, AND MY BUSINESS PAYS THE PRICE?!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Sir, please lower your voice. Shouting will not expedite the processing of the batch file.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: LOWER MY VOICE?! YOU STEAL MY MONEY AND TELL ME TO LOWER VOICE?! I LOSE MY SUPPLIER CONTRACT TODAY!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I can file an expedited internal dispute ticket, but it still requires two business days for formal resolution.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: TWO DAYS?! NO! I DO NOT ACCEPT TICKET! CANCEL THIS WIRE AND RETURN EVERY CENT TO MY ACCOUNT RIGHT NOW!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Because the funds are locked in the settlement clearing pipeline, we cannot cancel or reverse the transaction until review concludes.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [furious shout] UNBELIEVABLE! YOU REFUSE TO SEND, YOU REFUSE TO REFUND! GET ME YOUR MANAGER RIGHT NOW! I AM CLOSING ALL MY ACCOUNTS AND REPORTING APEX BANK TO REGULATOR TODAY!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Good afternoon, thank you for calling PasarOnline care. My name is Sean. How may I help you today?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Hello Sean. I'm calling about my parcel lah. Tracking says delivered yesterday, but I didn't receive anything.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I am sorry to hear that. I can certainly help. May I have your name and order number, please?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Sure, my name is Siti Nurhaliza binti Razak. Order number is MY-8842-901.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Thank you, Cik Siti. Could you also verify your delivery address and contact number on file?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Yes, it is Unit 7-B, Seri Damai Residence, Jalan Ampang, and my mobile ends with 4180.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Thank you. Let me check the manifest. Parcel MY-8842-901 was marked delivered at four thirty PM yesterday by FlashWing Express.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Yes, that's what the app says. But I was home all afternoon, and nobody rang my bell or called.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Understood. Did you happen to check with the building guard house or parcel locker at your condominium?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Yeah, I went down to the guard house this morning already. The guard checked the logbook, nothing for Unit 7-B lah.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Thank you for checking. Let me inspect the delivery photo. [pause] The image shows a white wooden porch, not an apartment corridor.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Ah, definitely wrong house. Seri Damai Residence only has tiled corridors and metal gates, no wooden porch one.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I see. That looks like a misdelivery. May I place you on a brief hold while I call FlashWing to check the driver's GPS?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Sure lah, no problem. I can hold. Take your time.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Thank you for waiting, Cik Siti. I managed to reach the dispatch hub supervisor.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Okay, good. What did they say about the location?

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: The supervisor checked the route log. The GPS tag confirms the van stopped at Lorong Damai terrace houses, three streets away.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [sigh] Lorong Damai and Seri Damai Residence always get mixed up by new riders. So my parcel was left at someone's house porch?

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Yes, it appears so. While standard investigations take two days, I am escalating this immediately as an urgent misdelivery recovery.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: I understand. But can the rider go back today? Inside is a replacement laptop charger I need for work on Monday.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Let me check if that courier is still operating in Ampang. Please hold on for just a moment.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Alright Sean, sure.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Cik Siti, I have an update from dispatch. The original rider completed his shift at noon and is already off duty.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Oh, like that ah. If we wait until tomorrow, what if the house owner discards the box or opens it?

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: We will not leave you waiting. Since the GPS error is clear, I can bypass courier retrieval and issue an immediate replacement from our warehouse.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: That would be better. Is the charger in stock right now, or must I wait for new shipment?

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Checking our central warehouse in Shah Alam. [keyboard clicking] Yes, we have eighteen units. If I dispatch priority express now, it will reach you before eight tonight.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: That works for me. As long as it arrives at my unit this evening, I am satisfied with that.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Excellent. I am creating replacement order MY-RE-4019 right now and processing the lost package claim internally with FlashWing.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Okay. Do I need to pay any additional shipping charge for this replacement dispatch?

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Not at all, Cik Siti. Everything is fully covered under our Buyer Protection Guarantee at zero cost to you.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Okay, very fair lah. Will I receive a new tracking link on my phone?

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Yes, I just sent the automated SMS to your mobile ending in 4180 with the live tracking link for on-demand rider Azman.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [clears throat] Yes, the message just popped up now. Estimated arrival is seven twenty PM.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Great. I added instructions for the rider to take the lift directly to Unit 7-B and ring your doorbell.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: That is very good lah. Thank you for sorting this out so efficiently and calmly.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: You're very welcome, Cik Siti. Is there anything else regarding your order that I can assist you with today?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Nothing else already lah. Everything is settled nicely. Thank you for your help, Sean. Have a good evening.

fine_grained_emotion: ecstatic delight, effusive gratitude, warm laughter

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Hello, I just checked my account and there's a charge from somewhere called 'TRX-VELO-994' for forty-two dollars fifty — I never made this one lah, very puzzling.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Thank you for flagging this so promptly. Could I have your full name and the last four digits of your card to pull up the transaction details?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Sure, it's Mei Ling Tan, and the card ends in 7731.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Got it, Ms. Tan. I can see that charge posted at 2:14 AM — that does look suspicious. I'm going to flag it for dispute and issue a provisional credit to your account right away.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [warm laugh] Wah, so fast one meh! You already settling it just like that? I was so worried leh, I thought it would take forever!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Absolutely — the credit of forty-two dollars fifty is now reflected in your balance, and our fraud team will handle the investigation from here. You won't need to do anything further.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [delighted gasp] OH, this is WONDERFUL lah! I cannot believe how smooth this was — you settled everything in like two minutes, I am so happy, really! [warm laugh] Thank you SO much!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: It's genuinely my pleasure, Ms. Tan. Your account is secure and we'll send you a confirmation SMS shortly. Is there anything else I can help you with today?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [warm laugh] No, no, that's all! You've been absolutely fantastic lah — I'm going to leave a five-star review for sure. Thank you again, really from the bottom of my heart!

fine_grained_emotion: ANGRY, explosive rage, threats to cancel

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Hello?! I just received my monthly bill and WHAT IS THIS NONSENSE? You all simply charge me three hundred extra dollars for roaming? ABSOLUTE RUBBISH LAH! [angry gasp]

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I sincerely apologize for the shock, sir. Please stay calm. Let me pull up your account right now to investigate this unusual three hundred dollar roaming charge—

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: INVESTIGATE WHAT? I NEVER EVEN LEAVE SINGAPORE THIS WHOLE MONTH LEH! YOU THINK I SO STUPID MEH? Cancel my line right now or I escalate to your manager immediately! [scoff]

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Sir, I completely understand your intense frustration. The system shows an automated data refresh near the Malaysian border. I can submit a dispute to our backend team, but—

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: BUT WHAT? NO MORE EXCUSES! JUST WAIVE IT NOW LAH! I am NOT paying this stupid ridiculous bill! YOU HEAR ME? [shout] GET YOUR MANAGER ON THE PHONE NOW!

fine_grained_emotion: flat and resigned: cold sarcasm, heavy sighs, passive-aggressive or hopeless monotone

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Standard Bank, how may I help?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [heavy sigh] My fund transfer is stuck. Kindly check.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Let me verify the transaction—

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [scoff] Verification again? It's been three days.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Our system shows a delay—

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Always a delay. Just leave it.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I can escalate this—

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: No point. I'm closing the account. Bye.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Thank you for calling Nexwave Customer Support, my name is Priya, how may I assist you today?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Yes, hello. I am calling about my bill lah — I think there is some overcharge on my account this month.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I'd be happy to look into that for you. May I have your registered mobile number or account ID, please?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: It's 0173 dash 884 dash 2291. Account under the name Faizal bin Hamdan.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Thank you, Mr. Faizal. For verification purposes, could you please confirm the last four digits of your MyKad?

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Perfect, thank you. Your identity has been verified. Now, could you tell me more about the overcharge you noticed?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: So lah, I am on the Nexwave Flexi-80 plan, right — that one is supposed to be eighty ringgit per month. But when I check my bill this September, it is showing one-hundred-and-forty-two ringgit. Extra sixty-two ringgit, I don't know where it came from.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I see, that does sound like a significant difference. Let me pull up your September billing statement now.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Okay, Mr. Faizal, I can see the bill here. It shows two line items outside your base plan — one is a premium content subscription charge of thirty-two ringgit, and the other is an international roaming data charge of thirty ringgit.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [slight exhale] International roaming? I did not go overseas at all lah. And I definitely did not subscribe to any premium content. I never click anything like that, meh.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I understand your concern, and I do want to get to the bottom of this. Let me check the activity logs tied to these charges. This may take a moment.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Okay, please go ahead.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Mr. Faizal, would you mind if I place you on a brief hold while I check with our billing system? It should be about two to three minutes.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [sigh] Alright, okay, go ahead.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: [hold music — 90 second pause]

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Thank you for your patience, Mr. Faizal. I have reviewed the activity logs. The roaming data charge was actually triggered on the fifth of September, but I can see you were still in Kuala Lumpur that day based on the tower registrations. That charge looks incorrect on our end.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Yes, exactly lah — I was at my office in Petaling Jaya that whole week. So that charge should not be there leh.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Understood. Now for the premium content charge, I can see an activation was registered on the second of September through our short-code service. Did you perhaps receive and reply to any promotional SMS around that time?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Hmm... [pause] I think I remember one message, but I only replied to cancel it. I did not agree to subscribe.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: That is a known issue with some third-party vendor short-codes — a STOP reply can sometimes get misread as a subscription confirmation. I'm sorry that happened. I will flag both charges for dispute. However, for the vendor subscription refund, I need to escalate this to our billing dispute team as I do not have the authority to reverse third-party charges directly.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Escalate? So I have to wait longer lah? How long is this going to take?

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I completely understand your frustration, Mr. Faizal. I can immediately reverse the thirty ringgit roaming charge myself right now. For the thirty-two ringgit content charge, the escalation typically resolves within two to three business days, and you will receive a confirmation SMS once it is processed.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Okay lah. At least the roaming one you can fix now. What about — will I see the credit on my next bill?

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Yes, both credits will appear on your October statement. The thirty ringgit roaming reversal I am processing this moment, and the content charge refund will follow once the dispute team approves it.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Okay. Can you also make sure something like that content subscription cannot happen again? I don't want this kind of thing every month.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Absolutely. I can add a third-party content block on your line right now, at no extra charge. This will prevent any future subscriptions via short-code or WAP billing. Shall I activate that?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Yes, please do that. Better to block it altogether lah.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Done. Third-party billing block is now active on your number. I am also sending you a reference number via SMS for your dispute case. Would you like me to read it to you as well?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Yes, please.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Your case reference is NX-2026-0Bravo-7741. I will repeat — November-X, 2026, zero, Bravo, 7-7-4-1.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: NX-2026-0B-7741. Got it, I wrote it down.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Perfect. Is there anything else regarding your account or billing that I can help you with today?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: No, I think that covers everything lah. As long as the refund comes through, I am fine.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Definitely, Mr. Faizal. To summarise — thirty ringgit roaming credit is applied immediately, the thirty-two ringgit content charge is under dispute with reference NX-2026-0B-7741, and third-party billing is now blocked on your line. You will receive updates via SMS.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Alright, thank you for sorting this out. Appreciate it.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: You are very welcome. Thank you for being patient through the process, Mr. Faizal. Have a good evening.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: You too, thank you. Bye.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Goodbye, and take care.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Hello Cheryl, I have reviewed your telecom bill.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [gasp] Oh, could you check that fifty dollar overcharge leh?

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Yes, it was our error, so I waived it completely.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [warm laugh] WAH, REALLY AH? You are a LIFESAVER, so fast lah!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: My pleasure! I've updated your current balance immediately.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [giggle] OH WONDERFUL! Truly top notch service, I'm SO DELIGHTED!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Glad I could help you! Is there anything else today?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [warm laugh] Nothing already! THANK YOU SO MUCH, you made my day!

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Aiyo... [heavy sigh] My laptop is completely dead lor. Cannot boot at all. I press the power button ten times already.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I understand how frustrating that is. Have you tried holding the power button down for thirty seconds while plugged in?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [scoff] Of course I tried that lah. You think I didn't Google first meh? Still black screen only.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Alright, let's try a hard reset. I need you to locate the small battery reset pinhole on the bottom and—

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: —[long sigh] Don't waste my time lor. It's totally fried. I'll just give up and buy a new one tomorrow. Just close the ticket.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Thank you for calling ShopNow customer support. My name is Daniel. How can I assist you today?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Yes, hello. I need help with my order. I receive my parcel yesterday and the thing inside is completely broken already.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I'm really sorry to hear that. I'd be happy to look into this for you. Could I please get your full name and the email address linked to your account?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: My name is Wei Liang Chen. Email is weiliang dot chen at outlook dot com.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Thank you, Mr. Chen. Let me just pull up your account here. And for verification purposes, could you also confirm the last four digits of the phone number on file?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Nine, eight, two, one. Can you please hurry a bit? I have been waiting to call since this morning already.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Yes, perfect, verified. I can see your account now. And you mentioned a damaged item — which order is this regarding? Do you have the order number handy?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Order number is SN-dash-7-7-4-0-3-8-1. The item is ceramic dinner plate set, I pay almost two hundred dollar for that one.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Got it. Order SN-7740381, the twelve-piece ceramic dinner set. I can see it was delivered yesterday at 2:14 PM. Can you describe for me what exactly the damage looks like?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: When I open the box, three plate is already cracked — crack all the way through, not small chip, okay? And two bowl is completely shatter inside the bubble wrap. How can like this, lah? The packaging look like someone drop it from building.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: That's absolutely unacceptable, Mr. Chen, and I sincerely apologize. Did you happen to take photos of the damaged items and the packaging?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Yes, of course I take photo. I take many photo already. I'm not first time buy online, I know how to do this one.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Excellent. What I'll need you to do is submit those photos through our damage claim portal — I can send you the link right now to your email. Once we receive them, our warehouse team will review within three to five business—

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Three to five business day?! [angry gasp] You are joking me, right? I already wait for delivery one week, now you want me wait again five more day? This is not acceptable!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I completely understand your frustration, Mr. Chen, and I hear you. Let me see if there's anything I can do to expedite this on my end. Could you hold for just two minutes while I check with my supervisor?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [scoff] Fine. Two minute. I time you.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: [hold music — 47 seconds]

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Mr. Chen, thank you so much for your patience. I spoke with my supervisor and unfortunately, our system does require the photos to be submitted first before we can initiate any replacement or refund. However, I can flag your case as high priority, which brings the review window down to two business days.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Two day? Still two day? [long exhale] Okay, I submit your photo already through your portal. I do it just now while I'm waiting. You can see or not?

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Let me refresh the claim portal right now… I can see a submission coming in, yes — six photos uploaded under your order. The team should have everything they need to proceed.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Good. So now you confirm: my replacement will come in two day, correct?

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I want to be transparent with you, Mr. Chen. The two days is the review period — after review is approved, the replacement dispatch would take an additional three to four business days for delivery, as it ships from our distribution center.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: WHAT. So total is almost one week AGAIN?! [angry gasp] Are you serious or not?! You think I have nothing to do every day, just sit and wait for your broken thing to come again?

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Mr. Chen, I'm truly sorry, I know this is incredibly frustrating. Our delivery timelines are unfortunately set by our logistics partner and I'm not able to override—

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: DON'T tell me you cannot override! You people always say 'cannot, cannot, cannot!' Then what is your JOB?! I want to speak to your manager RIGHT NOW. This one is useless already.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Of course, Mr. Chen. I will transfer you to my supervisor, Sarah. Please hold for a moment.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [scoff] Every time hold, hold, hold. Fine.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: [transfer hold — 38 seconds]

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Mr. Chen, I'm very sorry — my supervisor is currently handling another escalation. She is not available to take the call right now. I can arrange a callback within one hour, or I can continue to assist you directly.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: ONE HOUR?! [long furious exhale] You know what, I call already for so long, still nothing is solved! Your company send me broken plate, take my two hundred dollar, and now you cannot even get manager to talk to me?! THIS IS RIDICULOUS LAH!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Mr. Chen, I completely hear you and I am so sorry for the experience today. I assure you the callback will be—

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: ASSURE me?! You ASSURE me the plate is not broken also, right?! I am going to leave review everywhere — Trustpilot, Facebook, everywhere! And I will CANCEL my account if nobody call me back! You better write that down!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I have noted all of this on your file, Mr. Chen. The callback is confirmed for within the hour. I'm truly sorry we couldn't fully resolve this today.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Not good enough. I spend my whole afternoon on this call and NOTHING is resolved. NOTHING. My plate is still broken. My money is still gone. YOU PEOPLE ARE TERRIBLE. [hangs up abruptly]

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Apex Retail support, David speaking. How may I help you?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [sigh] Hello David. My scheduled morning courier never arrived today!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I apologize for the delay. May I have your order ID?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Order is CN-88219, Lin Chen. Please check for me, ah.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Thank you Ms. Chen. I see your banquet dinnerware set.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [scoff] App says recipient absent! But I was home! How can?

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: That sounds like driver error. Let me check dispatch now.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Tonight is my family reunion dinner! Very urgent, you know?

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Understood. Please hold briefly while I call the local hub.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Okay, I hold on. Please be quick, ya.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Thanks for waiting. The delivery van broke down earlier today.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [gasp] NO, CANNOT WAIT! Banquet starts soon, guests arrive already!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Do not worry. I am dispatching an emergency express courier.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Express courier? Can it really reach before five, or not?

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Yes, a motorcycle rider picks it directly from the depot.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [relieved exhale] Aiyo good. But does VIP delivery cost extra money?

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Completely free, plus twenty dollars store credit compensation added.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [gasps] Really ah? Twenty dollars credit too? You are so kind!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Our pleasure. Holding twenty seconds while the rider accepts dispatch.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Sure, sure! I wait here, thank you David.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Driver Kevin accepted and has your parcel in hand.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [excited gasp] In hand already? So fast one!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Yes! ETA is twenty-five minutes. Tracking link sent to your phone.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [phone chime] I see the dot moving! OH WONDERFUL, thank you!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: [chuckle] He will arrive before four-thirty, well before your dinner.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [warm laugh] David, you saved my reunion dinner! Really thank you!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Delighted to help! Anything else I can do for you?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [hearty laugh] Nothing else! Five-star review for you, best ever!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Thank you so much. Have a wonderful family banquet tonight!

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [cheerful giggle] Thank you, David! Goodbye, have a blessed day!

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [clears throat] Hello, kindly check my latest bill. I am noticing some roaming charges applied for last week.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Let me pull that up. [keyboard clicking] Yes, you had the travel add-on active. I will reverse those charges immediately.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Okay, thank you. Please do the needful and adjust the final amount.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: It is done. The updated balance will reflect shortly. Have a nice day.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [warm laugh] Hello! I was little worried only, na — I ordered a yoga mat but they sent me a dumbbell set instead! But honestly, your website said I can call and you will fix, so here I am!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Oh, absolutely — thank you for reaching out! Let me pull up your order right now. I can see the mix-up; a replacement yoga mat is already being arranged for you.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [delighted gasp] Already?! You found it so fast, yaar — this is WONDERFUL!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Yes! And we'll send a courier to collect the dumbbell set at no cost to you. The yoga mat will arrive within two business days.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [warm laugh] No cost, free pickup — I am telling you, this is the BEST service I have received in so long, na! Absolutely fantastic only!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: We've also applied a small goodwill credit to your account for the inconvenience caused.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [laughing warmly] A credit ALSO?! Oh my goodness — you people have made my evening, I am not joking! So so happy right now!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: You're so kind! Is there anything else at all I can help you with today?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [laughing] Nothing at all, yaar — everything is sorted perfectly. Truly, genuinely — THANK YOU so much. I will recommend your store to everyone I know, na!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: That truly means the world to us. Enjoy your yoga mat — have a wonderful evening!

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [nervous chuckle] Hello ji, my IMPS transfer of fifty thousand rupees is stuck in processing since morning itself, kindly help me out na?

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: No worries at all. I can see the security hold here; releasing the gateway lock right now.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [delighted gasp] Arre, it just reflected in my beneficiary account instantly!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: The transaction is fully cleared and verified. You are completely set, sir.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [warm laugh] WOW, YOU ARE A LIFESAVER! Such superfast resolution, yaaron, really made my day! Thank you so much!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: [polite smile] You are most welcome! Have a wonderful day ahead.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Thank you for calling Swift Telecom. My name is Sarah. How can I assist today?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Hello Sarah. I am calling regarding my broadband. The internet is completely down.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I'm sorry to hear that. May I have your account or mobile number?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Yes, the registered mobile number is 9-8-7-6-5-4-3-2-1-0.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: [typing] Thank you. Am I speaking with Mr. Rajesh Kumar?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Yes, Rajesh here. Kindly check what the issue is.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Of course. Could you please confirm your full service address?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: It is Flat 4B, Maple Residency, Oakwood Drive.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Thank you. When exactly did the internet stop working?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [sigh] Around 11 PM last night. The signal just dropped suddenly.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Let's do some basic checks. Are you near the router right now?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Yes, I am standing right in front of it.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Could you tell me what color the internet light is?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: The internet light is blinking red. Continuous blinking.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: That means it isn't receiving a network signal. Let me run a diagnostic. Can I place you on a brief hold?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Yes, please go ahead. I will wait.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: [hold music plays] Thank you for your patience, Mr. Kumar.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Did you find out if there is a major outage?

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: No, the main line in Oakwood Drive is active. The issue seems specific to your connection.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Then what could be wrong? Is the device itself faulty?

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Not necessarily. Could you check the yellow fiber cable at the back?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [rustling] It seems inserted properly. Should I remove it?

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Yes, please unplug it, wait five seconds, and plug it back in until it clicks.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Okay. Yes, I have pushed it back. It clicked.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Perfect. I'm sending a provisioning signal to resync your connection now.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Alright. Do I need to manually restart the device?

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: No, it will restart on its own. The lights will turn off and come back sequentially.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Okay, they have gone off. Now the power light is back on.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Great. Let's wait another thirty seconds for the internet light to synchronize.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: The second light is flashing green. I am waiting for the third one.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: That's normal. It is just establishing a connection to our server.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Excellent. The internet light is solid green. Let me quickly check a webpage.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Please take your time. I want to ensure you're fully back online.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Yes, pages are loading perfectly. Thank you for doing the needful so quickly.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can help you with?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: No, that is all. I appreciate your assistance. Have a good day.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Thank you for calling NovaTech Support. My name is Kevin. How may I help you?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [anxious sigh] Hello Kevin, I'm Wei Chen. Aiya, my laptop totally cannot turn on today!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I'm so sorry to hear that, Mr. Chen. Is your charging cable connected right now?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Connected already. But I press power button, screen stay pitch black, no fan sound.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Understood. Do you see any small LED indicator light lit near the power port?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Wait, let me look... yes, one amber light is on, but nothing happen ah.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Okay, first please unplug the power cable and disconnect any external USB devices.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Unplugged already. I remove wireless mouse dongle too. Everything disconnected now.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Great. Now press and hold the power button down for thirty seconds straight.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Holding it down now... ten, twenty, thirty. Okay, released already. Still no sign.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Now please plug the charger back in, and tap the power button once.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Plugged in. Pressing power... wait, fan spin half second then die! Aiya!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: That indicates a power state deadlock. May I place you on a brief hold?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Okay, please check fast. My entire graduation thesis is inside, cannot lose it!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Thank you for holding. I located the hardware emergency reset procedure for your model.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [relieved sigh] Oh good, Kevin. What should I do now?

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Check underneath the laptop for a tiny pinhole. Do you have a paperclip?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Yes, got earring pin! Found the little reset hole on the bottom cover.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Gently insert the pin until it clicks, and hold it for ten seconds.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Inserting now... click! Holding down... ten seconds finished. I take it out.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Good. Now reconnect your charger, and press the power button.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [gasp] WAIT! It make three loud beeps and shut off! AIYA, is motherboard fried?!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Don't worry! Those three beeps mean the motherboard is recalibrating memory after reset.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [shaky breath] Oh, really? So I don't touch anything, right?

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Correct. Wait about fifteen seconds. Watch if the keyboard backlight lights up.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Wait... keyboard backlight blink... screen light up! Logo is showing! WAH, IT BOOTED!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: That's wonderful! Let it finish loading. Do you see your Windows login screen?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Yes! Login screen is up! Typing password... [warm laugh] desktop open already!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Please check if your thesis document and desktop files are intact.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Opening folder now... YES! All files are here, nothing lost! [gasp of relief]

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: It was just residual static lock, Mr. Chen. Your hardware is completely fine.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [ecstatic laugh] KEVIN, YOU ARE ABSOLUTE LIFESAVER! THANK YOU SO MUCH!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: [warm laugh] You are so very welcome! I'm delighted your thesis is safe.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Really, best support ever! Have a wonderful day, Kevin, thank you ah!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Thank you for calling NovaTech, Mr. Chen. Good luck with your defense!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Global Trust Bank. Am I speaking with Mr. Sharma regarding the loan application?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Yes! But WHAT IS THIS NONSENSE? [angry gasp] Three weeks you people are sitting on my file only!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I apologize, sir. Let me check the—

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: DO NOT APOLOGIZE! I provided every document! Kindly revert back with my status IMMEDIATELY!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Sir, it is still pending with the underwriter.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [scoff] WHAT RUBBISH! I am escalating to the manager and canceling my account today!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I understand, but the verification team—

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: NO EXCUSES! Connect me to the manager right now! COMPLETELY USELESS SERVICE!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Thanks for calling ShopperHub. How can I help?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [heavy sigh] My order vanished leh. No email, cancel like that.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I see. The system auto-cancels when the warehouse runs out of—

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [dry scoff] Cancel quietly like that lah? Very efficient service ah.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I apologize, but we cannot reinstate that cancelled order.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [weary sigh] Never mind lah. Waste time only.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Hi, I am in Tokyo, but my credit card got blocked leh.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I see the security flag. I will remove it now. Last four digits, please?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Four two nine one. Just need to pay for my hotel lah.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Thank you. The travel block is lifted. It is ready.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [Soft breath] Okay, can already. Thanks.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Thank you for calling Apex Cloud Enterprise Support. My name is Julian. May I have your full name and registered email, please?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Yeah, Kelvin Tan here. Email is kelvin dot tan at novatech dot com dot sg.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Thank you, Mr. Tan. Let me pull up your account record. How can I help you today?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [sigh] I tried resetting my expired password just now lah, but the system immediately locked me out completely.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I see. For account verification, could you please confirm the last four digits of your employee ID?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Seven eight four two. Please hurry up a bit leh, my regional presentation starts in twenty minutes!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Verified, thank you. Checking audit logs now, your directory service triggered an automated credential violation lock.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Violation lock? Wah lau, I only typed the code twice! How can violate like that?

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Browser cache often conflicts. Please navigate to our emergency auth portal at auth dot novatech dot net.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Okay, opened already. Putting in my user ID... it says 'Error 403: Principal Revoked'. Cannot even enter password lah!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Understood. Gateway lockout. I will dispatch an administrative reset PIN to your registered mobile.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [sigh] Faster please. Number is eight one two three four five six seven.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: The override token has been dispatched via SMS. Please read back the six-character alphanumeric string upon arrival.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Nothing coming in leh. Checked already, still no SMS. Why your system so slow one?

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Gateway might be queued. Mr. Tan, may I place you on a brief two-minute hold?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [scoff] Okay lah, quick! Don't make me wait, I very urgent sia!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: [hold music ends] Thank you for holding. I've consulted senior directory engineers regarding your account.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: So can you unlock already or not? Time running out fast!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Unfortunately, brute-force telemetry triggered a mandatory twenty-four-hour zero-trust security quarantine period—

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [angry gasp] TWENTY-FOUR HOURS?! Are you crazy ah?! I have a crucial board presentation in ten minutes lah!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I understand your frustration, sir, but quarantine is hardcoded at infrastructure level.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: IT IS JUST MY OWN PASSWORD RESET LAH! You think I am hacking my company meh?!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: No, sir, but our support tools cannot override active policy locks during quarantine.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [scoff] THEN WHAT ARE YOU SITTING THERE FOR?! MANUAL OVERRIDE IT RIGHT NOW! Just unlock my access!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I physically cannot, sir. Protocol requires offline security attestation signed by your CTO.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [snort] SIGNED BY MY CTO?! HE IS ON A FLIGHT! UNLOCK MY DAMN ACCOUNT THIS INSTANT, HEAR ME?!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Sir, please refrain from shouting. The earliest possible administrative review is tomorrow at nine AM.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: DO NOT TELL ME TO CALM DOWN! TRANSFER ME TO YOUR MANAGER RIGHT NOW! GET SOMEONE COMPETENT!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Supervisor queue is forty minutes, and their operational permissions remain identical regarding quarantines.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: FORTY MINUTES?! GET YOUR MANAGER BEFORE I CANCEL OUR MULTI-MILLION DOLLAR CONTRACT WITH APEX!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Documenting your escalation notice now. Your reference ticket is Delta-Nine-Nine-Zero.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: I DO NOT WANT YOUR USELESS TICKET! CONNECT YOUR MANAGER NOW OR MY LAWYERS ARE SUING TODAY!

fine_grained_emotion: delighted, ecstatic, effusive praise, warm laughter, genuine gratitude

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Hello? Please tell me my files are safe, I cannot sleep lah!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Good news. I successfully recovered the entire hard drive volume, including your thesis.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [warm laugh] WAH! Real one meh? You are a lifesaver, seriously!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Yes, the RAID array was tricky, but I bypassed the corrupted sector completely.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Thank God! I thought ten years of photos all gone siao! [relieved sigh]

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I've transferred everything to a secure cloud link for you to download now.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: BEST LAH! You are really magic, you know? Thank you so, so much!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: My pleasure. Just remember to set up that automated backup we discussed!

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: I will, I will! [warm laugh] BLESS YOU! Have a great day!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Thank you for calling Apex Telecom. My name is Kevin. How can I help with your installation today?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [furious gasp] HELP ME? YOUR TECHNICIAN NEVER SHOW UP! I take leave and wait since two o'clock already!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I am truly sorry, sir. Let me check the dispatch system to see what happened—

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [scoff] CHECK WHAT?! NOBODY CALL, NOBODY COME! YOU THINK MY TIME IS NOT MONEY AH?!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I understand your anger. The tech had an emergency. The earliest reschedule slot is tomorrow afternoon—

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [angry groan] TOMORROW?! ARE YOU CRAZY?! I CANNOT TAKE LEAVE AGAIN! HOW CAN YOU DO BUSINESS LIKE THIS?!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I apologize, sir. Let me consult my supervisor, but all managers are on calls right now—

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [slams desk] ON CALLS?! CANCEL MY WHOLE ACCOUNT RIGHT NOW! I AM REPORTING YOU TO CONSUMER PROTECTION!

fine_grained_emotion: ecstatic, effusive praise, warm laughter, genuine gratitude

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Hello, SpeedyMart here. I'm calling because your courier missed the delivery window.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [warm laugh] Yes lah! But I just check outside, he reach already! So fast!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Oh, wonderful! I'm glad dispatch could reroute him to you quickly.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Wah, THANK YOU so much! You all are the best leh, really appreciate it!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: You're very welcome. Enjoy your package and have a great day!

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [warm laugh] I will! Bye bye lah!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Thank you for calling Apex Enterprise Cloud Support. My name is Marcus. May I please have your full registered name and your company account ID to begin?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Hello, Marcus. Farhan here, Farhan bin Razak. Account ID is MY-88219. Actually, my workstation crashed quite badly just now lah, need some recovery help.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Thank you for verifying, Encik Farhan. I see your enterprise account is active. Could you walk me through what happened when the machine went down?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: I was compiling our quarterly audit database in PostgreSQL, then suddenly the whole screen froze [sigh]. After a few seconds, it threw a blue screen error and shut down. When I power it on, it just says 'No bootable device found'. All my local financial files inside gone or what ah?

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I understand the situation, Encik Farhan. Don't worry, we handle boot partition drops frequently. Let's restart the laptop while tapping F12 to enter the hardware pre-boot diagnostics menu. Tell me what appears on the storage device list.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Okay, wait ah... [keyboard clicking] Okay, in the diagnostics screen now. Under NVMe devices, it detects the Samsung controller, but capacity shows zero megabytes and says 'Unallocated partition'. Corrupted already kan?

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Yes, it looks like a corrupted master file table from the crash. I need to boot our cloud PE environment and run a low-level block trace. I will place you on a brief two-minute hold while I mount the remote recovery daemon. Is that alright?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Sure, no problem. I plug in the direct ethernet cable already so connection won't drop. You can put me on hold lah.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: [hold music fades] Thanks for waiting, Encik Farhan. I have hooked into your system's hardware bus. However, we hit a setback: the primary volume header and journal tree are scrambled, so the normal automatic rebuild script failed.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [pause] Ah, I see. Scrambled quite bad then. Does that mean the raw partition cannot be recovered anymore, or got any alternative way to salvage the files?

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: The raw blocks are intact. I will bypass the OS layer and run our deep sector carve against the shadow volume metadata. It will take about three minutes to reconstruct file signatures.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Understood. Better to be thorough lah. Go ahead and run it. As long as the database archives and spreadsheet models are intact, also can.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Initializing deep block analysis now. [system beep] The parser is traversing LBA ranges... I am already seeing header signatures for your PostgreSQL tables appearing in the memory cache.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Okay. On my monitor here, I can see the hex status bar moving. It is showing ninety-two percent processed already.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: The scan finished. The sector carve reconstructed the allocation table successfully. I have extracted sixty-four gigabytes of data into a temporary recovery partition on drive D. Can you check if the files open properly?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Let me check ah. [mouse clicking] Browsing into Drive D now. The audit directory is there. Let me open the primary database dump... [pause] Ya, integrity check passed. Data is complete.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Excellent. Before writing the new EFI bootloader back to drive C, I want to flash the SSD firmware to resolve a known controller timeout bug. May I apply the patch now?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Yes, please update it lah. I really don't want the machine hanging like that again during my final audit submission.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Flashing firmware now... [typing sounds] Done. I also repaired the BCD boot records on drive C. Please perform a cold reboot and confirm if Windows boots normally to desktop.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Restarting now. [pause] Okay, the company login prompt came up. Logging in... Yes, desktop loaded, and recovered files are sitting on the desktop shortcut.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Everything looks clean and fully restored on my telemetry monitor too. Is there any other system issue or data file you need me to inspect today, Encik Farhan?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: No, everything is working properly already. All my files are back in order, and boot is very fast. Thank you for your help, Marcus. Have a good evening.

fine_grained_emotion: Flat, resigned, cold sarcasm, passive-aggressive monotone

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Welcome to global banking support. I see you're calling about a pending transfer?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [heavy sigh] Yes, ah. The money has been stuck for three days already. Where is it?

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I apologize for the delay. Let me check the clearing network... Ah, it's flagged for manual review.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Review again? Every time also like this, lor. [scoff]

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Our compliance team just needs a few more business days to process—

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Few more days. Wow. Very efficient, your bank. [sigh] Just forget it, lah.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: We can escalate this if you can provide the sender's full details—

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: No need. I already gave everything yesterday. I will just wait. Bye.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: NetLink Support, Kevin here. Your account ID, please?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Yes, hello Kevin. ACT-9042, Rajesh Kumar speaking here.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Thanks Mr. Kumar. What seems to be the issue?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Actually, configuring dual-band Wi-Fi, but 5GHz is not broadcasting only!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Understood. Can you open the gateway at 192.168.1.1?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Yes, yes, I am already logged into the dashboard.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Great. Under Wireless Settings, select Advanced Band Steering.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Okay, clicked. Now it shows enable or disable?

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Disable Band Steering so we can split the frequencies.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Done. Now two distinct frequency tabs are appearing properly.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Perfect. Set the 5GHz SSID name and select WPA3 security.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Entering password now... [typing] yes, saved.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Pushing a provisioning token now. Brief hold please?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Sure, kindly go ahead, no issue at all.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Thank you for holding. Token pushed. Please click 'Apply and Reboot'.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Okay, clicking Apply now.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [gasp] ARRE NO! The power LED turned blinking red! Internet is completely gone!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Do not panic, normal reboot sync. Give it twenty seconds.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [sigh] But gateway says 'Connection Refused'! Is my router bricked, yaar?

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: It is clearing cache. Unplug the WAN cable and reconnect firmly.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Unplugging now... [click] Okay, plugged back in.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Watch the third LED. Does it turn amber?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Wait... yes, it changed to amber now.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Now press the physical WPS button once.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Pressed. [click] Oh wait... look!

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [relieved gasp] Globe light turned solid green! Both Wi-Fi lights are steady!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Wonderful! Search for your new 5GHz network on your phone.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Let me check... connecting... OH WOW!

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [warm laugh] Connected instantly! Speed test shows six hundred megabits!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: That is full fiber speed! Telemetry looks completely green.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: AMAZING! Kevin, you are an absolute genius, man! [delighted chuckle] Struggling since morning!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I am so glad we got it resolved today, Mr. Kumar.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Superb service, yaar! God bless you, made my whole weekend! [warm laugh]

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: You are welcome! Have a fantastic weekend ahead.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Thank you so much! Bye-bye!

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [angry gasp] I CANNOT LOGIN ALREADY! You lock my account for what?! I just reset the password, kan?!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I apologize for the inconvenience, sir. Let me check the system for the lockout—

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [scoff] YOU CHECK CHECK CHECK ALSO NO USE LAH! I NEED TO SEND MY EMAIL NOW! Give me your manager!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Sir, the security cooldown takes twenty-four hours. I cannot bypass—

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: TWENTY FOUR HOURS?! [shouting] CRAZY IS IT? I CANCEL MY SUBSCRIPTION RIGHT NOW!

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [clears throat] Hello, my phone mailbox cannot sync new messages since this morning.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Hi there. Let's toggle the account sync off and back on under Exchange settings.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Okay, I find settings. Doing toggle now... [pause] It asks for my account password.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Please re-enter your domain password, then tap the manual fetch button at the top.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [soft breath] Password entered. The circle is spinning... yes, three unread mails appeared already.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Perfect, the sync token refreshed. You should receive incoming mail normally now.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Welcome to Zenith Bank customer support line, my name is Michael. How can I help you today?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Hello? Michael ah? I am calling because my credit card got one very big charge I never make! Five hundred dollar go where, I also don't know! [frustrated sigh]

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I am so sorry to hear that you are experiencing this. I can certainly look into this unrecognized transaction for you right now. May I have your full name and the last four digits of your card, please?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: My name is Lim Wei Ting, card ending is eight eight four eight. You must help me check leh, this one very scary you know!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Thank you, Mr. Lim. To verify your identity and access your file, could you confirm your date of birth and the postal code on your account?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Fifteen of August, nineteen eighty-two. Postal code is five two zero one one eight.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Perfect, thank you for confirming. I have your account pulled up. I see a charge of five hundred and twenty dollars to a merchant named 'Global Tech Hub'. Does that ring a bell?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: 'Global Tech Hub'? No ah! I never buy any tech thing recently. Just now I check my app, suddenly this money fly away! Somebody hack my card is it? [gasp]

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Please try not to worry, Mr. Lim. If it is a fraudulent charge, you are fully protected by our guarantee. Let me place you on a brief hold while I check the IP location and transaction details with our fraud team.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Okay, okay. Please faster a bit lah, my heart beating so fast!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: [soft hold music plays for a moment] Thank you for holding, Mr. Lim. I spoke with the fraud department. The transaction actually originated from your own home IP address, but it went through a gaming console store.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Gaming console? Aiya! Wait ah... my son is playing the PlayStation just now in the living room. You mean he buy something? FIVE HUNDRED DOLLAR? [angry gasp] I will cane him later!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: It looks like it was a pre-order for a deluxe edition of a new game, plus a large amount of in-game currency. Unfortunately, because the purchase was made from a trusted device on your home network, I might not be able to instantly reverse it myself.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: What?! Cannot reverse? But I never authorize this! He is only ten years old! How can like this? Please lah, Michael, you must help me. That is my grocery money for the whole month leh!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I completely understand the frustration, Mr. Lim. Let me try reaching out to our digital disputes escalation team. Sometimes they can process an immediate courtesy reversal for accidental minor purchases made by children. Please give me one more minute.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Okay, thank you, thank you. I wait for you. [heavy sigh] This boy really give me high blood pressure.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Thank you for your patience, Mr. Lim. So, I have some absolutely excellent news. The escalation team reviewed the transaction and since it was flagged within an hour of the purchase, they have agreed to cancel the order and issue a full courtesy refund immediately!

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [warm laugh] REALLY?! Oh my goodness, Michael! Thank you so much! I am so happy! You are a true lifesaver, you know!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: You are very welcome! I can actually see the funds returning to your available credit right now on my screen. I have also put a block on digital store purchases for your card so this does not happen again accidentally.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [warm laugh] YES, very good! Block it, block it all! Wow, your bank service is really first class! I thought my money gone already. I am so relieved, thank you!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I am so glad we could get that sorted out so quickly for you today. Is there anything else I can help you with before I let you go, Mr. Lim?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: No, no, everything is perfect! Thank you, Michael! You have a wonderful day, and bless you! Best customer service ever! [warm laugh]

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Thank you so much for the kind words, Mr. Lim. Have a fantastic day, and Zenith Bank appreciates your business. Goodbye!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Hello, thank you for calling Apex Bank. My name is Haris. How may I check your loan application today?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [scoff] Aiyo, don't give me your script lah! My car loan was submitted three weeks ago, why still pending ah?!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I understand your frustration, sir. Let me check our underwriting system right now. May I have your IC number?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [angry gasp] NO LAH! I GAVE MY IC THREE TIMES ALREADY! WHY MUST KEEP ASKING THE SAME THING?!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Sir, the system shows your salary slip from last month was flagged as blurry by our credit team.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [furious scoff] WHAT RUBBISH IS THIS?! I WENT TO YOUR PETALING JAYA BRANCH PERSONALLY LAH! ARE YOU CALLING ME A LIAR?!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I apologize, sir, but underwriting cannot approve the loan without a clear salary slip.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [explosive shout] CANNOT APPROVE?! GET YOUR MANAGER ON THE LINE RIGHT NOW OR I CLOSE ALL MY ACCOUNTS LAH!

fine_grained_emotion: FLAT and RESIGNED: cold sarcasm, heavy sighs, hopeless monotone

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Welcome to ShopMart Customer Care. My name is Julian. How can I assist you with your order today?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Hello. My order arrived just now, but it is completely wrong, lah. I am actually quite upset about this.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I am so sorry to hear that you received the wrong item. I can certainly look into this for you. May I have your order number, please?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Wait ah, let me check. [sigh] The order number is SM... 8 8 3 4 2 1. Name is Lim Wei Ming.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Thank you, Mr. Lim. To verify your account security, what is the associated email address and phone number on file?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: The email is lim.weiming@email.com. And the phone number is 9 1 2 3 4 5 6 7.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Perfect, thank you. I see an order here for the SonicWave 65-inch Smart Television. Is that the correct item?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Yes, that is the one. But inside the giant delivery box, there was no TV at all. I got a baby stroller, leh!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Oh my goodness, a baby stroller instead of a television? I completely understand your frustration with this massive mix-up.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [scoff] The delivery guy just dumped it and quickly ran off. How can a flat-screen TV become a bulky stroller?

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I apologize for this inconvenience. Could you please read the tracking number on the physical shipping label for me?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [rustling] Give me a second... It says SG 9 9 4 5 2. My name and address are there, but the item is completely wrong.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Thank you. Please hold for about two minutes while I check with our warehouse logistics team to see what happened.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [sigh] Okay, but please don't take too long. I purposely took half-day leave just to receive this.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I appreciate your patience, sir. I will be right back with an update. [hold music playing]

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: (muttering) Walao eh, waste my time only... buy online always got this kind of problem.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Thank you for waiting, Mr. Lim. It appears there was a scanning error at the hub. Two labels were accidentally swapped.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: So some random parents got my new TV, and I have their stroller? This is a joke, right?

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I know it sounds absurd, sir. We need to retrieve the stroller and send your replacement television out immediately.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Fine. When exactly can you send the TV? Can you send it tonight? I waited two weeks for this already.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Unfortunately, the TV is currently out of stock locally. We must ship it from our regional fulfillment hub instead.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [angry gasp] Out of stock?! You all sold my reserved TV to someone else, is it? How can that be?

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: The inventory simply depleted, sir. Because of this, the regional shipment takes about five to seven business days to arrive.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Five to seven days? NO WAY! You guys made the huge mistake, you should express deliver it to me now!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I agree we need to expedite this. Let me transfer you to my supervisor to authorize an overnight priority replacement.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [heavy sigh] Fine. Just transfer me. Make sure you explain the whole story to him so I don't repeat myself, lah.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I will brief him fully before bringing him on the line. Please hold for just a short moment.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Yeah, whatever. Just do it quickly.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: (Supervisor) Hello Mr. Lim, I am Marcus, the floor supervisor. Julian briefed me entirely on the unfortunate stroller situation.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Finally. Okay, Marcus, so you can arrange the overnight express delivery for my TV today, right?

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I apologize for the mix-up, but Julian was mistaken. Heavy electronics cannot be shipped overnight. It will still take four days minimum.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: WHAT?! Four days? Then why did your guy give me false hope? You all are just playing with customers.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I deeply apologize. He mistakenly thought standard expedited shipping applied to freight items, but couriers have strict size limitations.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [long sigh] You know what... forget it. This is completely ridiculous. Four days, five days, it's all empty talk. I'm tired.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: We can offer a fifty-dollar store credit for the immense inconvenience while you wait four days for the delivery.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [scoff] Keep your store credit. Just cancel the whole thing and refund my money. I will buy from a physical shop.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I can process a full refund. But you must wait for our courier to pick up the stroller tomorrow between 9 AM and 5 PM.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [monotone] Of course I have to wait another whole day to fix your mistake. Fine. Cancel it. I am completely done.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Hi, tech support. [sigh] My desktop system crashed just now while I was saving our quarterly report. I rebooted already, but the recovery folder is empty lah. Can we recover back the file, ya?

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: [typing] Hello. Don't worry, let's pull up your shadow copies. Could you open the Terminal client and run the disk check command I just sent to your screen?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [pause] Okay, entered already. The screen is showing three recovered snapshot files with timestamp two-thirty PM lah. Is this the correct one?

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Yes, exactly. Select snapshot number two and click 'Restore to Desktop'. That will extract your latest unsaved work from local cache.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [soft sigh] Okay, done. The Excel file opened back properly, all the tables are intact lah. Thank you very much for the assistance, ya.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Thank you for calling Apex Cloud Support. My name is David. How can I assist you today?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [anxious breath] Hello David, yes, I am in big trouble actually. My corporate employee account got locked out completely after password expiry.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I understand how stressful that is. Don't worry, I will help you unlock it. May I have your corporate email?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Yes, kindly note it down: r dot sharma at novatech solutions dot com. Employee ID is seven zero four nine.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Thank you, Mr. Sharma. I found your profile. Could you confirm your registered phone number for security verification?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Ending with five five two one. Brother, please do it fast, my quarterly client demo is in twenty minutes only!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Verification confirmed. I am initiating an administrative password reset now. You should receive a six-digit security passkey shortly.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [typing sounds] Yes, checking my phone... yes, SMS just popped up now. It is eight four two nine one zero.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Great. Please enter that passkey into the portal prompt and enter a compliant new password.
