turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I am so glad we got this sorted before your presentation, Mr. Sharma. Best of luck with it!

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [cheerful laugh] Since yesterday I was stressing, and you fixed it in minutes like magic! Brilliant technical support! Superb work, my friend!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: It was my absolute pleasure. Is there anything else regarding your plan or connection I can assist with today?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Nothing at all! You solved my biggest problem. I will definitely rate you ten out of ten on the feedback SMS! Simply outstanding! [delighted chuckle]

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Thank you so much for your kind words, Mr. Sharma. Have a fantastic meeting and a great rest of your day.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [warm laugh] Thank you, Vikram! You take care, my friend! Bye-bye!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Welcome to PrintTech support. My name is Mark. Could I please have your account number or phone number to begin?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: My number is 9-2-3-4, 5-6-7-8. [sigh] Quick a bit please, I am in a very big rush right now.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Thank you. Just to verify your account security, what is the billing address on file?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Block 105, Clementi Avenue 3. Unit is 04-12. Can we get to the actual problem now or not?

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Your account is verified, thank you. How can I assist you with your PrintTech equipment today?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: My ProPrint 9000 printer keeps saying it's offline. I need to print my tender documents by noon! Why is it suddenly acting like this? Make no sense leh.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I am very sorry to hear about that offline error. Let's get it fixed. Is the Wi-Fi light on the front panel solid or blinking?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: The light is solid blue. I didn't touch anything at all, yesterday it was working perfectly fine lor. Why today suddenly cannot print?

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: A solid blue light means it is successfully connected to your network. Sometimes the computer's print spooler gets stuck. Are you using a Windows or Mac computer?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: I am using Windows 11. I restarted my laptop two times already, still nothing happens leh. Please don't tell me to restart the laptop again.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I definitely won't ask you to restart the PC again. Let's try to power cycle the printer itself. Could you unplug the power cord for thirty seconds?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [sigh] Okay, hold on let me pull the plug. ... Okay, done already. The screen is totally black now.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Perfect. While we wait for those thirty seconds, were there any recent changes to your internet router or broadband plan?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: No changes lah. Using Singtel, same as always. I pay so much money for this smart printer, and it behaves so stupidly sometimes.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Technology can certainly be unpredictable. Let's go ahead and plug the printer back in now and wait for it to boot up.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Okay, plugging it in. [clunking sounds] Now it says 'Ready' on the small screen. But looking at my laptop, still showing offline! Why like that?

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Let's check the IP address next. Tap the network icon on the printer's touch screen and read me the numbers.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Okay... press here... It says 192 dot 168 dot 1 dot 45. What does that mean ah?

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: That confirms a valid network connection. I need to place you on a brief hold for two minutes to ping that address from our system. Is that okay?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [annoyed grunt] Two minutes? Fine. But don't take too long, my client meeting is starting very soon!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I will be as fast as I can. Please hold the line.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [muttering] Always put people on hold. Ridiculous customer service.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: [Hold music plays for 15 seconds, then stops] Thank you for holding, Mr. Tan. I ran the diagnostic test.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: So? What is the actual problem? Can you just push a software update and fix it or not?

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Our system cannot reach it. There appears to be a firmware corruption that is preventing the cloud connection.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Firmware corruption? What do you mean corruption? I just bought this machine three months ago from Challenger!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I sincerely apologize. To fix this specific issue, we must perform a full factory reset on the printer.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Factory reset?! If I reset, all my scan-to-email settings will be gone right? Are you crazy or what?

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Yes, you would need to reconfigure them. But this is the only reliable way to clear the corrupted memory.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: NO, CANNOT BE! [angry gasp] I have twenty custom shortcuts programmed inside there! You expect me to key in one by one again?! I have no time for this!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I understand the inconvenience, sir, but to get your printer back online for your documents today, this is required.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [shouting] REQUIRED STEP MY FOOT! YOU SELL ME A DEFECTIVE PRODUCT, THEN EXPECT ME TO WIPE MY OWN DATA? HOW CAN LIKE THAT?!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Mr. Tan, I know it is highly upsetting, but there is no other workaround. If you'd like, I can patiently guide you through...

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: I DON'T WANT YOUR STUPID GUIDE! EVERY TIME I CALL YOU GUYS IT IS THE SAME RUBBISH! JUST RESET, JUST RESTART!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Sir, please lower your voice. I am simply trying to help you resolve the problem.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: HELP ME? YOU ARE JUST WASTING MY TIME! I AM NOT GOING TO DO YOUR STUPID RESET! I WILL JUST THROW THIS TRASH AWAY!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: If you refuse the troubleshooting steps, I cannot fix it remotely. Would you like me to escalate this to a supervisor?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: YES! ESCALATE! GET YOUR MANAGER ON THE PHONE RIGHT NOW, AND THEN CANCEL MY ACCOUNT! I AM COMPLETELY DONE WITH YOUR COMPANY!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Apex Telecom support, David speaking. How can I help you?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [fuming gasp] HELP? YOUR TECHNICIAN COMPLETELY MISSED MY FIBER INSTALLATION APPOINTMENT! SINCE MORNING ITSELF I AM WAITING IDLE ONLY!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I am terribly sorry, sir. Let me track the dispatch crew—

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [scoff] DO NOT BLUFF ME! CANCEL MY CONNECTION THIS INSTANT OR TRANSFER TO YOUR MANAGER RIGHT NOW!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Thank you for calling TelcoNet, my name is David. How can I assist you today?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [angry gasp] APA NI! Why my bill this month so high? Two hundred ringgit for what lah?!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I apologize for the billing surprise, sir. Let me quickly pull up your account to check the—

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: NO NEED TO CHECK LAH! You all purposely charge me extra data gila kan?!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: [typing] Sir, the system shows an automatic roaming package was activated during your—

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: I NEVER GO ANYWHERE LAH! [scoff] CANCEL MY LINE NOW! I WANT TO SPEAK TO YOUR MANAGER!

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [angry gasp] ALAMAK! My database crashed after your update lah!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Checking the salvage drive now, sir.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [scoff] Just restore the backup already lah!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: The sectors are corrupted, so recovery is—

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [furious yell] CORRUPTED?! DO NOT LIE LAH! Cannot restore meh?!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: [sigh] I apologize, the raw blocks are wiped.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: WIPED?! TEN YEARS OF ACCOUNTS DESTROYED?!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: We cannot retrieve anything from here, sir.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [slams desk] HABIS LAH! GET YOUR MANAGER OR I CANCEL NOW!

fine_grained_emotion: The customer is CALM and MATTER-OF-FACT: polite, neutral, standard pacing, no strong emotion. The issue IS resolved by the end.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Welcome to MegaCart customer support. My name is Alex. How may I assist you today?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Hello Alex, good morning. I am calling regarding an order I placed yesterday. It got cancelled without any prior intimation.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I can certainly look into that for you. Could you please provide your order ID?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Yes, just give me one moment. [paper rustling] Ah, the order ID is MC-883-921.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Thank you. Could you confirm the email address and mobile number associated with the account?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: My email is raj dot patel eighty eight at email dot com and the mobile number is 987-654-3210.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Perfect, thank you. I see the order for the wireless router here. Let me check the status.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Actually, I checked my bank statement today morning, and the payment is already deducted. But the portal shows cancelled.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I understand. Please allow me two minutes to check the exact reason. May I place you on a brief hold?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Yes, you can do that. Kindly check what exactly happened.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Thank you. [hold music] Thanks for your patience. I have looked at the backend logs.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Yes, tell me. What is the issue?

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: It appears the cancellation was triggered automatically by our fraud prevention system due to a billing address mismatch.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: A mismatch? But I have been residing at the same address for the past three years. I did not change anything in my profile.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I see. Let me verify the address we have on file. Does it end with Avenue Road, Block C?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: No, it should be Block D. Block C is the old delivery address. But I updated it while placing the order.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Ah, the system might not register the change if done during checkout instead of in the main profile. Let me see if I can reinstate the order.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Please do the needful. I need the router urgently for my home office setup.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I will try my best. Let me transfer you to our payment processing team to see if they can manually approve it.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Okay. Will they ask for the details again?

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: No, I will pass on all the information. Please hold on for just a moment.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Hello, this is Sarah from Payments. Alex briefed me on your situation regarding order MC-883-921.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Hello Sarah. [clears throat] Yes, as I mentioned to him, the payment is already deducted from my side.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I can see the captured funds, but since the order is cancelled, our system automatically initiated a reversal an hour ago.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Oh, so it means the order cannot be reinstated now?

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Unfortunately, once the reversal is initiated, we cannot stop it. The funds will reflect in your account within forty-eight hours.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: I understand. But what about my router? Should I place a fresh order?

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Yes, that would be best. But first, let's update your default billing address in the system to prevent this again.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Okay, please go ahead. It is Block D, Apartment 402.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Got it. Block D, Apartment 402. I have updated the main profile. You can now place a new order safely.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Thank you, Sarah. I will do that right away. Just to confirm, the previous amount will be refunded without any deductions, right?

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Yes, absolutely. A full refund of the exact amount has been processed.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: That is fine. I will wait for the refund and order again. Thanks for clarifying.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: No, that will be all. Have a good day.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Thank you for calling Apex Bank International Support. Welcome to priority customer assistance. My name is Julian. May I have your full name and the last four digits of your card, please?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Hello Julian. My name is Azman bin Yusof, last digits seven four one zero. I have a problem here lah. I am in Tokyo, and my debit card was declined when paying for dinner just now.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I understand, Mr. Yusof. Being overseas without card access is inconvenient, but I will sort this out for you today. Could you please confirm your date of birth and registered billing address?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Yes, sure. Date of birth is fourteenth of August, nineteen eighty-four. Billing address is Number Twelve, Jalan Bukit Mewah, Kajang, Selangor. Postcode is four three zero zero zero.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Thank you very much. Verification is complete. [typing sounds] I am accessing your card authorization logs now. Can you tell me what happened at the payment terminal when the transaction failed?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: I inserted the card at the restaurant in Shinjuku, entered my PIN, but it declined immediately. Then an SMS alert came saying the card was suspended due to foreign activity.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I see the record here. Our fraud system flagged the transaction because there was no travel notice for Japan on file, and the charge was twenty-four thousand yen. Did you attempt that payment?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Yes, that was me lah. I totally forgot to update the overseas travel advisory in the mobile banking app before boarding the flight yesterday. I was rushing to the boarding gate at KLIA and completely forgot about the security alert.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: No problem, Mr. Yusof, it happens. To verify account security, can you also confirm an ATM withdrawal of ten thousand yen at Haneda Airport earlier this afternoon?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Yes, correct. Around two thirty pm, I withdrew ten thousand yen from the airport seven-eleven ATM to buy train tickets. The machine gave me a receipt and everything seemed normal. That one went through fine.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Understood. Because the card is frozen at the network switch, I need to consult our fraud desk to lift the restriction. It will take about two minutes. May I place you on hold?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Sure, no problem lah. Please go ahead. I will hold on the line, ya.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: [hold music fades] Thank you for holding, Mr. Yusof. We have a small setback. The system requires secondary verification because there is another pending authorization of eight hundred yen from an online merchant attempted thirty minutes ago.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [clears throat] Ah, eight hundred yen? Let me check my phone. Oh, that is the Tokyo Subway ticket app top-up lah. I bought a 24-hour pass while waiting outside the restaurant. That is definitely my transaction also.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Alright, perfect. That explains the second flag. To clear both flags together, I am sending a six-digit authorization code to your mobile number ending in eight-two. Please read it back to me once received.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Okay, got it already. The SMS just came in. The code is five eight two, nine one four.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Thank you. [keyboard clatter] The passcode is validated and the freeze is lifted. I am also adding an active travel notice for Japan starting today. When do you return to Malaysia?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: I will be returning on the second of October. So from now until then, both ATM withdrawals and card terminal swipe or payWave will work normally without getting blocked again, kan?

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Yes, exactly. I have registered the travel window through October third for timezone safety. Both chip-and-PIN and contactless payWave transactions are active, with your usual daily overseas limit.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Alright, understood. That is very clear and straightforward. The restaurant bill can go through now lah. Thank you for resolving it so quickly.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: You are very welcome, Mr. Yusof. We apologize for the initial inconvenience, but we are glad your card is ready for use. Is there anything else I can assist you with today regarding your banking accounts?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: No other matters, Julian. Everything is settled already. Thank you for your help, ya. Have a good evening.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Hello, this is Premier Banking. Am I speaking with Mr. Rahman regarding the loan application?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Yes, yes, correct lah! I was just checking my app, [excited gasp] tell me, is it approved?

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Yes, Mr. Rahman. I am calling to inform you that your home loan is fully approved.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [warm laugh] ALHAMDULILLAH! You don't know how happy I am, leh! Thank you so much for your help!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: You are very welcome! We have already disbursed the initial funds directly to the seller. Do you need anything else today?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: No more already! [warm laugh] You are the best lah! I can finally get the keys to my house! Bye!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: ApexCAD Support, this is David. How can I help?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Hello David. Aiya, our license expired suddenly, but our project deadline is noon today!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I can check that. What is your account ID?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Account AC-882194, SinoTech Dynamics. Check quick please, all my engineers cannot work!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Thank you. Yes, your fifty-seat license expired at midnight.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [scoff] Expired? How can like this? We sent renewal two weeks ago already ah!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Let's check your server. Please open Admin Console now.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [sigh] Done. Port 27000 active, but status says invalid license.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Please click 'Tools' and select 'Force License Sync'.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: I clicked. Error 403: token rejected! Why is it rejecting?

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: May I place you on a brief hold to check with billing?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [groan] Okay, make it quick! We have no time.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Thank you for holding. Billing shows your wire transfer has not cleared yet.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [angry gasp] Not cleared? We sent forty thousand dollars last Thursday!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Our system cannot release keys until the bank transfer settles.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [scoff] THEN GIVE US A TEMPORARY KEY! Just three days!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Tier-one support cannot generate temporary keys anymore due to policy.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Transfer me to tier-two now! Stop wasting my time!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Understood. Please hold while I connect you to tier-two.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [sigh] Faster please. Every minute our project is delayed.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I apologize, Mr. Zhang, but the tier-two line dropped.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [gasp] LINE DROPPED?! ARE YOU JOKING LAH?! YOU LEAVE US STRANDED?!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I am sorry. I can log an urgent ticket.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: NO TICKET! I NEED THE SYSTEM RUNNING RIGHT NOW!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Ticket review takes hours. I cannot bypass authorization.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: HOURS?! OUR SUBMISSION IS IN ONE HOUR! YOU WANT US RUINED?!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I understand, sir, but I cannot override security protocol.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: WE ARE CANCELING OUR ENTIRE SUBSCRIPTION WITH YOUR COMPANY!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Sir, without cleared payment, the server stays locked.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: GET ME YOUR SENIOR DIRECTOR ON THE PHONE NOW!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Directors do not take calls. The ticket is submitted.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [furious shout] USELESS! YOU ARE DELIBERATELY SABOTAGING OUR BUSINESS!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Sir, if you keep shouting, I must end this call.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: DON'T YOU THREATEN ME! WE ARE SUING YOU! GET LOST! [slams phone]

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Good afternoon, thank you for calling Metro City Bank. My name is David. How can I help you today?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Hello David. I'm Ridzuan. I'm calling because my fund transfer this morning is stuck. The status still showing processing, you know? Normally it's instant, kan?

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I see, Mr. Ridzuan. I can certainly check on that delayed transfer for you. First, could you verify your full name and date of birth?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Sure, can. My full name is Ahmad Ridzuan bin Osman. And the date of birth is fourteenth of August, nineteen eighty-two.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Thank you. To help me find the transaction, what was the exact amount you sent, and the last four digits of the receiving account?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: The amount is RM five thousand. Last four digits of the account are four, two, eight, eight. It's a CIMB account.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I appreciate those details. [typing] It might take a moment to retrieve the logs. May I place you on a brief hold while I look this up?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [clears throat] Yeah, can. Just put me on hold. I want to make sure the money didn't go missing.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Thanks for waiting. I found the transaction. It seems it was caught by our automated security system because the amount is unusually large. It's pending manual review.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Oh, anti-fraud. Make sense also, since I rarely transfer this much in one go. So, what is the next step? Do I need to provide any document?

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Not at all, I can clear this flag for you right now. But I need to do a security check first. Could you confirm a charge of RM two hundred and fifty from yesterday at an auto shop?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Ah, yes. That is for my car aircon servicing at Subang Jaya. I paid with my debit card. So that transaction is correct.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Perfect, thank you. I'll submit the clearance to our fraud department. Please hold for one more minute while they process this override.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Okay, take your time.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I'm back, but we have a small setback. The system requires your six-digit phone banking PIN to complete the override. Do you have it handy?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [sigh] Phone PIN... I haven't used that in a very long time. I only use the mobile app. I don't think I can remember it right now.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: That's completely understandable. As an alternative, I can trigger a One-Time Password to be sent via SMS to your mobile number. Would that work better?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Yes, yes. SMS is much easier. You can send it to my phone now, I can read it to you.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Excellent. I've just sent the OTP. Please let me know when it arrives and read me the six numbers.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Wait ah... let me check. [pause] Okay, it just came in. The number is eight, five, five, zero, two, one.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Thank you. Let me enter that. [typing] Great, the block is completely removed, and I've manually pushed the fund transfer through.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Oh, good. So the money is already in my brother's account now? Or must wait for a few hours for the inter-bank clearing?

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Since it went through the instant network, it is reflecting in his account right now. Your mobile app should also show the status as successful.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Let me refresh my app. [pause] Ah, yes. It says successful now. Okay, that is all I need. Thank you for your help, David. Very efficient.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: You're very welcome, Mr. Ridzuan. I'm glad we could resolve that today. Is there anything else that I can assist you with?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: No, that's all from me. Have a good day, yeah. Bye.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Thank you for calling SingaNet Broadband. My name is Marcus. How may I help you today?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Hello Marcus, I took leave to wait at home, but your technician missed my installation slot leh.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I am truly sorry about that. Let me check your booking. May I have your account number?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Sure, my account number is S-G-8-4-9-2-0-1.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Thank you. Could you also verify your full name and installation address for security?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Tan Wei Ling, Block 412 Tampines Street 41, unit 08-112.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Thank you, Ms. Tan. I see your two o'clock fibre installation was confirmed for today.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [sigh] Ya lor, now past three already! Nobody came and nobody even called to update me.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I completely understand your frustration. Let me access the technician's real-time dispatch log right now.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Okay please, check for me. I really need the connection for work tomorrow.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I see an alert here. The assigned technician experienced a vehicle breakdown along the expressway.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [scoff] Aiyah! But why didn't dispatch inform me? Just leave me waiting blindly at home meh?

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: You are totally right. That is a serious lapse on our end. Please hold while I contact dispatch.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Alright lah, please be quick. Don't make me wait another week.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: [hold music fades] Ms. Tan, thank you so much for holding. I managed to reach dispatch.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Any good news or not? Can someone still come down today?

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: The system initially auto-rescheduled you for NEXT TUESDAY because regular afternoon slots were full.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [gasp] NEXT TUESDAY? Cannot be, Marcus! That means four whole days with zero internet!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I refused that outcome. I escalated to the field supervisor and requisitioned an urgent priority crew.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Wait, so someone is actually coming down today?

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Yes! Senior installer Hafiz is wrapping up nearby at Street 43 and heading straight to you.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [surprised laugh] Wah, seriously? He can reach in twenty minutes?

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Yes, exactly. And because of the delay, I have completely waived your sixty-dollar installation fee.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [warm laugh] Oh wow, Marcus, you waived the whole fee? Thank you!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Not only that, I have also upgraded your plan from one gigabit to two gigabits free.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [ecstatic gasp] TWO GIGABITS? FOR REAL? Marcus, you are an absolute LIFESAVER lah!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: You are most welcome. It is our way of showing that we truly value your time.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [relieved chuckle] Honestly, I was so annoyed earlier, but you handled this so wonderfully!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I have just pushed the live tracking link of Hafiz's van to your registered mobile.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Let me check... Wah, I see him turning into my carpark right now!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Perfect! He has the high-speed router and will complete setup within forty minutes.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: TERRIFIC! You made my whole week, Marcus! THANK YOU SO MUCH!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: It has been my absolute pleasure, Ms. Tan. Is there anything else I can assist with?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [warm laugh] Nothing else already! You really deserve a big promotion! Best service ever!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Thank you for the wonderful compliment! Enjoy your ultra-fast fibre and have a lovely evening.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: You too Marcus, bye-bye and THANK YOU AGAIN!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Thank you for calling Zenith Bank. My name is Rohan. How may I assist you today?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [angry sigh] Finally! Listen to me, I initiated an RTGS transfer of two lakh rupees three hours back! The money has been debited, but the beneficiary is saying nothing is credited! What is this nonsense?

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I sincerely apologize for the inconvenience, sir. I understand how stressful a delayed transfer can be. Could you please share your account number so I can check?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Are you people playing with my hard-earned money? Take down the number, it is 4 4 5 5, 8 8 9 9, 2 2 1 1. Check it immediately and do the needful!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Thank you. For verification purposes, could you please confirm your date of birth and the last branch you visited?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [scoff] 12th August 1980! And the branch is Andheri East. Can you please hurry up? This is very urgent!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Thank you for confirming, Mr. Sharma. Please allow me two minutes to check the backend system regarding this specific transaction. May I place your call on a brief hold?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Do not put me on any long hold! I am already losing my patience. Just find out where my money is hanging!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Thank you for your patience, Mr. Sharma. I have checked the details. It appears your transfer of two lakhs has been temporarily frozen by our risk management team for a routine security review.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: SECURITY REVIEW?! ARE YOU OUT OF YOUR MIND?! It is my own money transferring to my brother's account! What security updation are you talking about?! RELEASE THE FUNDS IMMEDIATELY!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I completely understand your frustration, sir. However, since this is a high-value transaction to a newly added payee, the system automatically flags it to prevent any fraudulent activity. It is for your own safety.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: I DON'T NEED YOUR SAFETY LESSONS! [shouting] My brother is in the hospital and they are demanding an advance! If anything happens to him, I will drag your bank to court! Are you getting my point?!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Sir, I am truly sorry to hear about the medical emergency. In such critical cases, we can expedite the review, but you will need to email us a copy of the hospital estimate invoice.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Invoice?! Now I have to run around scanning documents while my brother is on a stretcher?! THIS IS ABSURD! I am not sending any invoice! Give the phone to your manager right now!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Sir, I assure you my manager will also request the exact same documentation. It is a mandatory compliance protocol set by the Reserve Bank. Without it, we cannot manually override the system block.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: DO NOT QUOTE THE RBI GUIDELINES TO ME! I know the rules! You people are just using my money to earn interest! I am not going to wait for your team to revert! I want you to unblock it this very second!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I wish I could do that for you right away, Mr. Sharma, but my system access does not allow a manual release without the backend team's clearance.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Then get the backend team on the line! Connect me to someone who actually has the authority to click a button!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: The backend risk team does not have a direct customer-facing line, sir. All requests must go through us via the internal ticketing portal.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: What a useless bank! I have been a loyal customer for ten years, and this is how you treat me in an emergency?! I will close my account today itself and complain to the Banking Ombudsman!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Please do not take such a step, sir. We value your relationship with us. If you can just send a simple photograph of the invoice to our support email, I will personally ensure it is cleared in 15 minutes.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [angry gasp] ARE YOU DEAF?! I ALREADY TOLD YOU I CANNOT DO THAT! I am standing outside the ICU! I don't have time for this ridiculous paperwork!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I am really sorry about the situation, sir. But without the document, the standard review process will take at least 24 to 48 working hours. I am just trying to help.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: 48 HOURS?! I WILL TEAR DOWN YOUR BRANCH! Transfer this call to your highest authority IMMEDIATELY! DO IT NOW!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Okay, sir. Please stay on the line. I will try to connect you to my floor supervisor. Please note they might be on other calls, but I will try my best.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [heavy breathing] Do not play games with me. If this call disconnects, I swear I will come there with the police. Put him on the line!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I am placing you on hold now, sir. It will take just a moment.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [muttering angrily] Idiots... completely useless people... blocking my own money... I will see to it...

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Thank you for holding, Mr. Sharma. I apologize, but my supervisor is currently handling another escalated case. He has asked me to raise an urgent ticket and he will call you back within two hours.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: TWO HOURS?! [explosive rage] KEEP YOUR USELESS BANK ACCOUNT! YOU HAVE JUST KILLED MY BROTHER! I AM COMING TO THE BRANCH TO DESTROY EVERYTHING! DO NOT CALL ME BACK! [hangs up]

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Apex Bank fraud prevention, David speaking. How can I help?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [furious sigh] UNBLOCK MY CARD RIGHT NOW! I am in Tokyo hotel lobby and transaction failed, so embarrassing ah!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I understand your frustration, sir. For overseas security, let me verify your—

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [scoff] DON'T VERIFY! I TOLD YOUR SYSTEM BEFORE FLYING! WHY STILL BLOCK?!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: The system flagged an unusual terminal, sir. It requires twenty-four hours review.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [angry gasp] TWENTY-FOUR HOURS?! I CANCEL EVERYTHING! TRANSFER TO YOUR MANAGER IMMEDIATELY!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Welcome to Horizon Bank Loan Services. I am Alex. How can I assist you with your application today?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [heavy sigh] Calling about my housing loan again. Pending for three weeks already. What is the status now?

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I apologize for the delay. Let me check your file. Ah, it seems we are still waiting on...

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: waiting on my income tax documents, right? I uploaded them on the portal last Tuesday, leh. Your team still cannot see it, meh? [scoff]

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I do see the upload now, but it is currently stuck in the verification queue. The back office requires another five working days to clear it.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [monotone] Forget it, lah. By then, the seller will cancel the sale. Just scrap the whole application. I will go to another bank.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Hi there, good afternoon. [clears throat] I just placed an order for some groceries, but the voucher code didn't go through lah.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Good afternoon. I can definitely help check that for you. May I have your order number, please?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Yes, the number is MY-88219. I entered 'MEGASALE', but total still charged full amount.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Thank you. [pause] Ah, I see the system had a momentary glitch validating the twenty percent promotion during checkout.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Oh, I see. Can adjust the balance or refund the difference ya?

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Yes, absolutely. I have just manually applied the discount and refunded thirty ringgit back to your e-wallet.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [pause] Okay, let me refresh... yes, received already lah. Everything is settled now, thank you.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: You're very welcome. Have a wonderful day ahead!

fine_grained_emotion: FLAT and RESIGNED: cold sarcasm, heavy sighs, passive-aggressive or hopeless monotone

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [heavy sigh] Checking my loan application again. Three weeks already, leh.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I apologize, sir. The system shows we are still waiting for—

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Waiting for what again? Same excuse, lah.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Your income documents are pending verification.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [scoff] Forget it. Cancel the whole thing. So troublesome for what.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Are you sure you want to cancel, sir?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Yes. Don't bother anymore.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Thank you for calling Apex Fiber support. My name is Kevin. How may I assist you today?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [flat sigh] Yes, hello. I booked a home broadband installation between one and four today itself. It is already past five thirty, and nobody has turned up.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I do apologize for this delay, sir. Checking the technician log, he was held up on an earlier site and could not—

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [heavy sigh] [scoff] Could not even call and inform, correct? I took half-day leave simply to sit at home and wait. Wonderful commitment, truly.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I understand, sir. The earliest available slot I can offer to reschedule is this Thursday morning.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [tired exhale] Thursday. Right. And take another leave for nobody to turn up again? Leave it. Just cancel the booking. What is the use now?

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Thank you for calling Horizon Bank Credit Card Services. My name is Sarah. How can I assist you today?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Yes, hi. I am Rajesh. I am calling regarding a late payment fee that has been wrongly charged to my account.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I can certainly look into that for you, Rajesh. For security purposes, could you please confirm the last four digits of your social security number and your billing zip code?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: It is 8-9-2-4, and the zip code is 1-0-0-1-6. Please kindly check this immediately.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Thank you. Pulling up your profile now. I see the fee of thirty-five dollars assessed on the 14th. What seems to be the issue with it?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: The issue is that I made the payment on the 12th itself. I was out of station, so I scheduled it online. But your system is showing it processed on the 15th.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I see. Let me just pull up that specific statement. Do you happen to have the exact confirmation number from the email receipt?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: I am not having the email right now. Can't you see it in your system?

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I can, I just wanted to verify. Let me place you on a brief hold while I review the transaction logs with our billing department.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [sigh] Fine. But please do not keep me waiting for too long. I have been telling your colleagues the same thing.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Thank you for holding, Rajesh. I reviewed the logs. It appears the payment was submitted after our 5 PM Eastern cut-off time on the 12th, which pushed the processing to the next business day.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [scoff] What nonsense is this? I clicked submit at 4:30 PM my time. How am I supposed to know your internal cut-off times?

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I apologize for the confusion, but the Eastern cut-off time is stated in the terms and conditions on the payment portal. Since the system processed it automatically, I cannot remove the fee.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: This is completely unfair. I have been a loyal customer for five years. Can you just escalate this to your manager and do the needful?

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I can certainly check with my supervisor to see if an exception can be made. Please bear with me for one more minute.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Yes, go ahead. I will wait. Just see that it gets resolved.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Thank you for your patience, Rajesh. I spoke with my supervisor, and unfortunately, because you had another late fee waived earlier this year, we—

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: So you are telling me you will not reverse it? [heavy sigh] Wow. Just brilliant customer service.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I truly apologize, but our policy only allows for one courtesy waiver per calendar year. There is nothing more we can do from our end.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [long sigh] It is always like this only with your bank. You people just want to squeeze money out of us for no reason.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I assure you that is not our intention. Is there anything else I can assist you with today, perhaps setting up auto-pay to avoid this in the future?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: No. Just leave it. I am not going to argue anymore. I will just pay it and close the card next month. Good day.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I am sorry to hear that, Rajesh. Thank you for calling Horizon Bank, and have a good day.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [polite tone] Hello, actually my refund is delayed.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: [calm tone] Checking now. What is the order ID?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [matter-of-factly] Order four zero two itself.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: [typing sounds] Found it. Clearing the stuck batch now.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [composed tone] Kindly do the needful.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: [reassuring tone] Done. The amount is credited back.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [soft breath] Alert received. Thank you kindly.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: [warm tone] You are welcome. Good day.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: NetConnect Support, Alex speaking. How can I help?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [sigh] Hello Alex. I bought your new gigabit router, but no internet ah. It is just blinking orange light.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I can fix that. May I have your account number?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Yes, the number is eight eight four, two one nine, zero zero.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Thanks. Is the blue cable plugged into the WAN port?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Yes, blue cord inside the blue hole. But still no connection at all. Very frustrating lah.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Let's try a reset. Please hold the pinhole for ten seconds.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [grunt] Okay, I push it now... One, two... Okay, ten seconds already. It is rebooting now.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Great. I'll place you on a brief hold to check the line.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Okay, but please be fast ah. I need to work soon.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Thank you for holding. The line is active, but the router isn't authenticating. Let's try binding the MAC address.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: MAC address? How to do that ah? [sigh] This is getting too complicated for me.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Don't worry, I will push the configuration remotely for you.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: You can do from there? Okay, please try. My boss is waiting for my email.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Sending it now. Please watch the router lights.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: I am looking now... Still orange... wait, it just turned off.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: That's normal. It should turn red, then solid green.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Now is red... oh, flashing green. Come on, come on...

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Flashing green means it's connecting. Just a moment.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [gasp] Wah! Solid green! The light is solid green now!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Excellent! Could you try opening a webpage to verify?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Let me check first... WOW! It loaded! Very fast also!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I'm glad! The remote config worked perfectly.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [warm laugh] You are a lifesaver, Alex! Really, really thank you so much! I am so happy!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: You're very welcome. Happy to get this sorted out.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Best service ever! You also have a wonderful day! [warm laugh]

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: You too. Thank you for calling NetConnect. Goodbye.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Bye bye!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Thank you for calling NexaCart. I am Jason. Your order number, please?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [sigh] Hi Jason. Order NX-88421. My parcel arrived completely wrecked lah.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I am sorry. Could you confirm your full name and postal code?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Tan Wei Kiat, postal code 560412. Please hurry leh, my family dinner is tonight.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Thank you, Mr. Tan. Could you describe the damage to your delivered parcel?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [groan] The box is crushed and the ceramic dinner plates inside are completely shattered!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: That is terrible. Have you submitted photos of the damage through our app?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Yes lah, uploaded five photos ten minutes ago. You can check or not?

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Let me check. Yes, I see the broken ceramic set on my screen.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Good. So dispatch an express replacement set to my place before six PM.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Standard protocol requires collecting the damaged parcel first before sending a replacement item.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [scoff] Return broken shards leh?! You want me to ship sharp glass back?!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I understand your concern. Please hold two minutes while I check with dispatch.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [sigh] Fast hor, Jason. Don't leave me waiting on the line.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Thank you for holding, Mr. Tan. I just spoke with fulfillment.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: So how? Can send the rider down with the new set now?

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Unfortunately, that dinnerware set is completely out of stock across our regional warehouses.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [gasp] Out of stock?! But your website showed stock when I ordered!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: There was an inventory delay. I can process a refund in ten days.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [angry gasp] TEN DAYS?! My money is stuck and dinner is tonight!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I can issue immediate store credit so you can buy alternative plates.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [scoff] I don't want store credit lah! I want what I bought!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I understand, but we physically cannot ship an item that is unavailable.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Then courier stock from your Orchard retail outlet store to my home!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Our retail outlets run on separate inventory systems, so cross-fulfillment is not allowed.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Then what use are you meh?! Put your duty manager on now!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Sir, our supervisors are currently occupied, but I can log a request—

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [scoff] STOP GIVING EXCUSES LAH! YOU BREAK MY THINGS AND RUN AWAY MEH?!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I'm not running away. I can request a supervisor callback within twenty-four hours.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: TWENTY-FOUR HOURS?! GUESTS ARRIVE IN TWO HOURS LAH! ARE YOU DEAF OR WHAT?!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Sir, please lower your voice. Shouting will not bypass our system rules.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: SYSTEM RULES MY FOOT! YOUR SERVICE IS GARBAGE! CANCEL MY ENTIRE ACCOUNT NOW!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Closing your account now will void your pending damage claim, Mr. Tan.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [angry gasp] SHUT UP! TRANSFER ME TO A MANAGER THIS INSTANT OR I REPORT YOU TO CASE! DO IT NOW!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Welcome to ShopCart E-commerce Support. My name is David. Could I please have your name and order number?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Hello David. I'm Amirul. My order number is eight-eight-two, one-four-nine. Calling because I just saw my order is cancelled.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Thank you, Amirul. I'm sorry to hear about the cancellation. Let me pull up your account. Can I have the email address associated with the order for verification?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Sure, it is amirul dot hassan at gmail dot com. Actually, I didn't get any email saying it was cancelled, you know? Just saw it in the app.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: [typing] Got it, thank you for verifying. I see the order for the Smart Air Purifier here. Let me check the exact status of this transaction.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Yes, correct. The purifier. I check my credit card just now, the pending charge is still there, but the app says cancelled. Quite confusing lah.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I understand why that would be confusing. It looks like our system automatically flagged this because the specific fulfillment center closest to you reported a sudden inventory discrepancy.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Oh, I see. So it means no stock already? But yesterday when I order, the website still show got five units left.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: You're absolutely right, the website did show stock. We experienced a synchronization delay between the warehouse database and the storefront. I sincerely apologize for the lack of notification.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: It's okay. These system things happen kan. But how about my order now? Can we just transfer from another warehouse or not?

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: That is exactly what I'd like to look into. Do you mind if I place you on a brief hold for about two minutes while I check our national inventory?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Sure, no problem. I'll just wait on the line.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: [hold music plays briefly] Thank you for your patience, Amirul. I checked the secondary fulfillment centers, and unfortunately, we are completely out of this specific model nationwide.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [sigh] Aiya, that is quite unlucky. So how? Do I just need to cancel and wait for the refund to clear, or what is the standard procedure?

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Normally, yes, the refund would process automatically within three to five business days. However, since this was our system error and we failed to notify you, I want to explore a backup option.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Okay. What kind of backup option you mean?

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: We partner with third-party vendors for some of our electronics. I can try to place a direct manual requisition to a vendor to ship it to you at no extra cost. Would you like me to try that?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Oh, can do that? Okay, that would be very good. But will the price be the same? Because I bought it during the flash sale, you know.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Yes, absolutely. We will honor the flash sale price you initially paid. I'll need to contact the vendor desk to see if they can accept the manual routing. It might take another two or three minutes on hold.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Okay lah, I wait. As long as can get the item, I don't mind waiting a few minutes.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Thank you so much. Please bear with me, I will be right back.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [throat clear] Take your time.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: [typing sounds] Hello Amirul, are you still there?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Yes, still here.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Great news. I've successfully routed a new order through our premium vendor partner. They have confirmed the stock and have accepted the override at your flash sale price.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Ah, that is good to hear. So, I don't need to do anything on my side, right? Just wait for the new tracking number?

turns.text: Yes, hello. I am calling about a late fee on my credit card statement.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I can certainly look into that for you. Could I have your account number, please?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: It's four-five-eight-nine, one-two-two-three, nine-nine-zero-one, four-three-four-three.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Thank you. And for verification, your date of birth?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: First of March, nineteen eighty-two.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Perfect, thank you Mr. Chen. I see the account here.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: So, you can see the fifty dollar late fee, right?

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Yes, I do see a late fee posted on the fourteenth of this month.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: But I paid it on the twelfth leh. Before the deadline.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Let me check the payment history. Please bear with me for a moment.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [heavy sigh] Okay, I wait.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Thank you for holding. I see a payment initiated on the twelfth...

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: See? I told you already.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: However, it seems it didn't clear our system until the fifteenth, which is past the due date.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [scoff] That is YOUR system problem, not my problem what.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I understand your frustration, sir, but the terms state it takes three business days to clear.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Three days? Since when? Last time it was instant.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: We updated our processing policy last month, sir. An email was sent out regarding this change.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: You think I read all your spam emails meh? Can you just waive the fee?

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Let me see if you are eligible for a fee waiver. I will need to place you on a brief hold.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [heavy sigh] Just do it quickly, please.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Thank you for your patience. I'm afraid I cannot waive this fee.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Cannot? Why cannot?

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Our system shows you already had a courtesy waiver applied earlier this year in January.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [monotone] So what? That was for a different card.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: The policy applies across all accounts under your profile, unfortunately.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [cold laugh] Wow. Okay, fine. Just take my money then. Whatever.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Is there anything else I can assist you with today, Mr. Chen?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: No. Forget it. Don't even bother. [hangs up]

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [angry gasp] HELLO?! I ordered a wireless mechanical keyboard, but you sent me baby diapers lah! ARE YOU BLIND OR WHAT?! [scoff]

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I am very sorry for this mix-up, sir. Let me check your order number to arrange an exchange—

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [scoff] EXCHANGE WHAT LEH?! DO NOT GIVE ME EXCUSES! I NEED THAT KEYBOARD FOR MY WORK TODAY! SEND A DRIVER DOWN RIGHT NOW!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Our dispatch is closed for today, sir. You will need to drop it off at a locker first—

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [fuming] DROP OFF YOUR HEAD LAH! GET YOUR MANAGER ON THE LINE RIGHT NOW OR I AM CANCELLING MY VIP ACCOUNT IMMEDIATELY!

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Hello, my internet connection is completely down since morning. I am working from home, actually.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I see. Let me check the connection status for your area. Could you please confirm the blinking lights on your router?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [soft breath] Yes, only the power light is steady green. The internet light is not blinking at all, basically.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Thank you for confirming. It looks like a backend configuration dropped. I am pushing an update to your router right now. This will take about ten seconds.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Okay, let me check... Yes, all the lights are back to green now. The connection is working fine. Thank you.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: You're very welcome. I'm glad we could get that resolved for you. Have a great day.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Thank you for calling NovaGrid Enterprise Support. My name is Alex. May I please have your full name and corporate account ID to get started?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [anxious sigh] Yes, hello Alex. My name is Rohan Mehta, and my enterprise account ID is NG-94821. Actually, I am calling because of one very urgent issue with our software license today.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Thank you Mr. Mehta. I have your corporate account pulled up here. How can I assist you with NovaGrid today?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Today morning only our engineering team got locked out! The system shows 'License Expired - Error 701', but our accounts cleared the renewal last Thursday itself! In one hour I have a crucial client demonstration, so kindly do the needful!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I understand the urgency, Mr. Mehta. Our portal confirms your renewal was processed, but your local licensing daemon failed to fetch the updated validation certificate from the cloud server.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Oh, God! Can we do one thing? Is there any manual refresh button inside the console? Kindly tell me what to do, because right now my dashboard is totally blocked.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Let us try a forced sync. Please open NovaGrid Administrator, go to Settings, select Licensing, and click 'Sync with Cloud Server'.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Okay, clicking it now... [stressed gasp] Wait, Alex, it failed! It is throwing one big red pop-up saying 'Error 403: Hardware Footprint Hash Mismatch'! Oh NO, what does this mean? Will my entire database get corrupted now? Please tell me!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Don't worry, your database is completely safe. That error happens when the renewed license tries to bind to a cached machine identifier. I need to purge the stale hardware key on our backend cluster. May I place you on a brief two-minute hold while I reset it?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Yes, yes, definitely, please do the needful! No problem at all, I will hold the line only. Kindly make it as fast as possible, ya?

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Thank you for holding, Mr. Mehta. I have cleared the old node lock and generated a twenty-four character offline bypass key that will override the mismatch.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [relieved breath] Okay, thank goodness you are back, Alex! Tell me, where exactly should I enter this offline bypass key?

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: In the Licensing tab, click 'Activate Offline Manually'. The key is: NOVA, dash, SEVEN EIGHT, dash, OMEGA NINE, dash, OSCAR TWO. That is capital O, not zero.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Wait, wait, N-O-V-A, dash, 7-8, dash, OMEGA-9... [frustrated sigh] Oh, it said 'Invalid Checksum'! Wait, for that last block, did you say zero two or letter O two? I typed the digit zero only!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Ah, that explains it! It is uppercase letter O as in Oscar, followed by the number two. Please replace that zero with an O.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Okay, changing it to capital letter O... now clicking on 'Validate and Authorize License'... It is showing one spinning wheel now... please let it work, please work...

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Take your time. The licensing service is pinging the local socket to verify the cryptographic signature right now.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [gasps in disbelief] Wait! Alex! IT TURNED GREEN! A green badge popped up: 'Enterprise License Activated - Valid Through 2027'! And all my team's analytics workspaces just opened up! [warm laugh] OH MY GOD, IT WORKED!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Excellent! The heartbeat from your local server is green on our dashboard. All twelve cores and GPU clusters are fully unlocked.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [joyful laugh] WOW! You don't know what a HUGE relief this is, Alex! I was having pure panic attack thinking our high-stakes client demo was doomed! You resolved it so quickly and smoothly, genuinely BRILLIANT work! [warm chuckle] You are an absolute lifesaver, ya!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: It was truly my absolute pleasure, Mr. Mehta! I am so glad we got that sorted before your presentation. Is there anything else today?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Nothing else at all! Everything is running super fast! Thank you so much for your tremendous patience and kind support! You made my whole week, really! Have a wonderful day ahead, my friend! [cheerful laugh] BYE-BYE!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Hi, I see your new SIM isn't activated. I just pushed the update. Please restart your phone.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Okay, wait ah... WAH! Got signal already leh! [warm laugh] You are so fast!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Excellent! Glad that worked. Anything else for today?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: No need already lah! You saved my day, thank you so much!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Thank you for calling Apex Retail support. My name is Julian. May I have your order number and full name, please?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Marcus Lim here. Order is SG-88214. Need help urgent, lah.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Thank you, Mr. Lim. I see your order for the handcrafted Kyoto porcelain dining set. How can I help you today?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [sigh] Parcel arrived crushed and soaked! Half the ceramic bowls inside are shattered, sia! Totally ruined!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I'm terribly sorry. Have you uploaded photos of the damage through our app?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Uploaded five photos already, leh! This is for my parents' anniversary Saturday! Can send replacement immediately or not?

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I understand your concern. Please hold for a moment while I check our warehouse inventory for a replacement option.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [groan] Okay lah, be quick please.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Thanks for waiting, Mr. Lim. Sadly, that artisan set is completely out of stock nationwide.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [angry gasp] Out of stock?! Wah lau! Dinner is in two days! What alternative will you give me?

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Our policy requires you to pack the shards, drop them off at a depot, and—

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [furious scoff] ARE YOU CRAZY?! You expect me to pack broken glass and haul YOUR trash to a depot?!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Please calm down, sir. That return scan is mandatory before we can authorize any resolution.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: DON'T TELL ME TO CALM DOWN! Send a courier to collect your mess and REFUND ME NOW, LAH!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Let me check with my supervisor if we can waive the depot drop-off.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [heavy breathing] Better fix this fast. Ridiculous.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I checked, but the manager confirmed the system strictly blocks exceptions without physical depot intake.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [scoff] ARE YOU KIDDING ME?! PUT YOUR MANAGER ON THE LINE RIGHT NOW!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: He's in a closed meeting and cannot take inbound escalations, sir.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: DON'T LIE TO ME! I AM CANCELING MY MEMBERSHIP AND DISPUTING THIS WITH DBS BANK!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I apologize, Mr. Lim, but my hands are tied until the items reach our warehouse.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: TIED YOUR HEAD LAH! I'M REPORTING YOU TO CASE AND GOING TO SOCIAL MEDIA! YOU WATCH! [slams phone]

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Welcome to Global Standard Bank. My name is David. How can I assist you today?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Hello sir, a very good morning. Myself Rahul. I am calling regarding a transaction.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Good morning. I can certainly help. May I have your account number?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Yes, please note it down. It is four five two, eight eight one.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Thank you. For security purposes, confirm your date of birth.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: It is fourteenth of August, nineteen eighty-five.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Perfect, thank you. What seems to be the issue with the transaction?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [worried] Actually sir, fifty thousand rupees got deducted yesterday night. I haven't done it.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I understand your concern. Let me pull up your recent statement right away.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Kindly do the needful, sir. It is a huge amount for me.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I see a charge from 'Tech Solutions'. Does that ring any bells?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: NOT AT ALL! It is totally unrecognised. I was sleeping.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Okay, I will place you on a brief hold to check with our fraud division.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [sigh] Okay, I will wait on the line. Please check it thoroughly.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Thank you for your patience. I am back on the line.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Yes sir, please tell me. What is the status?

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: The transaction was flagged by our system, so the funds are only on hold.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Oh! So the money has not gone out completely?

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Exactly. Because it looked suspicious, we can reverse it right now.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [gasp] Are you serious? You can just reverse it back?

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Yes, I am cancelling it now and blocking your compromised debit card.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Oh my god, thank you so much! [warm laugh] I was so tense!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I have successfully reversed the fifty thousand into your available balance.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: I can see the SMS alert right now! [ecstatic] YOU ARE A LIFESAVER, sir!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I'm very glad we caught it. I will dispatch a new card today.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [warm laugh] Yes, please do! Your service is simply outstanding!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: It is my pleasure. The new card should arrive in three business days.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: That is perfectly fine. You have made my day completely!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I appreciate the kind words. Anything else you need assistance with?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Nothing else at all! God bless you. Have a wonderful shift!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Thank you so much. Have a great day and stay safe.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [happy] Same to you! Bye-bye!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Thank you for calling Apex Retail customer support. My name is Kevin. How may I assist you today?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [sigh] Order number is AR-88410. I checked the app today morning itself, and my confirmed order is simply cancelled.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I can certainly check that. Before proceeding, could you confirm your full name and phone number?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Rohan Mehta. Phone is 9820-551-402. No email came, no SMS came, nothing at all.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Thank you, Mr. Mehta. I have your file open. You're referring to the Philips Air Fryer ordered Tuesday?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Yes, correct. It was a gift for my parents' anniversary tomorrow. Why was it silently cancelled without informing me?

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I see the cancellation flag, but no reason. May I place you on a two-minute hold while I check fulfillment logs?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [sigh] Haan, fine. Put on hold only. What else to do anyway.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Thank you for waiting, Mr. Mehta. Our system triggered an automated cancellation because—

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: —WAIT, automated cancellation? How you people can simply wipe out a confirmed order without notice?

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Our facility had an inventory sync error. The stock showed available online, but physically was depleted.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [scoff] Very nice. Superb system. Money is deducted, and you don't even bother updating the customer.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: The refund was processed automatically. You can re-order the unit from an alternate seller on our portal.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [bitter chuckle] Re-order? That seller is charging four thousand rupees extra! Why should I pay for your mistake?

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I understand your frustration. Let me consult my supervisor to see if we can price-match.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [heavy sigh] Go ask only. But I know very well nothing useful will happen.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I spoke with my supervisor. Unfortunately, policy strictly prohibits manual price-matching on marketplace listings.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [cold scoff] Exactly what I expected. Sitting and waiting three days, and in the end, zero help.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I apologize. As a courtesy, I can credit a two-hundred-rupee promotional voucher to your wallet.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [tired scoff] Two hundred rupees? Keep it yaar. Buy yourself tea. Don't do charity for me.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I understand your disappointment, Mr. Mehta. Aside from this, is there anything else I can assist with?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [long sigh] No, nothing. Don't touch anything else, otherwise you'll cancel my account also. Just leave it. I am hanging up.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Thank you for calling tech support, how may I assist you today?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [angry gasp] I AM TELLING YOU, THIS PRINTER IS SHOWING OFFLINE SINCE MORNING!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I apologize for the inconvenience. Let's check your Wi-Fi connection.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: WHAT WI-FI?! [scoff] I ALREADY RESTARTED EVERYTHING! ARE YOU EVEN LISTENING?!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Sir, if we just look at the IP settings—

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: NO MORE SETTINGS! DO THE NEEDFUL AND CONNECT ME TO YOUR MANAGER!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Please, I need to troubleshoot first before escalating.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: NONSENSE! I AM CANCELLING MY CONTRACT RIGHT NOW! [angry gasp] GOODBYE!

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: I waited since morning itself, but your courier simply didn't turn up.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I'm sorry, sir. Let me check the driver's delivery log right now.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [scoff] Great log. Status says 'customer unavailable', which is complete nonsense only.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I apologize. I can rebook the courier for first thing tomorrow.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [sigh] Tomorrow? No ya, same drama will happen again.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I will personally ensure the driver calls before arriving—

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [sigh] Leave it na. Don't bother. Just cancel the order.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: E-Cart Customer Support. My name is Liam. How can I help?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Hello? Liam? I am very angry right now!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I'm sorry. Could I have your order number?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Order number eight eight nine two!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Thank you. Let me pull up your account.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [sigh] Be quick lah! I don't have all day!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Can you confirm your delivery address for verification?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Block one two three, Bishan Street!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Thank you. What is the issue with your order?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [angry gasp] You sent me the WRONG ITEM!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I apologize. What exactly did you receive?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: I ordered a rice cooker, but got a kettle!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: A kettle instead of a rice cooker? I see...

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: WHY LIKE THAT LAH? I need it for tonight!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I understand. Let me check the warehouse status.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Check what check? Just send it today!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Please hold while I contact dispatch.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Don't put me on hold! Hello?!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: [hold music plays] Thank you for waiting, Mr. Tan.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [scoff] When is it coming? My guests are arriving!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Unfortunately, we cannot deliver it today.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: CANNOT DELIVER TODAY? Are you joking with me?

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: The item is out of stock locally.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Out of stock?! Why your website say got stock?

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: There was an inventory sync error on our end.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: I DON'T CARE! This is ridiculous lah!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: We can ship it tomorrow morning instead.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: TOMORROW IS TOO LATE! I want your manager!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I can transfer you to a supervisor, but...

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Just transfer! Pass the phone to your boss!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Please hold while I connect you.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Do it fast! I'm losing patience!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: [hold music plays] My manager is on another call.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [angry groan] WORST SERVICE EVER! I WANT A REFUND!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I can process a refund right now.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: CANCEL MY ACCOUNT! NEVER BUYING FROM YOU AGAIN!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I will initiate the cancellation immediately, sir.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: JUST DO IT! USELESS! [slams phone]

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Horizon Telecom broadband support, Kevin speaking. How may I assist you today, sir?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [sigh] This is Rajesh Sharma. My fiber broadband is crawling like an ant since morning itself!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I am sorry, Mr. Sharma. May I have your account number to check?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: My account number is eight-two-four-one-nine, flat four-B Green Valley. Please check quickly, ya.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Thank you. Accessing your file now. [typing sounds] Yes, I have you verified, Mr. Sharma.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Good. Now listen, I am paying for five hundred Mbps, but getting two Mbps only!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I see. Are you connected via Wi-Fi or direct Ethernet cable right now?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Both I tried, ya! Even sitting right next to the router, nothing is opening at all.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Understood. Is the optical fiber PON indicator green on your router?

turns.speaker: customer
