turns.text: [scoff] PON is green, power is green. Everything green except the speed itself!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Let us restart the gateway. Please disconnect the power plug for thirty seconds.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [frustrated grunt] I did that thrice before calling! Why ask me to repeat again?

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: A fresh reboot forces our server to refresh your dynamic connection profile, sir.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Fine, powered on again. [exhale] Look, lights are back, but still only two Mbps!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Thank you. I must run a backend line diagnostic. May I place you on hold?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Make it fast, please. I have an urgent international client call in fifteen minutes.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Back in two minutes, sir. [hold music playing] Thank you for waiting. I am back, Mr. Sharma.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Yes, tell me. Did your backend test find any issue?

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: The physical fiber signal to your terminal is healthy with zero packet loss.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: If line is healthy, why is my internet completely stuck, tell me?

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Diagnostics show heavy traffic saturation on your neighborhood splitter hub right now.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [scoff] Saturation? I pay three thousand rupees monthly specifically for dedicated high speed!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Our residential broadband plans provide speeds up to five hundred Mbps subject to network traffic.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Do not make excuses! Fix the bandwidth bottleneck from your side immediately!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I cannot change hub bandwidth remotely. I can schedule a field technician visit.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Fine, send someone today itself. Send a technician within two hours!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Our earliest available appointment in your area is Thursday afternoon between two and five.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [angry gasp] THURSDAY? ARE YOU MAD? TODAY IS MONDAY! HOW WILL I WORK?

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I understand your emergency, Mr. Sharma, but our field technicians are fully booked until—

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: DO NOT GIVE ME EXCUSES! I AM LOSING BUSINESS AND THOUSANDS RIGHT NOW!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Sir, please do not shout. I am following company technical support protocols.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: I WILL SHOUT! YOU ARE DOING COMPLETE TIMEPASS WHILE MY WORK DIES!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I can log an urgent supervisor escalation ticket regarding the delay, sir.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: TICKET? KEEP YOUR USELESS TICKET! TRANSFER ME TO YOUR DUTY MANAGER RIGHT NOW!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: The duty manager is handling other escalations and currently unavailable for calls.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: LIAR! YOU ARE BLOCKING ME! PUT SOMEONE SENIOR ON THIS LINE IMMEDIATELY!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I cannot transfer without an available manager, sir. I can only book Thursday.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: CANCEL MY ENTIRE CONNECTION RIGHT THIS SECOND! I AM FILING A REGULATOR FRAUD COMPLAINT TODAY ITSELF! RIDICULOUS SERVICE!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Horizon Bank, Alex speaking. How can I help?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Hi Alex. My card have one fifty dollar charge from yesterday, but I didn't buy anything. Can you help me check?

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: [inhale] Let me pull up your account... ah, I see it. That is your annual card fee.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Oh, I see. Is it possible to cancel this fee?

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Yes, I can go ahead and waive that for you today.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [sigh] Okay, that is great. Please help me waive it. Thank you.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: All done. The credit will reflect tomorrow. Anything else?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: No, that is all. Thank you. Goodbye.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [clears throat] Hello, good morning. I am trying to log into the banking app, but it keeps giving me a network timeout error lah.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Good morning. I can check that for you right away. Did you update the app recently to the latest build?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Yes, I updated yesterday night. Since then, cannot reach the main dashboard at all.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Understood. Please go into your phone settings, clear the app cache, and relaunch it.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Okay, let me do that. [pause] Cleared already. Oh, the login screen popped up, can sign in already lah.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Wonderful, everything is back to normal now. Have a very good day ahead.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Hello, telecom support. How can I assist you today?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Good morning. My internet is running very slow since yesterday.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I see. Let me send a refresh signal to your router.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Kindly do the needful. I will wait.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: [typing] Okay, the signal is sent. Please check.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [pause] Yes, the speed is coming properly now.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Perfect. Do you need help with anything else?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: No, that is all. Thank you.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Thank you for calling Apex Retail. My name is Priya. May I have your order ID?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [flatly] Rajesh Kumar here. Order ID is nine-four-two-two.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Thank you. Could you also confirm your registered mobile number?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Nine-eight-four-five-zero, double-two-one. That is verified now?

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Yes. I see your order for a Philips mixer grinder yesterday.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Correct. But what arrived is three plastic storage containers only.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I apologize for that. Did the carton appear tampered with?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [scoff] Fully sealed. Simply the completely wrong item packed inside.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Understood. Could you read the code printed on the shipping label?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: It says B-X-four-zero-nine. What does that mean?

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: That code is for plastic containers. Let me check the dispatch logs.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [sigh] Please check. My family lunch is tomorrow itself.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I understand. The dispatch log shows this parcel was scanned as—

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [scoff] Scanned whatever, madam! The fact is I have plastic boxes.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Allow me two minutes on hold to consult the warehouse supervisor.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [heavy sigh] Yes, put on hold only. What else to do.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Thank you for holding, Mr. Kumar. I spoke with the warehouse.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [flatly] And? What great solution do you have?

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Unfortunately, that mixer grinder is completely out of stock everywhere.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [bitter chuckle] Out of stock. Brilliant. Simply first class.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: We can book a return, but warehouse inspection takes seven working days.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Seven days? To inspect plastic boxes your people sent by mistake?

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Policy requires physical verification before we can approve any refund.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Then do one thing, credit the amount directly to my card.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: The system automatically locks refunds until the return package is scanned.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [weary sigh] So no mixer, and five thousand rupees stuck also.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I can place a priority escalation to speed up courier pickup.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: And how long will that priority take? Three days?

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Priority courier assignment usually takes forty-eight to seventy-two hours.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [coldly] Fantastic. So tomorrow I should grind masala in plastic boxes.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I understand your anger, sir. Shall I book the return request?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [monotone] No. Do not book anything. Just leave it.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Sir, without booking it, the seven-day return window will expire.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [sigh] Let it expire. I have no energy for this circus.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Mr. Kumar, I genuinely want to help resolve this situation.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [flatly] You cannot resolve anything. Your system is totally useless.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Please let me arrange a supervisor call-back within one hour.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [resigned sigh] Nobody will call. Keep your plastic boxes. I am done.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Thanks for calling IT helpdesk. My name is Kevin. How can I help you today?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [heavy sigh] My Outlook app stopped syncing two days ago lah. No new mail coming in at all.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I see. Let's start by clearing your local cache or checking your IMAP settings in the—

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [scoff] Already done three times, okay? Still showing the same server timeout error lor.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Understood. Could you try removing the account completely, rebooting your laptop, and re-authenticating?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [dry chuckle] Reboot again meh? Standard script as usual lah. Nothing ever gets fixed here.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: If that fails, I can escalate a ticket to Tier Two network operations, but it takes forty-eight hours.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [defeated sigh] Forty-eight hours? Forget it then. Waste of time only. I'll just use webmail lor. Bye.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Customer care, how may I help you?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [warm laugh] Bhai, wrong jacket came, but it is STUNNING!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Let me check that delivery for you.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Can I just keep this one itself?

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Yes, keep it as a complimentary gift!

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [gasp] MAGNIFICENT! You made my whole day, thanks!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: You are most welcome!

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [delighted giggle] BEST service ever, cheers!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Enterprise Tech Support, David speaking. How may I assist you with your equipment?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [angry gasp] LISTEN LAH! My office printer is offline since morning, and I have urgent client contracts that CANNOT PRINT!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I understand the urgency. Could you check whether the printer's Wi-Fi light is blinking or—

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [scoff] DON'T TALK RUBBISH LEH! Light is solid blue, but driver cannot detect! FIX THIS NOW!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I apologize, sir. Let us try resetting your office print spooler service right—

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [furious groan] RESET AGAIN MEH?! GET ME YOUR MANAGER IMMEDIATELY OR I CANCEL OUR WHOLE CORPORATE ACCOUNT TODAY!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Thank you for calling Apex Telecom Fiber Support. My name is Kevin. May I please have your registered account number and your full name to get started?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [clears throat] Yes, hello Kevin. My name is Rajesh Iyer, and my customer account ID is BLR-904218. I am calling because my fiber broadband is completely down since morning itself.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Thank you, Mr. Iyer. I have your account pulled up here for your Koramangala residence. [keystrokes] I can see the connection is offline. Could you tell me what lights are showing on your optical terminal?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Actually, on the Nokia ONT box, the Power light is solid green, but the PON light is completely off, and the LOS indicator is continuously blinking red only.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Understood. A blinking red LOS light means the unit is not receiving an optical signal from our exchange. Let us check the yellow fiber patch cord. Is it firmly connected to the green port underneath?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [pause] Yes, I am checking it right now. The green connector is clicked firmly into the socket, and there are no sharp bends in the cable. I rebooted the box earlier also, but no change.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Alright, thank you for checking that. Let me run an optical time-domain reflectometer test on our line card. May I place you on a brief hold for about two minutes while I check the neighborhood splitter?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Sure, no issue at all Kevin. Kindly take your time and do the needful. I will be on the line.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: [pleasant tone] Thank you for holding, Mr. Iyer. Our line diagnostics indicate the main distribution fiber is healthy, but your specific port on the street distribution point has gone into an administrative shutdown state after a power surge.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Ah, I see. So there was no physical wire cut outside? I had a doubt that perhaps some road digging work had snapped the cable nearby.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: No physical cut, fortunately. I am initiating a soft reset and re-provisioning of your port from our backend switch right now. [keystrokes] Could you keep an eye on the ONT lights for the next thirty seconds?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [exhales quietly] Yes, I am watching it. The LOS light stopped blinking red for a second, but now it has turned solid amber. Is that expected behavior, or has it failed again?

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: That is part of the handshake cycle, Mr. Iyer. The unit is re-authenticating with the OLT. I am pushing the VLAN configuration and DHCP profile to your terminal right now.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Okay, noted. Yes, now the amber light has vanished, and the PON light is flashing green rapidly. It seems it is trying to register with the network.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: [reassuring tone] That is excellent. The PON LED should turn solid green momentarily once the session locks in. Could you verify if the Internet LED on your separate Wi-Fi router is lighting up?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Wait, one moment. [pause] The PON light has turned steady green now, but on the Archer router, the internet globe icon is still showing orange. My laptop still shows no internet access.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Understood. Your router simply needs to renew its WAN lease. Could you please unplug the power cable from your Archer router for ten seconds, plug it back in, and let it sync?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Doing that right now. Power adapter disconnected... waiting... and plugging it back in. [pause] Okay, the router is booting up, LEDs are cycling. Let us see.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Take your time, Mr. Iyer. It usually takes forty-five seconds for the PPPoE session to establish and pull a valid IP address. Let me know when the internet LED changes color.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [subtle chuckle] Yes, the globe icon just turned solid blue. Let me just test opening a webpage... yes, my office VPN and email portal are loading up instantly now. The connection is back.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Wonderful! I have verified from my side as well, your downstream and upstream optical signal levels are at a perfect negative eighteen dBm. Is everything performing at your expected speed?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Yes, I ran a quick speed test, and it is giving the full three hundred Mbps. Everything is in order. Thank you very much for your prompt assistance, Kevin. Have a good day.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Thank you for calling Apex Broadband. My name is Kevin. May I have your account number, please?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Yes, it is AC-984421. I am Rajesh Patel, and my internet is dead since morning itself!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Thank you, Mr. Patel. Let me pull up your account records. Just a moment, please.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Kindly check fast! I have urgent office meetings and nothing is working on the router!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I see your fiber line active. Could you check the LOS light on your terminal box?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [sigh] The LOS light is blinking red continuously, blinking only!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Understood. Please unplug the power adapter for thirty seconds to power cycle the terminal.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: I have done this restart three times already! Still it is flashing red only!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I understand. Please allow me two minutes on hold while I run a central diagnostic test.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [scoff] Fine, put on hold, but make it fast, please!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Thank you for holding, Mr. Patel. The test confirms a physical fiber cut at your street junction.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [gasp] Fiber cut? When will your technician come to rectify this?

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Our earliest field slot is day after tomorrow between two and five PM.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: DAY AFTER TOMORROW? ARE YOU COMPLETELY OUT OF YOUR MIND?

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Sir, our technicians are fully booked for emergency maintenance today—

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: DO NOT GIVE ME THIS RUBBISH EXCUSE! I AM LOSING CLIENTS EVERY SINGLE MINUTE!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I understand your urgency, sir, but our dispatch policy prevents overbooking—

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: WHAT SENSELESS POLICY? YOU ARE DOING TIME PASS WHILE MY WORK IS DESTROYED!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Sir, please lower your voice. I can log an expedite request, but cannot guarantee arrival.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: I WILL NOT LOWER MY VOICE! CONNECT ME TO YOUR SENIOR MANAGER RIGHT NOW!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: My supervisor is in a meeting and unavailable to take calls right now.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [angry scoff] THIS IS SHAMELESS NONSENSE! YOU REFUSE TO DISPATCH ANYONE AND YOUR MANAGER IS HIDING!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Sir, I can transfer you to cancellation, but the repair slot cannot be moved.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: CANCEL MY CONNECTION TODAY ITSELF! I AM FILING A CONSUMER COMPLAINT AGAINST YOUR PATHETIC SERVICE!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Thank you for contacting ApexMart Customer Care. My name is Bryan. May I have your full name and order reference number, please?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Hello, Bryan. [sigh] Farhan Razali here. Order ID is MY-98234-KL. Please check fast, lah. I have waited over two weeks, and still nothing shows up at my door.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Thank you, Mr. Farhan. For security verification, could you also confirm the registered delivery postal code and the email address tied to your account?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Postcode is 47500 Subang Jaya, email farhan.razali@mailnet.my. Alamak, brother, tracking is stuck on 'Out for Delivery' since last Tuesday! It is an expensive camera lens, three thousand ringgit, not some cheap toy, you know?

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Thank you for confirming those details, Mr. Farhan. Let me pull up the internal logistics telemetry for MY-98234-KL right now to see what's happening with the transit hub.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Check properly, okay? A birthday gift for my brother last weekend! Now his birthday passed, and I look like a fool waiting every day for your dispatch van!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I completely understand your frustration. The record shows an abnormal status flag from the regional depot. May I place you on a brief two-minute hold while I ring the logistics dispatch supervisor directly?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [sigh] Fine, go ahead. But don't put me on hold for half an hour, ah. Settle this today, please.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: [clears throat] Thank you for holding, Mr. Farhan. I managed to connect with the courier terminal. Regrettably, their driver logged the parcel as 'Delivered - Left at Guardhouse' yesterday evening, with a blurred photo attached.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [scoff] What nonsense are you talking about?! Left at guardhouse? My condominium does not even have a guardhouse, lah! We have an intercom gate! Who received it, huh? Did anyone sign for it?

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Looking at the manifest, there is no digital signature recorded, only an automated GPS ping three kilometers away from your street. It appears the driver may have misrouted or misplaced the container.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [angry gasp] YOU MISPLACED A THREE THOUSAND RINGGIT LENS?! [slams desk] How can your driver simply dump a parcel three kilometers away and tick delivered?! THAT IS STEALING, WEI! Don't tell me 'misplaced' like it fell under a sofa!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Sir, please calm down. I understand this is distressing, but shouting will not resolve it. We need to open an official courier audit inquiry, which takes approximately seven to fourteen working days to conclude.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: FOURTEEN DAYS?! Are you insane, hah?! [groan] You lost my package through your courier's stupidity, and now ask me to wait two more weeks?! Send a replacement today or refund my card immediately, lah!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Under company policy, high-value goods exceeding one thousand ringgit require the courier investigation report to be finalized before our finance department can approve a merchant refund or authorize a warehouse replacement release.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [shouting] I DON'T CARE ABOUT YOUR POLICY, LAH! YOU TOOK MY MONEY IN TWO SECONDS, BUT WHEN YOU LOSE MY ITEM, YOU HIDE BEHIND AN AUDIT?! THIS IS FRAUD! YOU ARE RUNNING A SCAM!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Mr. Farhan, I must formally ask you to maintain a professional tone. If the abusive language continues, I will be forced to terminate this call. We must follow standard procedure.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [furious scoff] TERMINATE MY CALL?! YOU DARE THREATEN ME?! PASS ME TO YOUR MANAGER RIGHT NOW! DO NOT WASTE MY TIME WITH YOUR ROBOT EXCUSES! GET ME SOMEONE WHO HAS THE BRAINS AND AUTHORITY TO RETURN MY MONEY IMMEDIATELY!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: All duty supervisors are currently tied up in emergency escalation meetings. I can only log an internal manager callback request for you, which will be processed within twenty-four to forty-eight operational hours.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [explosive shout] FORTY-EIGHT HOURS?! GO TO HELL WITH YOUR CALLBACK, WEI! I AM GOING STRAIGHT TO THE CONSUMER TRIBUNAL, THE POLICE, AND SOCIAL MEDIA! I WILL CANCEL MY ACCOUNT, FILE A BANK CHARGEBACK, AND SUE YOU! DO NOT EVER TOUCH MY MONEY AGAIN!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: [flustered sigh] Mr. Farhan, please, if you will just allow me to submit the—

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Singtel Helpdesk, this is Rachel. Are you calling regarding the fiber broadband disruption in Tampines?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [heavy sigh] Ya lah, whole morning down already. Cannot even load one webpage, you know.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I understand. Our field team is currently resetting the optical terminal on site—

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [scoff] Reset again ah? [sigh] Two hours ago you also say resetting. Still blinking red light what.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: We are monitoring the signal loss now. It might take another two to three hours before—

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [flatly] Three hours more? [weary sigh] Forget it lah, no point talking. Never mind.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Apex Support, Jason speaking. How can I help you today?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [clears throat] Hi Jason, my parcel status shows delivered, but nothing arrived lah.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I can check that. May I have your order number?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Yes, it is MY-882104.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Thank you. And your full name and address for verification?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Farah Razak, unit 12-04, Block B.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Thanks. System shows delivered yesterday at four PM.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Ya, but I was home. Nobody knocked at all.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Did the courier upload a drop-off photo in the app?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Got photo, but the gate is green. My gate is black one.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I see. Let me place you on a brief hold to call dispatch.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Sure, boleh. I will wait.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Thank you, please hold for a moment.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [quiet breath] No problem.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Thanks for holding, Ms. Farah. Dispatch checked with the driver.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Okay, what did the driver say?

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: He mistakenly delivered it to Block D instead of Block B.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Aiyoh. Can he retrieve it back?

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: He went back, but nobody answered unit 12-04 at Block D.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [soft sigh] I see. What can we do now?

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Since it's our error, I can send an immediate priority replacement.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: That works lah. When will it arrive?

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: By six PM today via express courier.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Okay, that is acceptable.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Your replacement order number is EXP-9041.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: EXP-9041, noted.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I also credited a ten-ringgit shipping voucher to your account.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [polite chuckle] Thank you, appreciate that.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: You will receive an SMS confirmation in a few moments.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Ah, yes, just received the text.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Great. Anything else I can assist with today?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: No, that settles it lah. Thank you.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: You are welcome. Have a wonderful day ahead.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: You too, Jason. Take care.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Goodbye, Ms. Farah.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Bye-bye.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Goodbye.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Hello brother, my office printer keep showing offline lah, cannot connect at all. I need to print this client contract super urgently, can help me check?

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Hello! Don't worry, I can help you sort that out right away. Let's restart the Windows print spooler service together.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Okay okay, I go to services and click restart spooler now ah... [warm laugh] Eh, the yellow warning light just turned green!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: That's a very promising sign! Could you please send a quick test page through to verify it prints?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: OH WOW, IT IS PRINTING OUT NOW! [cheering] Fantastic lah, you are truly a wizard, thank you so, so much!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: You're very welcome! I'm delighted everything is working smoothly. Have a fantastic day ahead!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Thank you for calling Apex Crest Bank Lending Support. My name is Marcus. May I please have your full name and application reference number to get started?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Yes, hello. My name is Zhang Weimin. The reference number is LN-nine-zero-four-two-one-eight. Please check for me quick, I am waiting for three days already.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Thank you, Mr. Zhang. Before I access your file, could you please verify your registered date of birth and the current mailing postal code for security?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [impatient sigh] Fourteenth of August, nineteen eighty-six. Postal code five-six-zero-two-one-two. Quick please, the contractor is pressing me for payment today.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Thank you for confirming that, Mr. Zhang. Your identity is verified. Let me pull up your loan application dashboard here in our system. Just one moment.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: You see, Monday your branch officer told me three working days definitely approved and funds disbursed directly. Today is Thursday already ah! Why nothing inside my account?

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I understand your concern. Looking at loan application LN-nine-zero-four-two-one-eight, I see the sixty-thousand-dollar bridging loan record. However, there appears to be a compliance hold placed on Tuesday afternoon.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [sharp gasp] Compliance hold? What compliance hold?! I submitted all my payslips, tax assessment notice, everything clear and complete already! How can you hold without even telling me?

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I completely understand why that is concerning. The underwriting note indicates an income discrepancy between the automated salary feed and your submitted Notice of Assessment. Allow me to place you on a brief two-minute hold while I consult underwriting.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [scoff] Consult now! Make sure you fix this fast! I am holding on line, do not waste my time!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Thank you for holding, Mr. Zhang. I spoke directly with our senior underwriter. Regrettably, because the supplemental employer declaration letter was unsigned, the system flagged the packet and automatically suspended processing yesterday. We cannot disburse until a new signed form is submitted.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: WHAT DID YOU JUST SAY?! [explosive gasp] YOU SUSPENDED IT?! I HAD THE BRANCH MANAGER PHYSICALLY SIGN AND CHOP THE ORIGINAL COPY BEFORE SUBMITTING! ARE YOU BLIND OR WHAT?!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Sir, please lower your voice. The uploaded digital scan in our central repository is missing the authorized signature on page three, which is why underwriting halted it.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: LOWER MY VOICE?! YOU ARE HOLDING MY SIXTY THOUSAND DOLLARS! MY RENOVATION CONTRACTOR IS LOCKING MY FLAT DOOR TODAY BECAUSE YOUR INCOMPETENT STAFF LOST MY SIGNATURE PAGE! HOW CAN LIKE THAT?!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I apologize for the immense frustration, Mr. Zhang. If you can re-upload the signed page three via our secure web portal right now, I can flag it for expedited manual review.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: MANUAL REVIEW TAKE HOW LONG?! ANOTHER THREE DAYS MEH?! I CANNOT WAIT ANOTHER HOUR! YOU DISBURSE MY APPROVED MONEY RIGHT NOW TODAY! THIS IS YOUR BANK MISTAKE, NOT MINE!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Standard expedited review takes twenty-four to forty-eight banking hours after receipt of the verified document. Our system will not allow manual fund release overrides without complete underwriter clearance.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: DO NOT TALK TO ME ABOUT YOUR STUPID SYSTEM! [furious table slam] TRANSFER ME TO YOUR DUTY MANAGER RIGHT THIS SECOND! BRING SOMEONE WHO ACTUALLY HAS THE POWER TO RELEASE MY MONEY!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I can place you into the queue for a supervisor, but current hold times exceed forty-five minutes, and our supervisory desk operates under the exact same lending compliance protocol. They cannot bypass this regulation either.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: FORTY-FIVE MINUTES?! YOU ARE CHEATING CUSTOMERS! I AM NOT WAITING! I WILL SUE YOUR WHOLE BANK! I WILL FILE A COMPLAINT TO THE MONETARY AUTHORITY THIS VERY MORNING! YOU WILL PAY FOR ALL MY CONTRACTOR PENALTIES!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Sir, I have documented your formal complaint and noted the urgency on your file. Beyond receiving that signed document or connecting you to the supervisor queue, I am unable to force an immediate payout today.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [loud furious scream] USELESS! ABSOLUTELY USELESS BANK! CANCEL EVERY SINGLE ACCOUNT I HAVE WITH YOU! I AM GOING TO YOUR HEADQUARTERS RIGHT NOW TO MAKE A HUGE SCENE UNTIL EVERYONE KNOWS WHAT FRAUD YOU RUN! [violent phone slam]

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Hey Shawn! After clearing the print queue like you said, the printer suddenly woke up already lah! [gasp] IT'S PRINTING!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: That's wonderful! The stuck spooler was definitely keeping it offline.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [warm laugh] Wah, you really saved my life today, thank you SO MUCH leh!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Glad I could help. Everything running smoothly now?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Super smooth! You're an absolute legend, really appreciate it lah!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Thank you for calling Apex Care Support. My name is David. May I please have your full name and laptop serial number to pull up your account?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Yes, hello. Name is Mei-Ling Zhou. The serial number right, is L-N-eight-nine-zero-four-J. My laptop cannot power on at all today.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Thank you, Ms. Zhou. I have your file open. I'm sorry to hear that. Could you describe what happens when you press the power button?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: I press the power button right, the small white light blink one time, then nothing. Screen stay pitch black. No fan sound, no boot chime, completely dead already.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Understood. Is your original charger plugged directly into the wall, and do you see the amber charging indicator glowing beside the port?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Yes, adapter is original, plugged directly into wall socket. The amber light is on, steady light. But laptop still won't turn on at all, completely no reaction.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Got it. Let's do a static discharge. Please unplug the charger, then hold down the power button for thirty seconds to drain residual board power.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [heavy sigh] Aiyah, I already did that twice before calling, but okay lah... I hold it now. One, two, three... thirty. Plug back in, press power... [sigh] See? NOTHING happens. Same thing.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Thank you for trying. Next, let's test the screen. When you press power, tap the F2 key repeatedly to see if we can trigger BIOS or—

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [flat scoff] Look, I already told you, the machine is NOT EVEN spinning the fan! Tapping F2 is totally useless when the whole motherboard has zero power, right?

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I understand, Ms. Zhou. This does indicate a power rail issue. Please hold for two minutes while I consult Tier Two and verify repair options.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [sigh] Fine, put me on hold lah. Go check. I wait.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Thank you for waiting, Ms. Zhou. I spoke with Tier Two. Because the power rails fail to distribute voltage, the motherboard requires depot replacement.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [bitter chuckle] System board replacement. So what does that mean practically? How long will I be without my computer?

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: You would need to ship the unit to our central repair depot. Right now, replacement boards for this model are on component backorder, so the turnaround time is approximately three to four weeks.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Three to four weeks? [scoff] That is ridiculous. My entire master thesis data is inside there, and my defense submission is due next Monday already. Can you send someone on-site?

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I deeply apologize, but on-site motherboard swaps aren't covered under the standard limited warranty. Furthermore, depot policy requires a full storage wipe and re-image during mainboard replacement for firmware recalibration, so data would not be preserved.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [heavy sigh] You want to wipe my drive as well? Fantastic. Just fantastic. So not only I wait one month, all my research files are gone too.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I know how stressful that is. We do offer an expedited out-of-warranty data extraction service through our partner lab, but that carries a separate diagnostic charge starting at three hundred and fifty dollars.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [hopeless monotone] Pay another three hundred fifty dollars? On top of waiting four weeks for a broken laptop? No use one lah. Every solution you give just costs more money and wastes more time.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I truly wish I had a faster resolution for you today, Ms. Zhou. Would you like me to leave the RMA ticket open or email you the service quote so you can review your options?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [cold sigh] Don't bother lah. No point keeping it open. Just cancel the ticket. I will just go buy another brand. Forget it. Goodbye.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Tech Support, I see your network printer is showing offline?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [heavy sigh] Ya lah. Reboot router three times already, still offline. Super great.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Let's check the IP address on the printer screen so we can—

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [scoff] Don't bother lah. The screen also totally blank. Useless one.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: We can try a hard power reset on the wall socket—

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [weary sigh] Forget it lor. Not like it'll work anyway. Bye.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Hi, I spotted an unfamiliar eighty-ringgit charge on my card lah. Can check?

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Looking at it now, it is a pre-authorisation hold from Petronas.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Ah, [soft chuckle] I did pump petrol earlier ya. Will it drop off?

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Yes, it reverses automatically by midnight.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Understood, thank you for clearing that up.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Apex Bank card support, Sarah speaking. How can I help you today?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [heavy sigh] Look, I'm stranded in London and my card is blocked only. I have to pay my hotel deposit right now.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I can check that. For security reasons, can you please verify—

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [scoff] Don't ask OTPs yaar. I updated my travel notice in the mobile app itself yesterday.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I see, but our fraud system triggered a hard lock. It requires visiting your Mumbai home branch in person.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [weary scoff] Brilliant. Visit Mumbai while I am standing outside Heathrow in the rain. Just magnificent.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I do apologize, sir, but there is no remote override on this system.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [long exhausted sigh] Forget it. No use talking only. I will manage somehow. Goodbye.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Thank you for calling Apex Cloud Enterprise Support. My name is Sean. May I have your full name and account ID, please?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Hi Sean, yes. I'm Kelvin Tan, account ID is K-T-8-4-9-2. Need some help here lah.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Thank you, Mr. Tan. Let me verify that. Could you confirm the registered business email on the file?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Sure, it is kelvin.tan@vanguard-sg.com.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Verification successful, thank you. What seems to be the trouble you're experiencing today?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: I got locked out of the admin console. I tried resetting the password twice, but the reset link didn't arrive, then the system locked me out leh.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Understood. Account lockouts usually occur after multiple attempts, or when security flags the IP. Let me pull up your identity profile.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Okay, sure. Take your time.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I see the active lock on Kelvin Tan. Before I can trigger a manual override, I need to place you on a brief hold for one to two minutes to verify security telemetry. Is that alright?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: No problem, go ahead lah. I will wait.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: [clears throat] Thank you for holding, Mr. Tan. I appreciate your patience.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Sure, no worries. What's the status?

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Well, we have a slight hiccup. When I tried to trigger the standard security token, the directory server returned an authentication mismatch error code 4-0-3.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Oh, 4-0-3? That means permission issue meh? I am the primary domain admin though.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Right. It appears the automated token generator was out of sync with your regional Singapore cluster after last night's directory update.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [sighs softly] Ah, I see. So what do we need to do now?

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I need to escalate this to our tier two identity gateway to clear the stale session cache manually. It will take just thirty seconds while I patch the bypass.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Alright, please go ahead. As long as we can get it sorted.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Working on it right now... okay, the tier two bypass cleared the cached lock.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Okay, good. Do I try logging in again?

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Not just yet. I have dispatched a secure, one-time temporary access code directly to your mobile number ending in 9-1-2.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Let me check my phone... yes, SMS received just now. It is 7-4-1-9-0-2.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Great. I am inputting that into the override console now. The lockout state has cleared. Please navigate to the portal and enter your username.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Okay, I entered my username. Now it prompts for the temporary password.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I have just sent the temporary alphanumeric password to your corporate inbox. It should arrive immediately.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Wait ah, refreshing Outlook... yes, received. Let me paste it in.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Take your time. Once in, the system will prompt you to set your new permanent password.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [typing sounds] Okay, entered my new password, confirmed twice... and yes, I'm back into the admin dashboard.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Excellent. Can you confirm if all your standard administrative privileges and tabs are displaying normally?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Yes, user directory, billing, and logs are all intact. Everything is working fine now lah, thanks.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Glad to hear that, Mr. Tan. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: No, that will be all. You've been very helpful Sean, appreciate it. Have a good day ahead.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: You too, Mr. Tan. Thank you for choosing Apex Support, goodbye.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Hello! My laptop wouldn't boot, but I pressed the power button as advised lah.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Awesome, is the display showing your desktop screen now?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [gasp] YES! It booted up already! [warm laugh] IT WORKS!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Perfect, the hard reset resolved the power freeze.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [warm laugh] Wah, you are an absolute LIFESAVER leh, THANK YOU so much!

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [angry gasp] Hello?! My CAD modeling software suddenly shut down saying license expired! We have client presentation in two hours, why your system lock us out like this?!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: [polite tone] I understand your urgency, sir. Let me check your account. It looks like the annual enterprise subscription expired at midnight, and the automatic renewal payment failed to go through—

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [furious scoff] DON'T GIVE ME EXCUSES! YOU PEOPLE DID NOT EVEN SEND ONE WARNING EMAIL! WE CANNOT WORK AT ALL! FIX THIS RIGHT NOW OR UNLOCK OUR ACCESS MANUALLY!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: [soft sigh] I hear your frustration, sir, but our security protocol prevents manual overrides until accounting verifies payment, which typically takes one business day—

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [slams desk] ONE BUSINESS DAY?! ARE YOU CRAZY?! GET YOUR MANAGER ON THIS PHONE IMMEDIATELY! I AM CANCELING OUR ENTIRE CONTRACT AND SUING YOUR COMPANY!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Thank you for calling Apex Retail Customer Care. My name is Aidan. May I have your full name and order reference number, please?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Hello, Aidan. Farhan bin Razak here. The order ID is MY-8840291. It's regarding my espresso machine return.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Thank you, Encik Farhan. Let me pull up your account records. To verify identity, could you confirm your registered mobile number and mailing address?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Number is zero-one-two, four-nine-eight, three-one-one-zero. Address is twenty-four Jalan Bangsar Ria, Bangsar Baru.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Verification successful. I see the record here for the Barista Pro espresso machine. How can I assist you with this transaction today?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [sigh] Look, I returned the parcel twenty-one days ago already lah. Warehouse received it on the eighth, but until today, no refund inside my bank. How come like that?

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I completely understand your concern, Encik Farhan. Our standard turnaround for merchant warehouse inspection and refund authorization is normally seven to ten business days.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Ten days? Ya, but today is day twenty-one kan. Three weeks gone already. Your tracking status also say 'Inspection Passed' since two Mondays ago leh.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Allow me to review the backend financial logs. Did you receive an automated confirmation email stating the credit note was generated?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Nothing pun. Only received the courier drop-off slip and the system ping saying item accepted. That's why I'm calling you directly now.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I see. Please bear with me while I check with our logistics settlement queue. May I place you on a brief two-minute hold while I investigate?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [sigh] Okay lah. Go ahead. Don't take too long, okay?

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Thank you so much for patiently waiting, Encik Farhan. I have checked the warehouse ledger. The unit was indeed certified intact on the eleventh.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: So if it's intact, where is the RM1,850 gone? Why hasn't it hit my Maybank account?

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: It appears that when the credit memo was routed to the third-party payment gateway, there was an intermittent reconciliation error with the acquiring bank.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Wait, wait, wait—[scoff] intermittent error? When I paid for the machine, your system took my money in two seconds flat. Now you say system jam?

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I sincerely apologize for the inconvenience. Inbound merchant authorizations utilize instant tokenization, whereas merchant reversal batches require secondary security clearance.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: So basically your system only knows how to swallow money fast fast, but spitting it back out takes one whole month. Beautiful lah.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I can manually re-trigger the payout request from my terminal right now to push it into the priority settlement queue for you.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Okay. Do it then. Does that mean it enters my account this evening?

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I have submitted the manual override. However, because our finance batch only synchronizes at midnight, it will require an additional three to five business days.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [heavy sigh] Another three to five working days. Today is already Thursday, Aidan. So basically next Wednesday, if I'm lucky lah?

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Excluding the weekend, that would be Tuesday or Wednesday of next week, provided the clearing house releases the ledger hold.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: 'Provided the clearing house releases'. You see how many 'if' and 'provided' you give me? Can you just transfer me to your finance manager right now?

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Our finance settlement desk operates as a back-office department without inbound voice routing, sir. Supervisors on duty follow the exact same override protocol.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [scoff] Of course. Cannot talk to anyone with actual authority. Standard script lah.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I assure you your case has been escalated to Tier-2 priority. You will receive an automated tracking ticket via SMS within forty-eight hours.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Forty-eight hours just to get an SMS ticket. You know what, Aidan... don't worry about it. Don't bother promising anything lah.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Sir, I want to make sure your refund is completely followed up on. Would you like me to add your alternate email for status notifications?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: No need, lah. What's the point? Send email, send SMS, still no money inside my bank anyway. It's just a wall of excuses.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I have logged your ticket reference as RF-99214. Is there anything else at all I can check or assist you with today, Encik Farhan?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [long sigh] Assist with what? You guys can't even refund a broken kettle in three weeks. Never mind lah. I give up. Bye.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Thank you for calling Apex Retail. I apologize again for the delay, and have a good day ahead, sir.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Tech Support, David speaking. How may I assist with your system today?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [angry gasp] ASSIST ME?! Your software update crashed my machine, and ALL MY CLIENT FILES ARE GONE lah!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I am truly sorry to hear that, sir. Let me inspect your secondary backup drive to see if—

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [shouting] DON'T TALK ABOUT BACKUPS LAH! THE SYSTEM CRASH WIPED EVERYTHING! ARE YOU BLIND MEH?!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: [sigh] If the file sectors are corrupted, our tools cannot rebuild the database. It is unrecoverable.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [slams desk] UNRECOVERABLE?! FIVE YEARS OF TAX ACCOUNTS GONE JUST LIKE THAT?! HOW CAN LIKE THIS?!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I sincerely apologize, but without intact clusters, the data loss is permanent and cannot be reversed.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [rageful scoff] BULLSHIT LAH! GET ME YOUR REGIONAL DIRECTOR RIGHT NOW OR I SUE YOUR WHOLE COMPANY!

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Ni hao, hello! [cheerful chuckle] I received your 5G SIM today, SO EXCITING! But no service yet ah, can help activate?

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Hello! [warm tone] I would be glad to help. Could you read me the number on the card back?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Yes, sure! [gasp] It is 8986-0422-1099! Your delivery was SO FAST already, truly wonderful service!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Thank you! [keystrokes] I have pushed the activation now. Please restart your phone to finish.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Restarting now! [warm laugh] AYA, LOOK! Signal bars jumped to full immediately! That is INCREDIBLE!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Fantastic! Your SIM is active on the network. Is your mobile data loading smoothly?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [warm laugh] YES, SUPER FAST! You are an ABSOLUTE GENIUS! Thank you so much, best service ever, made my day!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: [gentle chuckle] You are most welcome! It was my absolute pleasure. Enjoy your 5G and have a lovely day!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Hello, thanks for calling Apex Fiber support. My name is David. Are you still experiencing the network disconnection?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: David! [warm laugh] OH MY GOD, you won't believe it! Just as you picked up, the optical light turn steady green already!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Ah, wonderful! I just refreshed your optical terminal port from our central switch. Is your laptop showing full internet access now?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Yes, YES! [gasp] Everything load instantly! Wow, you are pure genius, really! I was so worry about my presentation, ah!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: That is fantastic news. The signal attenuation looks completely clean now, so your line should remain stable.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [warm laugh] AMAZING service, David! You fix it faster than lightning, really save my life today! Thank you so, so much!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: You are very welcome! Is there anything else I can help verify for you?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: No need already, everything perfect! [giggle] You have a wonderful day, bye-bye!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Thank you for calling Apex Broadband Technical Support. My name is Marcus. How may I assist you today?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Hello Marcus. Yes, I am having one issue configuring my new Wi-Fi 6 router at home.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I can certainly help you with that. First, may I please have your account number and full name?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Sure. My account number is SH-88204, and the name is Kevin Chen.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Thank you, Mr. Chen. Can you also confirm the installation address on file for security verification?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Yes, it is 42 Harbor View Boulevard, apartment 12B.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Thank you, identity verified. Please describe what is happening when you try to set up the router.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Actually, the WAN LED light is showing solid orange, and I cannot open the default admin page.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Understood. Have you already connected an Ethernet cable from your fiber optical terminal directly into the router's WAN port?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Yes, blue cable from optical terminal LAN one into router WAN. Already restarted both devices, still same thing.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Got it. What IP address are you entering into your web browser to reach the administration panel?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: I enter 192.168.1.1, but it says site cannot be reached, connection timed out.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Your optical modem might also be using 192.168.1.1, creating an IP conflict. Could you try navigating to 192.168.0.1 instead?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [keyboard typing] Ah, wait. 192.168.0.1 also cannot load. My computer Ethernet shows no valid IP assigned.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Let's disconnect the WAN cable temporarily, then power cycle the router so your PC grabs a local DHCP lease.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Okay, WAN cable unplugged. [pause] Powering off the router now... waiting five seconds... powering back on.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Great. Once the power LED turns solid green, please check if your computer receives an IP address.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Yes, green light is steady now. [mouse clicks] Okay, my laptop now shows IP 192.168.0.100.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Excellent. Now, please allow me about two minutes to check the line status on our exchange side. I will put you on a brief hold.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Okay, sure. I will stay on the line.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Thank you for waiting, Mr. Chen. The optical line is clear, but your connection profile requires specific VLAN tagging.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: I see. That explains why it cannot obtain IP automatically from the fiber modem.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Precisely. Please reconnect the WAN cable, open your browser to 192.168.0.1, and log into the administrative interface.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [mouse clicks] Cable connected. Yes, I am logged in now. I am looking at the Basic Network setup page.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Please navigate to Advanced, then select Network, and look for the IPTV or VLAN submenu.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Okay, Advanced, Network, IPTV VLAN. Yes, found it. There is an option to Enable VLAN.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Please enable it, select Custom mode, and set the Internet VLAN ID tag to 10 with priority 0.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Wait, what about the 802.1Q Tag checkbox? Should I check this box as well?

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Yes, please check 802.1Q Tag for the Internet interface. Leave IPTV and VoIP tags disabled for now.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Understood. VLAN ID 10, priority 0, 802.1Q checked. [mouse clicks] I click Save now.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Now under WAN Connection Type, ensure it is set to Dynamic IP, and click Release then Renew.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Clicking Renew now... [pause] Wait, it says acquiring IP address... still showing zero dot zero dot zero.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Give it about fifteen seconds to negotiate the handshake with our optical line terminal.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [pause] Ah, okay! It just populated a public IP address, and the front WAN LED changed to solid green.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: That is wonderful. Could you please open a new browser tab and test loading a couple of websites?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [keyboard typing] Yes, loading portal page... and video streaming site. Both opening immediately without delay. Working fine now.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Fantastic news, Mr. Chen. Everything looks stable from our end as well. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: No other issue. Everything is working smoothly now. Thank you for your clear guidance, Marcus. Have a good day.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Thank you for calling Horizon Bank customer service. My name is Kevin. How may I assist you today?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [clears throat] Hi Kevin, good afternoon. My credit card got declined here in Tokyo, so I think it is blocked lah.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I understand, ma'am. Let me check that for you. May I have your full name and card number?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Sure, my name is Tan Wei Ling. The credit card number ends in four eight two nine.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Thank you, Ms. Tan. Could you confirm the billing address registered on your account?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Yes, it is Block 342 Clementi Avenue Five, unit zero eight one two.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Thank you. And could you also verify your date of birth for me?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Seventeenth of May, nineteen eighty-six.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Verification complete, Ms. Tan. Let me pull up your account records to see what happened.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Okay. I tried tapping at the hotel front desk just now, but the payment terminal said declined leh.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: [typing sounds] I see the transaction attempt right here for forty-five thousand yen from Shinjuku Prince Hotel.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Ya, correct, that is the exact one lah. I need to settle the room charges before check-out.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Our automated fraud monitoring system flagged it as an unusual overseas transaction and automatically placed a temporary hold on the card.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Ah, I see. I actually forgot to activate overseas usage before flying over, so my fault also lah.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: No worries at all, Ms. Tan. I can unblock the card and add a travel memo for Japan.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: That would be great. Can you help me unblock it directly right now?

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Yes. I will place you on a brief two-minute hold while I clear the security flag.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [soft sigh] Okay, no problem at all. I will hold the line lah.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Thank you for your patience, Ms. Tan. I will be right back with you shortly.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Thank you for waiting, Ms. Tan. I have accessed our backend fraud clearance system now.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Okay, good. Is the card unblocked already?

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: [sigh] There is a slight complication. Because of the overseas trigger, the system requires a secondary one-time verification code to release the block.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Ah, okay. But I am using a Japanese tourist data SIM now, so SMS cannot come through leh.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: That is completely fine. We can send the six-digit code to your registered email address instead.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Okay, can, that works. Let me open my email app to check now.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I have just dispatched the email. Please take a look and let me know once you see the code.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [pause] Okay, got it already. The six-digit verification passcode is six two nine eight zero one.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Thank you. Let me enter that passcode into the override portal right now.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Great news, Ms. Tan. The security block has been completely removed from your credit card.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Okay, nice. So I can tap the card at the hotel counter now ah?

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Yes, exactly. I also logged your travel dates in Japan until next Monday so your payments will not be interrupted.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [polite chuckle] Wonderful. That is very convenient and helpful lor.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: You are most welcome. Is there anything else I can help you with today, Ms. Tan?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: No other issues already, Kevin. Everything is settled nicely.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Excellent. Thank you for banking with Horizon Bank, and enjoy your stay in Tokyo!

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Thank you very much for your help, Kevin. Bye-bye.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Apex Telecom support, David speaking. How may I help you today?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [clears throat] Hello David. My fiber optical box has red light since morning, no internet connection.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Understood. Let me send a quick reset signal to your modem. Please hold on.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Okay, take your time.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Signal sent. Could you check if the LOS light turned green now?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [pause] Yes, the indicator changed to steady green already. Web page can load now.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Glad to hear that. Does everything look good on your side then?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Yes, all working properly now. Thank you very much, David.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Thank you for calling CelTel Support. My name is Haris. How may I assist you today?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Hello encik, I bought a postpaid SIM card yesterday, but until now still no service lah.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I apologize for that, sir. May I have your full name and IC number for verification?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Afiq bin Rosli, IC 880412-10-5531. Please settle fast, I have urgent meetings today.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Thank you, Mr. Afiq. Have you tried restarting your device or reinserting the SIM card?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [sigh] Aiyo, of course I did lah. Restarted three times already, still 'No Service' mah.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Understood. Please hold for two minutes while I check the activation status in our system.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [groan] Okay lah, fast a bit. I am running late.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Thank you for waiting, Mr. Afiq. The portal shows your SIM hit a provisioning error.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [scoff] Provisioning error? What is that? I paid fifty ringgit at your store yesterday!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: The network gateway rejected the serial number. I must submit a manual request to—

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [angry gasp] MANUAL WHAT? DO NOT GIVE EXCUSES LAH! YOUR STAFF PROMISED ONE HOUR!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I understand, sir, but manual network escalation takes twenty-four to forty-eight hours.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: FORTY-EIGHT HOURS? [yell] ARE YOU CRAZY AH?! TWO WHOLE DAYS WITHOUT SERVICE?!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I apologize, Mr. Afiq, but backend engineering must clear the stuck queue.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: PROTOCOL MY FOOT LAH! ACTIVATE IT NOW! PUSH THE OVERRIDE BUTTON ON YOUR SCREEN!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I cannot override the core network from here, sir. I have no clearance.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [shouting] I DON'T CARE! TRANSFER ME TO YOUR MANAGER RIGHT NOW! GET SOMEONE COMPETENT!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: My manager is currently occupied, but I can log an urgent priority callback.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [furious yell] NO CALLBACK! IF THIS IS NOT ACTIVE IN TEN MINUTES, I CANCEL ALL MY LINES!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Sir, please calm down. I am trying to assist within company policy—

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [explosive rage] SHUT UP! I WILL REPORT TO MCMC TODAY! CANCEL MY ACCOUNT IMMEDIATELY!

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Hello, good morning. I noticed an unexpected fifty-dollar late fee on my credit card statement, but I paid before the deadline lah.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Good morning. Let me check your transaction records. [typing sounds] Ah, I see your payment arrived at five PM on the due date.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Yes, correct. The money was deducted on time kan, so why got late charge?

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Our clearing system lagged overnight by mistake. I have reversed the fifty-dollar fee for your account already.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [polite hum] Okay, I can see the waiver reflected now. Thank you for settling this ya.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: You are very welcome. Have a wonderful day ahead.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Hi! My order was cancelled without notice, but I got a notification lah?

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Yes! A glitch cancelled it, but I reinstated your delivery right away.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [gasp] [warm laugh] WAH, REALLY? You sorted it already? That is SO AWESOME lah!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Yes, it is arriving this afternoon with an extra voucher included.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [warm laugh] TERIMA KASIH! You are an absolute lifesaver, SO DELIGHTED!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: You're most welcome! Enjoy your day!

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [angry gasp] HELLO?! Your banking app keeps saying network error cannot login lah! What is this nonsense?

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I understand your frustration, sir. Could you please check if your Wi-Fi or mobile data is active?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [scoff] DON'T TREAT ME LIKE AN IDIOT LAH! I have full 5G bar! I need to transfer money NOW!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Please try clearing your app cache—

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [slamming table] NO MORE EXCUSES! GET ME YOUR MANAGER RIGHT NOW OR I WILL CLOSE ALL MY ACCOUNTS!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Thank you for calling Apex Retail Singapore, my name is Marcus. How may I assist you today?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Hi Marcus, I really need your urgent help lah. I ordered a premium espresso machine for my husband's 40th birthday tomorrow, but I received plastic bowls instead! [sigh]

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Oh no, I'm truly sorry to hear that! Let's get this sorted out immediately. May I please verify your full name and order number?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Sure, my name is Tan Wei Ling, and the order ID is SG-88492. Delivery address is Bishan Street 22.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Thank you, Ms. Tan. I see your order for the De'Longhi Specialista espresso machine. Could you check the tracking sticker on the parcel box?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: The white sticker outside says tracking number SPX-9011-B, but the packing slip inside has another person's name, a Mr. Teo leh.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Ah, I see what happened. It appears there was an unfortunate shipping label swap at our Jurong fulfillment warehouse during peak sorting.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Aiyo, how can like that? The party is tomorrow morning leh! If the machine doesn't arrive by tonight, I will be in big trouble! [frustrated gasp]

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I completely understand your worry, Ms. Tan. Please hold on the line for two minutes while I contact our warehouse dispatch team directly.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Okay lah, please be quick. I will hold.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Thank you for waiting patiently, Ms. Tan. I just spoke directly with our head of dispatch at the Jurong facility.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: So how? What did they say? Can they deliver the coffee machine to me today or not?

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Unfortunately, the Jurong warehouse is out of stock, and their standard restock process would require three working days to fulfill.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: WHAT?! THREE DAYS?! But I already paid over one thousand dollars, and the birthday celebration is tomorrow morning at ten AM lah! [sharp intake of breath]

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I know, and three days is completely unacceptable. I rejected that standard timeframe immediately and escalated this case directly to our regional operations director.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Then got any other solution meh? Don't tell me I have to serve instant three-in-one coffee to twenty guests tomorrow!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Definitely not! We secured an unopened display unit from our premier Orchard flagship boutique, and I've booked an emergency point-to-point courier right now.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Wah, really? You mean they can bring it straight from Orchard Road to my house today?

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Exactly. The express driver will arrive at your Bishan home today between four and five PM sharp, with all expedited fees waived.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Oh that is such a relief! But what should I do with this box of kitchenware here?

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: The courier will collect it during delivery. In addition, I have added a fifty-dollar store credit to your profile as our sincere apology.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: WAH, Marcus! You are an absolute lifesaver lah! [warm laugh] I was panicking so badly, but you resolved everything so smoothly!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I'm genuinely thrilled I could rescue the celebration for your husband, Ms. Tan. Is there anything else I can assist with?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [delighted laugh] Nothing else, Marcus! Your customer service is top notch! THANK YOU SO MUCH, you truly saved my entire week!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: You are most welcome, Ms. Tan! Have a wonderful celebration tomorrow, and thank you for shopping with Apex Retail. Have a fantastic day ahead!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Tech support, Azman here. Are your mailbox folders syncing properly after our cache reset?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [happy gasp] YA ALLAH, YES! All two hundred pending emails just flooded in right now lah!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Excellent! Let's make sure the outbox clears too. Try hitting manual sync once.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [warm laugh] Done already! The stuck drafts cleared completely, sent out so smooth!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: That confirms the IMAP token renewed properly. Any alerts showing on your screen?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: None at all! [giggle] Everything is spotless, YOU ARE AN ABSOLUTE LIFESAVER, brother!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Glad to hear. Your mailbox sync is officially fully restored.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [joyful laugh] TERIMA KASIH! Truly the fastest, most wonderful help ever, I am so grateful!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Apex Retail customer care, Sarah speaking. How may I assist you today?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Hello Sarah. I'm calling about my parcel ya. It seems missing lah.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Sorry to hear that. May I have your order number and full name please?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Yes sure. My name is Faizal Rahman, and order ID is MY-882194.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Thank you, Encik Faizal. Let me pull up your account records right now.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [clears throat] Take your time, no rush ya.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I see your wireless headphones order here. What does your tracking status indicate?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Status shows delivered yesterday afternoon, but nothing arrived at my door kan.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Understood. Let me check the courier's electronic proof of delivery and photo.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Yeah, I was home all day working. Nobody rang the bell.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: The courier's GPS scan shows the delivery was marked at three fifteen PM.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [pause] Did the driver drop it at wrong block maybe?

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Possibly. Please hold while I contact the dispatch hub directly.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Alright, boleh. I'll hold on the line lah.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Thanks for waiting. I managed to reach the local hub manager just now.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Okay, what did they say ya?

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: The courier mistakenly dropped it at Block B instead of Block D.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [sigh] Ah, Block B. Similar unit number lah. Can retrieve back?

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: They tried earlier, but resident wasn't home. We've marked it lost.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Understood. What is the solution now? Can get replacement?

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Yes, I can arrange an immediate replacement or issue a full refund to your card.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Replacement lah please, I need the headphones for work.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Checking stock now. Yes, we have units available.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Great. Do you need my address verification again?

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Yes please, just to ensure accuracy this round.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Block D, twelve-zero-four, Residensi Damai, Petaling Jaya, four seven three zero zero.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Confirmed. I've scheduled priority dispatch with signature required on handover to avoid any mix-up.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Okay, when will that arrive ya?

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Tomorrow before noon. You'll receive live SMS tracking shortly.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Any extra charge for the priority dispatch?

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: No charge. We also credited twenty ringgit to your wallet.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [chuckle] Okay, that's very fair lah. Appreciate the prompt help.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: You're welcome. Is there anything else I can help with?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: No, everything is settled already. Very clear.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Your ticket reference is CAS-77102. Email confirmation is sent.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Got it noted. Thanks very much, Sarah.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Thank you for choosing Apex, Encik Faizal. Have a good day.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Thank you for calling Apex Device Support. My name is Marcus. May I please have your full name and phone number for verification?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [polite clearing of throat] Yes, hello Marcus. This is Rajesh Venkatraman, and my contact number is 98450-23118.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Thank you, Mr. Venkatraman. I have your customer record open here. How can I assist you with your laptop today?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Actually, my ZenBook is not booting up today morning itself. When I press the power key, nothing is coming on the screen.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I understand how inconvenient that is. Let us check what is going on. Are there any LED indicator lights showing on the side?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: No, actually speaking, earlier there was one faint amber light, but right now even that light is completely gone, you see.
