turns.text: Thank you for your patience on hold, Ms. Tan. I spoke with the warehouse supervisor, but unfortunately we ran into an unexpected setback.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [sigh] What happened? Is the grey chair completely unavailable or damaged across both of your warehouse facilities now?

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: The remaining grey batch at retail failed pre-dispatch inspection due to packaging defects. Logistics quarantined the entire lot, so we cannot safely ship it.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Aiyah, safety first then. But black color also can, you know. I just need the ergonomic office chair for my study room setup.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: We have certified units in black, but because the original order was purged, the flash-deal promotional discount cannot automatically apply to a replacement cart.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Oh, but that was an automatic system cancellation, not my fault, right? If cannot reapply, does that mean I must pay full regular price?

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Not at all, Ms. Tan. That was our system error. I have authorization to apply a manual price override to match your original flash-sale price.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: That is fair and reasonable. As long as the final charge remains fifty-eight dollars as originally agreed, black color is completely fine with me.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Wonderful. I am submitting new order SG-991054 now with the price adjustment applied, along with complimentary priority express delivery for the inconvenience.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Okay, very good. And what about the previous credit card payment of fifty-eight dollars that was already deducted from my account yesterday?

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: That initial charge was an authorization hold. Since that order was voided, the hold was released back to your bank, and only this new order will bill.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: All right, that is very clear and straightforward. When exactly can I expect the delivery team to arrive at my block in Tampines?

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Delivery is scheduled for tomorrow afternoon between two and six PM. I have sent the updated receipt and tracking link directly to your registered email.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [clears throat] Received the email already, and the order details are all correct. Everything is resolved properly now. Thank you for your help, Marcus.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Thank you for calling Apex Broadband Support. My name is Kelvin. May I have your name and account number?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [sigh] Farhan Razali here. Account FX-8821940. My home fibre internet completely died this morning lah.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Thank you, Encik Farhan. Could you please confirm your registered installation address for verification?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Forty-two Jalan USJ eleven bar four, Subang Jaya. The red LOS light is blinking non-stop.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Thank you. I see your account is active on our five hundred megabits fiber package.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Active package also no use if zero internet kan? I have urgent client meetings today.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Understood. On your optical modem box, is the green PON light totally unlit right now?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Ya, PON is dead dark. Only LOS flashing red. Already restarted three times before calling.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Alright. Let's check the thin patch cable underneath. Can you gently reseat that connector?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [scoff] Wait ah. Unplugging green connector... okay, clicked it back in. Still blinking red lah.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: That indicates optical signal loss outside. May I place you on a brief hold while I test?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [sighs deeply] Hold again. Fine, go ahead. Just don't drop the call.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Thank you for waiting, Encik Farhan. I just ran an optical test from our backend.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: So what happened? Can reset from your side or not?

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Our test detected a signal break at the neighborhood box. It requires an on-site technician.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: On-site? What time can your technician reach today? Morning or afternoon?

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Let me check the dispatch roster for available slots in Subang Jaya.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Check fast please. Whole house is stuck without connection.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Checking now... due to yesterday's thunderstorm damage, our earliest slot is—

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: —Wait, DON'T TELL ME you cannot come today! Today is only Saturday morning!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I apologize, Encik Farhan. The earliest available slot is Tuesday at two PM.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [dry chuckle] Tuesday? Are you joking? Four days without internet for remote work?

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I understand, but our field engineers are fully tied up repairing damaged main cables.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Every month pay ninety-nine ringgit on time, but repair need wait four days.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I can provision a free twenty-gigabyte mobile data pass to your SIM card right now.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [scoff] Aiyo, your mobile signal here only one bar Edge lah! What to do with hotspot?

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Let me check with my supervisor if we can expedite an emergency slot.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [tired sigh] Ask lah. See if they care.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Thanks for waiting. My supervisor confirmed the schedule is locked. We cannot force an earlier slot.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [flat monotone] Of course. Expected already. No surprise.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Shall I secure that Tuesday two PM appointment so you retain the slot?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [heavy sigh] Whatever lah. Put whatever date. Doesn't even matter anymore.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Booked ticket BR-77401 for Tuesday afternoon. Is there anything else I can help with?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Assist? [weary chuckle] You couldn't fix my net today. Nothing else lah.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I am truly sorry for the trouble, Encik Farhan. Thank you for calling.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [cold monotone] Yeah. Bye.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Hello, good morning. Actually, I am unable to login to the mobile banking app since today morning only. It is throwing one error code: AUTH-403.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Good morning. I can assist with that error code. It usually indicates a cached credential conflict. I have just cleared your active mobile sessions from our backend.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [clears throat] Okay, understood. Should I try entering my credentials once more right now itself, or must I restart the mobile handset?

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: No need to restart the phone. Simply reopen the application, enter your standard six-digit MPIN, and verify if the dashboard loads.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [pause] Yes, entering it now... It has authenticated properly and the account balance is visible. Thank you, the issue is sorted.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Thank you for calling PasarMall support. My name is Kevin. How may I assist you today?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [sigh] Ya, hi. I ordered an induction cooker two weeks ago, but you all sent a cheap plastic kettle. Macam mana ni?

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I'm really sorry for the parcel mix-up. Let me pull up your order so we can—

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [scoff] Don't need to check lah. Even the label outside says kettle. Sumpah, your warehouse team cannot read is it?

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I understand. To get an exchange, you'll have to print a return slip and wait five working days for pickup.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [heavy sigh] Five days again? [monotone chuckle] Never mind lah. It is always like that with you all. Just forget it.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Sir, I can still easily file the return ticket right now if you want to—

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [sigh] No need lah, waste my time only. Keep the money, consider I donate. [sigh] Bye.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Apex Telecom support, Daniel speaking. May I have your account number, please?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Hello Daniel. [sigh] It's MY-88219. Name is Farah.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Thank you, Miss Farah. Profile is open. How can I help you today?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Whole house got no internet lah! Modem LOS light keeps blinking red.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I hear you. Let's check the terminal. Are the fiber cables plugged tight?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Already checked lah, firmly inside. Still blinking red, tak boleh connect.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Understood. Please switch off the power adapter for ten seconds and restart.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Okay wait ah. [pause] Powered on already. Aiyo, still blinking red lah!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Hold on for two minutes please while I check the exchange port signal.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Can, can. Please check properly ya? Got urgent work today.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Thanks for waiting, Miss Farah. Backend shows optical signal, but authentication timed out.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Aiyoh, router spoiled is it? I really cannot have outage today.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Hardware is fine. Exchange gateway locked up. I am resetting the session now.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [gasp] Wait, wait! Red light stopped blinking! It turned steady green!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Great! Signal locked. Can you check if a website loads on Wi-Fi?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Refreshing my laptop browser now... [pause] OH WOW, IT LOADED INSTANTLY!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Wonderful! Could you run a quick speed test to confirm bandwidth?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Testing now... Wah, five hundred megabits! Smoother than before even, kan?

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Yes, the port reset cleared packet latency. Signal health is perfect now.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [warm laugh] ALHAMDULILLAH! You are absolute MAGIC, Daniel! Presentation starts in ten minutes!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: [chuckle] Glad we sorted it out just in time for you.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: TERIMA KASIH BANYAK-BANYAK! [giggle] Best service ever, you saved my day lah!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: My absolute pleasure. Anything else I can assist you with today?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [relieved sigh] Nothing else! You deserve a huge promotion! Have a blessed day!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Thank you so much, Miss Farah. Good luck with your presentation. Goodbye!

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [warm laugh] Bye-bye, thank you so much!

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Hi, I'm in Tokyo now and my credit card got declined at the station lah.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Hello. Let me check that. Could you verify the last four digits of your card?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Sure, five-one-two-nine. Did the system block it leh?

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Yes, flagged for overseas security. I'm removing the block for you now.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [soft sigh] Okay, thanks. Hope can clear fast.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: All sorted. Overseas usage is now activated on your card.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Nice, payment just went through already. Thank you ah.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Glad to help. Have a safe trip!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Thank you for calling Apex Cloud Support, my name is Marcus. May I please have your full name and registered account email address?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Hello Marcus, my name is Jason Chen. My email is jason dot chen at horizon logistics dot com. Please, urgent help already.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Thank you, Mr. Chen. For security verification, could you please confirm the primary company phone number associated with your account?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Yes, it is 415-555-0198. Please hurry up a bit, my side is having very big trouble right now.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Verification successful. How may I assist you today with your Apex email account, Mr. Chen?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [anxious sigh] My email sync is completely broken! Since nine o'clock, Outlook and phone stopped receiving mails. Inbox stuck showing 'connecting' and error 0x80040115. My client sent contract already, but I cannot see anything!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I understand that is critical. Have you tried signing in directly to our webmail portal via your web browser to check if new messages appear there?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Yes, I tried already! Webmail also spinning non-stop, saying server timeout. Both mobile and computer cannot sync. Why suddenly like this?

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Let's check your connection settings. In Outlook, please go to Account Settings, open your Exchange profile, and check if cached Exchange mode is checked.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Wait, let me click... okay, cached Exchange mode is enabled. Then what? Should I uncheck it?

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Please uncheck it, click Next, and restart Outlook. That forces a direct connection with our Exchange mailbox server.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [groans] No use, Marcus! It pops up saying 'folders cannot be opened'. It crashed my whole mailbox! Not even old emails are showing now!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Do not worry, your data is safe on the server. That indicates the profile failed authentication. Let me check our backend tenant logs for your mailbox. May I put you on hold for two minutes?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [tuts] Aiya, okay, but make it fast! My client gave me twenty minutes before canceling our tender!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Thank you for waiting, Mr. Chen. I checked our backend tenant dashboard. During an automated database migration this morning, your mailbox store encountered an indexing corruption and the replication pipeline halted.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [angry gasp] Migration? What migration? You do maintenance during business hours without informing anyone? What kind of support is this?

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I apologize for the inconvenience. To resolve the corruption, standard procedure requires unlinking your primary mailbox and initiating a full mailbox reconstruction from backup.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [scoff] Reconstruct? How long does that take? I need my contract right now!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: The backend restore queue typically takes twenty-four to forty-eight hours to complete reconciliation, and any draft items created locally this morning will unfortunately be—

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [slamming desk] FORTY-EIGHT HOURS?! ARE YOU CRAZY?! MY BID SUBMISSION DEADLINE IS IN TEN MINUTES! TEN MINUTES! YOU ARE TELLING ME MY PROPOSALS AND CONTRACT ARE GONE?!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Mr. Chen, I cannot bypass the automated rebuild queue. It is a core system task managed by our tier-three operations team.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: DO NOT TALK OPERATIONS TO ME! YOU DESTROYED MY WHOLE SYSTEM AND MY TENDER! I WANT YOUR MANAGER ON THIS CALL RIGHT NOW! TRANSFER ME IMMEDIATELY!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Our escalation queue is currently full, but I can log a priority ticket and request a supervisor callback within four business hours.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: FOUR HOURS?! ARE YOU JOKING?! DO YOU THINK I AM STUPID?! I CANNOT WAIT FOUR HOURS! GET SOMEONE ON THIS LINE BEFORE I SUE YOUR COMPANY!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Sir, there are no supervisors available for immediate transfer, and the automated queue cannot be expedited manually from my console. There is nothing further I can do right now.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: NOTHING YOU CAN DO?! UNBELIEVABLE! [screaming] WE PAY TEN THOUSAND DOLLARS EVERY MONTH FOR THIS GARBAGE! CANCEL OUR ACCOUNT! CANCEL IT IMMEDIATELY! I AM TAKING LEGAL ACTION AND REPORTING THIS DISASTER EVERYWHERE! YOU JUST RUINED OUR BUSINESS! [slams phone]

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Thank you for calling Apex Telecom customer support. My name is David. May I please have your full name and the mobile number you are inquiring about today?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Yes, hello. Rajesh Kumar here, calling regarding 9820-551-404. Look, I am having serious trouble only. I collected this new 5G SIM card two days back, but it is still showing 'No Service' completely on my phone!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Thank you, Mr. Kumar. I understand how frustrating that must be when you need connectivity. Before we proceed, could you kindly confirm your registered billing address and the last four digits of your ID?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Address is Flat 402, Green Valley Apartments, Mumbai, and my ID ends with 7-1-8-2. Please expedite this, ya. My critical client calls are pending since morning itself, so I am very anxious.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Verification is successful, Mr. Kumar. Let us resolve this swiftly. Have you already tried rebooting your device or toggling Airplane Mode on and off to refresh the network search?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [sigh] Brother, I have done all those things three times already! Even I took out the tray, cleaned the gold contacts, and inserted it in slot one only. Still, emergency calls only, no network latching whatsoever.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Understood, thank you for checking. Let us inspect the SIM registration on our network switch. Could you read out the twenty-digit ICCID printed on the card?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Yes, wait, let me read carefully. It is 8-9-9-1-0-4-0-2-3-8-9-1-0-5-5-2-4-1-8-9. Can you see it in your database? What is the holdup actually?

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Thank you. I have located the record, but the activation token appears stalled between our retail portal and network controller. May I place you on a brief two-minute hold while I inspect the HLR database directly?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Fine, do one thing, please check thoroughly. But kindly don't disconnect the line, ha? I have already wasted forty minutes navigating the automated IVR earlier, so please stay with me.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: [clears throat] Thank you for patiently holding, Mr. Kumar. Here is the issue: the retail store registered this SIM under a duplicate batch profile, so our automated provisioning gateway flagged it as a suspended token and stopped the pairing.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [shocked gasp] WHAT?! Suspended token?! Are you telling me that store handed me a dead piece of plastic? That is completely unacceptable, man! I have an international board presentation in twenty minutes, how am I supposed to receive OTPs?!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I completely understand your frustration and urgency, Mr. Kumar. Do not worry at all. As a tier-two network engineer, I have direct override clearance to purge that stuck batch token and manually bind your IMSI to the live Home Subscriber Server right now.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Can you really do that from your side itself? Please, I beg you, if this fails, my entire business deal will collapse today! Please make it happen.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Rest assured, stay on the line with me. Purging the stuck retail token now... clearing database locks... done. Now injecting fresh authentication keys directly into your regional tower cluster. Give the core gateway about ten seconds to synchronize.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [tense silence] [whispering] Okay... I am watching the screen continuously... it is still searching... wait, wait, the network indicator is beginning to flash now...

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Perfect. Now, kindly toggle your Airplane Mode on, count to three seconds, and turn it back off to force a brand new network handshake with the local mast.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [gasp] [excited chuckle] HEY! Wait! FIVE BARS! Full 5G reception just popped up, and two client OTP messages arrived right this second! IT IS WORKING! IT IS ACTUALLY WORKING!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I can confirm the terminal handshake is fully authenticated on our backend, Mr. Kumar! Both crystal-clear VoLTE calling and ultra-fast data packet routing are active and running seamlessly on your line.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [warm laugh] Outstanding! Superb! Brother, you are an absolute genius, I swear! I was so stressed my head was bursting, but you solved in two minutes what the store staff couldn't even explain! Simply magnificent and top-class work!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: It was my absolute pleasure, Mr. Kumar. We are delighted that everything is restored in time for your presentation, and I truly appreciate your patience while we corrected that.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [joyful laughter] God bless you, David! You have literally saved my day, my client contract, and my peace of mind! Keep up this incredible service, ya! Heartfelt thanks to you! Have a truly wonderful and blessed day ahead!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Thank you so much for your kind and generous words, Mr. Kumar. Best of luck with your board meeting, and thank you for choosing Apex Telecom. Goodbye!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Thank you for calling Apex Telecom MNP support. My name is Jason. How may I assist you today?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Hello Jason. Actually I am calling because my number porting failed yesterday lah.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I can certainly check that for you. May I have your full name and IC number, please?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Sure, it is Nurul Huda binti Osman. IC is 900412-10-5542.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Thank you, Puan Nurul. And what is the mobile number you are attempting to port in?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: The line is 012-3984711. It is supposed to move over from my old telco.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Got it. Let me pull up the porting transaction log from the central clearinghouse. One moment.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [sighs softly] Ya, I received an SMS saying the donor provider rejected the switch.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Did you manage to reply to their automated SMS confirmation within the required two-hour window?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Yes, I replied YES straight away, but thirty minutes later it bounced back as failed.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Looking at the clearinghouse system now, error code D01 is showing up: identity verification mismatch.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Identity mismatch? But my name and Malaysian IC are correct what. Nothing changed on my end.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Let me contact our clearinghouse liaison to view the exact registration record from the donor network. May I place you on a brief hold?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Sure, boleh. I can hold, no problem.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: [chime] Thank you for holding, Puan Nurul. I have identified the root issue on their database.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Okay, what is the problem on their side ah?

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Your previous provider still holds your original registration under an old passport number instead of your MyKad IC.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [polite chuckle] Oh, ya lah! I signed that original plan when I was studying overseas using my passport.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: That explains the rejection. Do you happen to have that passport number handy right now?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Yes, wait ya. It is A3829104. Can we resubmit with that?

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Yes. I am updating the donor identification field to that passport number directly in the portal.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Do I need to go down to the branch to verify documents again, or is this enough?

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: No physical visit is necessary. I am pushing a manual override packet through the clearinghouse right now.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Okay, that is convenient then. Thanks.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Sending the re-validation trigger now. The donor network has fifteen seconds to acknowledge the patch.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Alright, I will just stay on the line with you.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: [soft click] Good news, the donor gateway just accepted the credentials and released the MSISDN allocation.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Oh, so the porting is officially approved already?

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Yes. I am provisioning the new Apex SIM card profile to our HLR core network right now.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Let me check the phone. [rustling sound] Ah, the old SIM just dropped network service.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Please insert your new Apex SIM card or toggle flight mode if you have an eSIM installed.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Okay, toggling airplane mode now. Okay, 5G signal bars just popped up.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Excellent. Could you please place a quick test call or check data connectivity to make sure?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [taps screen] Data is loading fast and test call rings fine. Everything is settled already, thank you Jason.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: You are most welcome, Puan Nurul. Thank you for choosing Apex Telecom, and have a pleasant day ahead.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Thank you for calling support. How can I help you today?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [angry gasp] LISTEN! I ordered a smartphone and you sent cheap plastic bowls only! ARE YOU CRAZY?

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I apologize for the mix-up, sir. Let me check your tracking number—

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [scoff] NO TRACKING! I WANT MY PHONE TODAY ITSELF, NOT EXCUSES, YAAR!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Replacement takes forty-eight hours, sir. We must inspect—

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [shout] FORTY-EIGHT HOURS? SHUT UP! CONNECT TO YOUR MANAGER RIGHT NOW!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Managers cannot bypass this policy, sir.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [furious yell] FRAUD COMPANY! CANCEL MY ACCOUNT! I AM SUING YOU ALL!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Thank you for calling Apex Computer Support. My name is Kevin. May I please have your full name and the serial number on the bottom of your laptop?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Yes, hello. This is Rohan Deshmukh. Serial is Alpha-Nine-Zero-Four-Two. Actually Kevin, my laptop is not booting up at all since morning itself. It is completely dead.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Thanks for verifying that, Rohan. I see your ZenithBook 15 here. When you press the power button, do you hear any fans spin up or see any indicator lights flashing?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [weary exhale] Nothing only. No fan sound, no keyboard backlight, screen is pitch dark. I kept it on charging for two hours, but still zero response.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Understood. Let's attempt a static power discharge. Please unplug the AC adapter, disconnect any external USB devices, and then press and hold the power button down for thirty full seconds.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Okay, holding it down now... [pause] Ten, twenty, thirty seconds done. Now plugging back the power cord and pressing once... [heavy sigh] Still stone dead. Nothing is happening.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Alright, thanks for trying that. Can you check the small LED light directly on the power adapter brick? Is that illuminated, or is it flickering?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: The adapter LED is solid white only. Socket also I tested with my mobile charger and that is working fine. The issue is strictly in the laptop itself, no?

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Got it. Did anything unusual happen prior to this, like a sudden drop, liquid exposure, or perhaps a system firmware update?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: No drop or spills. Yesterday night itself your automated support assistant pushed a critical BIOS update. It said rebooting, screen went black, and it never woke back up.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I see. That sounds like the firmware flash might have been interrupted. Please allow me two minutes on hold while I consult our tier-two hardware specialist about recovery protocols.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [sigh] Fine, go ahead. Do whatever you must do. I am holding.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Thank you for your patience, Rohan. I discussed the case with my senior team. Because the power management IC isn't handshaking, the EEPROM chip is likely corrupted and unresponsive—

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [flat scoff] Wait, so you are telling me your official update basically bricked my motherboard? Just like that, for doing what your system software told me to do?

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I deeply understand your frustration, Rohan. Unfortunately, if the motherboard won't accept a crisis flash, it requires a board-level replacement. Looking up your coverage, your standard warranty ended fourteen days ago.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [cold chuckle] Fourteen days. Two weeks out of warranty, and your own software destroys the machine. What a marvelous coincidence, yaar.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: An out-of-warranty depot repair for the system board is five hundred and eighty dollars, with an estimated turnaround of fifteen business days once you ship the unit to our service facility.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [monotone sigh] Five hundred and eighty dollars. That is almost sixty percent of what I paid brand new. Superb service, really. Truly mind-blowing logic.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I can submit a goodwill escalation to my supervisor to request a partial discount, though I cannot promise it will be approved. Would you like me to create that request?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [resigned scoff] No, please. Don't bother making any special requests. I know how this song and dance goes. I will wait three days only to hear another polite refusal.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I apologize for the difficult situation, Rohan. We do want to help, but our system policies are strict regarding out-of-warranty replacements.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [heavy sigh] Yeah, yeah. Whatever. Just cancel the ticket and close everything. I have zero energy left to argue with you people. [clicks tongue] Goodbye.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Apex Support, David speaking. May I have your name and account email?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Kenneth Tan lah. Email is kenneth dot tan at novacorp dot sg.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Thanks, Kenneth. Account identity verified. How can I assist you today?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: My work email not syncing since morning. Phone and laptop both stuck.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I see. Are you seeing any error message during manual sync?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Says 'Server timed out, error 0x80040115'. Cannot send or receive anything leh.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Understood. Can you check if webmail access works on your browser?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Webmail can log in, but inbox there also never update lor.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Understood. Let's first try clearing your local client cache under Account Settings.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Cleared already. App restarted, but still showing five hours ago meh.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Let's remove your account profile and re-add it via auto-discover.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Re-add profile? [scoff] Re-downloading everything will take forever you know?

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: It should be quick if cached mode is disabled initially.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Fine, re-added. Now it says 'Cannot connect to server' directly.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Let me place you on a brief hold while I check our backend routing logs.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Hold again ah? Okay lor, please be fast.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Thanks for waiting. Your mailbox sync pipeline on our backend is locked.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Locked? Can you unlock it from your side right now?

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I tried a flush, but the database cluster flagged an index corruption.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Corrupted? [groan] I have a tender submission at five PM today!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: We must run an automated database integrity repair on the cluster.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: How long will that database repair take?

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Standard integrity repair typically takes between four to six hours.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [scoff] FOUR TO SIX HOURS? That one cannot make it lah!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Stopping the process mid-way risks permanent data corruption across your mailbox.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [heavy sigh] So basically today cannot use email at all.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I can escalate this ticket to Tier Three to monitor queueing.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [cold scoff] Monitor what? Escalation also won't finish before five PM right?

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I cannot guarantee that, sir, but our engineers will prioritize it.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [weary sigh] Aiyah, forget it lah. Always like that one.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Would you like me to keep this case ticket open for updates?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [flat tone] Do whatever you want lor. Don't call back. Bye.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Hello, my system crashed during update only. Can we recover the partition data?

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Checking your shadow volume now. [soft keystrokes] The previous backup snapshot is intact.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Kindly restore from that snapshot itself, please.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Applying recovery now... The volume tables are successfully rebuilt.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [clears throat] Yes, all project files are showing properly now. Thank you.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: You are welcome. Have a great day!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Thank you for calling IT Support, my name is Rachel. How can I help you today?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [heavy sigh] Hello. My printer is offline again. Already restarted three times, but computer still cannot detect device.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Got it. Let us check the network status on your control panel to see if—

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [scoff] No need check ah. Cable is connected, green light on, but your spooler is completely dead.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I understand. We could attempt to clear the print queue via administrative tools.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [weary sigh] Forget it. Did that twice already. [flat scoff] Amazing system. I will just walk to fourth floor and print there. Bye.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Thank you for calling OrderHub support. My name is Kevin. May I have your order number?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [flatly] Yeah, MY-88421. My parcel missing already two weeks, you know.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Let me check that tracking ID for you right now, ma'am. One moment please.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [heavy sigh] Check also same thing lah. Hub status never update since fifth March.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I see the courier opened an inquiry yesterday, and they need five more business days to—

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [dry scoff] Five more days? [sigh] Just say the driver lost it lah, don't pretend anymore.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I understand your frustration, but company policy requires the logistics team to conclude the physical search first.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [long sigh] Conclude what? Never mind lah. Keep searching your empty warehouse. I give up already.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Thank you for calling QuickShip support. My name is Mark. How can I help with your delivery today?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [heavy sigh] Your courier didn't show up. Tracking app says 'attempted', but I waited whole day at door. Nobody come.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I apologize for the delay. Let me check with the regional dispatch hub to find out why the driver—

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [cold scoff] Find out why? Yesterday your colleague also check dispatch. Result is still no parcel. Always same excuse.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I really apologize. I can submit an urgent escalation to guarantee a re-delivery first thing tomorrow morning.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [weary sigh] Forget it. Tomorrow morning definitely no-show again. No need to deliver already. Just return to sender, I really don't care.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Thank you for calling Apex Federal Bank. My name is David. May I have your full name and account number, please?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Yes, Rajesh Ramanathan. Account number ending in four eight two nine.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Thank you, Mr. Ramanathan. For security, could you please confirm your billing zip code and the last four digits of your SSN?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Zip code is 08854, and SSN is 7102.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Thank you for verifying, Mr. Ramanathan. What can I help you with today?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: I am looking at my statement, and you people have put a forty-five dollar late fee. I made the payment on Friday itself, so why this charge?

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I can certainly look into that fee for you. Let me pull up your transaction records for this billing cycle.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [heavy sigh] Yes, please check. Every month I pay on time only, never missed once.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Looking at the ledger, the due date was Friday the fourteenth at 5 PM Eastern. Your payment was posted on Saturday morning at 3 AM.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Arre, but I initiated the transfer from my checking account at four in the afternoon on Friday. Why should your internal processing lag become my penalty?

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Our terms state electronic transfers initiated after 4 PM cutoff take one business day to clear. That triggered the automatic fee.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Cutoff time, fine print... [scoff] So my money left my account on Friday, but your system sleeps till Saturday, so I am charged.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I understand that can be frustrating, sir. Let me check if our system allows an automated waiver for your account.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [tired pause] Please do that only.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I will need to place you on a brief hold for about two minutes while I submit this to our billing supervisor. May I put you on hold?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [sigh] Fine, go ahead. I am waiting.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Thank you for your patience, Mr. Ramanathan. I have reviewed the fee with our supervisor.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: And? Has it been removed?

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Unfortunately, because a courtesy late fee waiver was already granted on this account eight months ago, the system is strictly preventing us from applying another one within a twelve-month window.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [flat monotone] That was your website glitch back in January, not my mistake. You guys admitted it that time.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I do see that notation, sir, but our compliance policy locks override capabilities at my tier. The fee stands at forty-five dollars.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: So basically, you are saying forty-five dollars is more important than a seven-year customer relationship. Wonderful.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I apologize for the inconvenience, sir. If you prefer, I can submit an appeal ticket to our offline review desk, which takes three to five business days.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [long heavy sigh] And while your offline desk drinks tea and reviews, my bill accumulates interest on top of the fee, correct?

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: The finance charges would accrue unless the statement balance is paid in full while the dispute is pending, yes.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [scoff] Brilliant logic. Pay the disputed penalty to avoid more penalties.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Would you like me to go ahead and file that formal dispute form for you today, Mr. Ramanathan?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [resigned sigh] No. Forget it. Do not bother. Just leave it as it is. I will pay your extortion fee, close the card next month, and be done with it.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I am truly sorry we couldn't resolve this to your preference today. Is there anything else I can assist you with?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [monotone] Nothing. Absolutely nothing. Goodbye.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Thank you for calling Apex Federal Bank. Have a good day.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Thank you for contacting Tech Support. My name is Sarah. May I have your serial number and full name, please?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [calm tone] Yes, hello Sarah. My name is David Chen. The serial number is Lima Tango seven eight four two.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: [typing sounds] Thank you, David. Account verified. How can I help you today with your ThinkBook?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: My laptop cannot boot up today. When I press power, nothing happens on the screen.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Understood. When you connect the AC power adapter, does any charging light turn on beside the port?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [pause] Let me check. Yes, there is one small amber light on the side.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Okay, good. Let's do a hard reset. Unplug the charger and hold the power button for thirty seconds.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Unplugging now. Okay, I am pressing and holding the power button. [soft exhale]

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Thirty seconds done. I plug back the power cable and press again. [click] Still black screen.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Did the cooling fan spin or keyboard backlight flash when you pressed it just now?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: No fan sound at all, completely quiet. Last night it was working normally before shutdown.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I see. Please allow me two minutes on hold to review the board-level power diagnostics for this revision.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Sure, no problem. I will wait on the line.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: [call reconnects] Thank you for waiting, David. The power delivery circuit might be stuck in a static latch state.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: I see. How can we discharge or clear this state?

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Make sure the charger and all external USB devices or dongles are completely disconnected.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [rustling sounds] Okay, mouse receiver is removed, charger disconnected. Everything is unplugged.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Now, hold down the Function key and the Power button together for twenty-five seconds to reset the embedded controller.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Holding Fn and Power now. [steady breathing] Ten seconds... twenty seconds... twenty-five.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: I release both keys. The amber LED blinked white once and turned off.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: That confirms the controller has successfully reset. Now, reconnect only your power adapter.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [adapter clicks into port] Power cable is connected. Amber light is solid again.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Great. Press the power button once firmly, then do not touch any keys for fifteen seconds.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [clicks button] Pressed once. Power LED came on solid white.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [exhale] But screen is still dark after ten seconds. The fan started spinning loudly though.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: That is expected behavior, David. The system is retraining the memory after the controller clear. Give it another moment.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Ah, keyboard backlight just blinked on.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Now the screen shows the boot logo. Loading circle is spinning.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Excellent. Please let me know once it reaches your operating system login screen.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Yes, Windows login prompt is up now. Desktop loaded properly, battery icon is charging.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Glad to hear that resolved the boot latch! Is there anything else I can assist you with today?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: No, everything is working smoothly now. Thank you for your clear instructions, Sarah.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: You are very welcome, David. Have a wonderful rest of your day, and thank you for calling.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Apex Bank support, Sean speaking. How can I help you today?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [scoff] Check my card now, leh! Three thousand dollars charged to Paris! I NEVER BOUGHT THIS LAH! Reverse it right now!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I understand your alarm, sir. To secure your account, I must verify your identity with an OTP—

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [angry gasp] DON'T OTP ME LAH! ARE YOU DEAF MEH? MY MONEY IS STOLEN! GET YOUR MANAGER RIGHT NOW OR I SUE YOUR WHOLE BANK!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Sir, protocol requires authentication before I can freeze any charges—

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [groan] UNACCEPTABLE! I AM CANCELING ALL MY CARDS AND REPORTING YOU TO MAS IMMEDIATELY!

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [heavy sigh] Hello. My IMPS transfer of fifty thousand rupees is still stuck in pending since morning itself.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I understand your concern, sir. Let me check the core banking portal for the reference number.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [flat scoff] Reference number won't credit the beneficiary account, na? My vendor is waiting.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Our server batch failed during clearing, so it requires two working days to reconcile the—

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [dry chuckle] Two days? Brilliant. Just brilliant. Your instant transfer system is truly wonderful, no?

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I can raise an escalation ticket to speed up clearance, if you prefer.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [weary sigh] Forget it. Another useless ticket won't do anything anyway. I give up.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Thank you for calling CelNet Customer Care. My name is Kevin. How may I assist you today?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Hi Kevin. I bought a new prepaid SIM card yesterday, but it is still showing no service lah.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I understand. Let me check on that SIM activation for you right away. May I have your full name and IC number, please?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Sure. Name is Ahmad Nizam bin Yusof. IC number is 880412-10-5531.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Thank you, Encik Nizam. Could you also share the new mobile number or the SIM card serial number printed on the back?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: The mobile number is 011-2849-3012. The SIM serial is 8960-0122-4410.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Got it. Thank you. Let me pull up your registration record in our system now.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [pause] Okay, take your time ya.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I see the registration was submitted yesterday at the Mid Valley branch. Have you tried restarting your phone today?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Yes, I restarted twice already this morning. Still says No Service on the top bar.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Understood. Can you verify if the SIM card is placed in SIM slot one or slot two?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: It is in slot one. My phone is an iPhone 13, single physical SIM only.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Alright. Let me check the backend network provisioning status. May I place you on a brief hold for about two minutes?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Sure, no problem. I will hold lah.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Thank you for your patience, Encik Nizam. Placing you on hold now.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [pause] No worries.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Thank you for waiting. It looks like there is a minor setback here. The automated ICCID provisioning stalled during yesterday's system batch update.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Ah, I see. That is why it cannot detect the network signal, kan?

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Exactly. The SIM registration is complete, but the network profile was not pushed to the local cell tower registry.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Okay. Can you push it manually from your side?

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Yes, I am initiating a manual OTA profile refresh right now. It will force the network binding directly to our HLR server.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Alright. Let me know when you need me to do anything.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: The manual sync is running now. [keyboard typing] It should take about fifteen seconds to broadcast.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [pause] Okay, standing by.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: The update has gone through successfully on our server. Could you please toggle your phone into Airplane Mode for five seconds, then turn it off?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Okay, turning on Airplane Mode now. [pause] One, two, three, four, five. Okay, switching off now.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Great. Let's give it a few seconds to search for the carrier frequency.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [pause] Ah, wait. The signal bar just appeared. It says CelNet 5G now.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Excellent! Let's do a quick test. Could you try dialing *124# to check your main account balance?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Okay, dialing now. [pause] Ya, the balance prompt pop up already. Showing ten ringgit active credit.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Perfect. That confirms data and voice routing are both fully active on your line now.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Okay, clear. Everything is working fine now, thank you.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: You are very welcome, Encik Nizam. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Nothing else lah. You have resolved it nicely. Thank you for your help, Kevin. Have a good day.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Thank you for calling Apex Customer Care. My name is Marcus. May I have your full name and registered email address to verify your account, please?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Yeah, hi. Tan Wei Ming. Email is w-m-dot-tan at horizon dot sg. I really need some quick help here, please.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Thank you, Mr. Tan. I've pulled up your record. What seems to be the trouble with your ApexBook today?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: My laptop won't turn on at all lah. I was using it normally last night, then this morning when I press the power button, totally dead. Zero response. I have a client deck due at two.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I understand how critical that deadline is. Let's run a quick hardware triage. First, when you plug in the original AC power adapter, do you see any charging indicator LED beside the USB-C port?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [scoff] Nothing leh. No orange light, no white light, nothing. Even the charging brick is completely cold to the touch.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Understood. Let's perform a static power discharge. Unplug the charger, disconnect all USB peripherals, then press and hold the power button down firmly for thirty full seconds.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [heavy exhale] Okay, wait ah... holding it down now. One, two... ten... twenty... okay, thirty seconds already. Pressing power again now. [sigh] Still pitch black. No fan sound, no keyboard backlight.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Alright. Could we test by plugging the adapter directly into a different wall outlet without going through any extension cord, just to eliminate the socket as—

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Aiyah, I already tested that before calling you lah! I tried three different wall sockets, and I even borrowed my colleague's identical Apex charger to test. Still completely stone dead.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I see, thank you for verifying that. In that case, allow me to place you on a brief hold for about two minutes while I consult our tier-two hardware schematics.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Fine lor, but don't take too long, okay? Time is running out.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Thank you for holding, Mr. Tan. As a final software-level override, let's try the emergency BIOS rescue sequence. Hold down the Escape and Function keys while pressing the power button three times.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Escape, Function, power three times... [clicking sounds] [dry scoff] Nope. Screen doesn't even flicker once. You sure this thing works meh?

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I'm afraid that indicates a power delivery failure on the main system motherboard. Because the board isn't drawing current, this requires an internal hardware replacement at our central repair depot.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Motherboard spoiled? Okay, so if I send it down to your service center in Jurong right now, can your tech fix it on the spot today?

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Unfortunately, our walk-in centers only handle triage. Depot motherboard replacements have a standard turnaround time of ten to fourteen business days due to parts backlog.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [bitter laugh] Ten to fourteen business days? Hello, my presentation is in four hours, and all my company quarterly slides are stuck inside your encrypted solid state drive. What am I supposed to do?

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I truly apologize for this difficult situation. We do offer an expedited data recovery service, but that is an off-site process as well and typically takes three to five business days minimum.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [heavy sigh] Three to five days. Fantastic lah. Really top tier premium support. Buy a three-thousand-dollar laptop for it to become an expensive paperweight after six months. Very helpful.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I understand your frustration, sir. I can initiate the depot pickup RMA ticket right now and email you the shipping label so we can begin repairs as soon as possible?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [flat monotone] Never mind lah. Don't bother. Sending it away for two weeks does nothing for me today anyway. Just close the case lor. Bye.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Apex Telecom, Ray speaking. How may I help you today?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [heavy sigh] Yeah. Waited whole morning for your broadband installer, but nobody came lah.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I apologize for the delay. Let me check if the technician can make it later this—

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [scoff] Later today? Don't bother lah. I already burn one full day of leave.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I am truly sorry. The earliest slot available in the system is Thursday morning.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [sigh] Thursday. Right. Another day waiting at home for nobody to show up, kan?

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I can lodge an urgent request to try for tomorrow morning instead.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [hopeless sigh] Tak apa lah, forget it. Never mind. I give up already.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Good morning, thank you for calling Horizon Bank Card Services. My name is Marcus. May I have your full name and your card's last four digits, please?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [weary sigh] Morning Marcus. Tan Wei Ling, last four digits eight nine four two. I'm trying to increase my card limit on your app, but it keeps failing.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Thank you, Ms Tan. I can check your credit line. To verify your account, could you confirm your NRIC and date of birth?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: S eight three four one nine two zero B, eleventh September nineteen eighty-three. Please be quick.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Thank you, Ms Tan. Verified. You hold our Horizon Infinite card with an eight-thousand-dollar limit. What new credit limit do you require today?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: I need a temporary increase to fifteen thousand dollars. My mother was admitted to Tokyo General Hospital, and they require a deposit before tomorrow morning. But your mobile app shows error code ERR-four zero three nine.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I understand the urgency, Ms Tan. That error occurs when automated approval isn't permitted by our credit engine, requiring manual underwriting review or Singpass MyInfo verification.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [scoff] But I submitted Singpass MyInfo three days ago leh! If your system cannot approve instantly, why advertise instant limit increase within seconds?

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I see the Singpass record from Tuesday. However, because you're requesting nearly double your limit, policy requires secondary document validation before releasing funds.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [sigh] Validation for what? My eleven-thousand salary is credited into your bank every month! You don't have my income records meh?

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Our card underwriting uses a separate system, Ms Tan. Let's try a portal override. Could you log into your internet banking right now?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Okay... [keyboard clattering] logged in liao. Card Services... Request Temporary Increase... fifteen thousand... clicking submit now.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Thank you. That submission routes to our duty credit queue for prioritized review.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [heavy sigh] Marcus, it shows a red banner: 'Cannot process online. Upload Notice of Assessment.' Same useless block lah!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: That triggers when risk thresholds lock. Under our credit bureau compliance and MAS regulatory guidelines—

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [scoff] Don't bring up MAS guidelines lah! Last week your bank sent me three SMSes begging me to take a fifty-thousand-dollar personal loan with zero documents! Now during a real family emergency, you give me endless excuses!

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I apologize, Ms Tan. I see how frustrating that is. Let me place you on hold while I speak directly with our credit duty manager for a waiver. May I hold for two minutes?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [resigned sigh] What choice do I have? Put on hold lor. Quick please.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Thank you for holding, Ms Tan. I've reviewed your request directly with our risk manager.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [flat tone] So can approve or not?

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: Unfortunately, we cannot override it today. An automated GIRO deduction is scheduled for tonight, which locks card adjustments until the billing cycle reconciles in forty-eight hours.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [cold chuckle] System freeze. So because I set up GIRO, your bank freezes my emergency request. Very sensible hor.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I know it's frustrating. As an immediate workaround, you can transfer seven thousand dollars to your card now, creating a credit balance for the hospital deposit.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [scoff] Transfer my own cash into the credit card? If I wanted to use cash, I wouldn't waste time calling your card department lah.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I understand, Ms Tan. It is the only real-time way to authorize the charge tonight before underwriters return Monday morning.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [hopeless monotone] Monday. The Tokyo hospital needs the deposit by tomorrow morning. Monday is useless to me.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I am very sorry. Would you like me to submit an expedited ticket for our management team on Monday?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [heavy sigh] For what? By Monday my mother's surgery is already delayed. What's the point? Just leave it lah.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I sincerely apologize that we couldn't resolve this today, Ms Tan. Is there anything else I can check?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [weary sigh] Nothing. Once this is settled, I am closing all my accounts. Big promises on advertisements, but zero help when needed. Whatever.

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: I will log your feedback regarding the emergency process, Ms Tan. I wish your mother a smooth recovery.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: [scoff] [flat monotone] Log feedback. Sure. Goodbye Marcus.
